previousOriginal:
The engineer understands the power you hold. He acquiesces unhappily. Lying back down, he begins humming gently.

Slowly, a pair of long limbs emerge. A face becomes visible. A set of big, wet eyes peer from under a snout bristling with opalescent hair. The engineer keeps humming, and the creature inches its way out. Finally, it nestles in his arms, its many-jointed legs wrapped around him so tightly it's hard to determine who is cradling who.

previousTranslation:
工程师明白你所拥有的权力。他不高兴地默认了。他躺下身，开始轻声哼唱。

慢慢地，一对长长的肢体出现了。然后是一张脸。一双湿漉漉的大眼睛从长满乳白色毛发的鼻子下面往外看。工程师不停地哼着歌，而这个生物渐渐爬了出来。最后，它依偎在他的怀里，它那多节的腿紧紧地缠着他，很难确定谁在抱着谁。

previousOriginal:
With pen, paper, and a hardback copy of Dolford's Compilation, you subject your transcription to a merciless interrogation.  You use a magnifying glass at several points, until it melts entirely.

Much of the writing is a panegyric to the Judgement of Hours; a catalogue of its deeds and dominions; its provinces, holdfasts and vassals. Its triumphs over time's lesser potentates.

The final burnt lines employ sigils used nowhere else on the Throne. A warning; a message: Time offers no surety against Death.

大部分文字都是对时间司命的颂辞。它的事迹和领地的目录——它的行省、掠夺的领地和附庸国。它战胜的较弱小的时间领主。

烧焦文字的最后几行使用了王座其他地方都没有出现的符印。一个警告；一条信息：时间也无法确切地抵挡死亡。

previousOriginal:
A rash of eyes across your back; more smeared across your shoulder like winking frogspawn. A slotted goat's eye, nestled in the crook of your elbow; a big shimmering beauty, the kind that inspires poets, glistening on your knee. 

You've been feeling weaker, lately – each new eye that sprouts has deep, thirsting roots. Yet it's worth it. In the privacy of your cabin, you unwind your bandages and inspect each one with pride.

最近，你觉得自己愈发虚弱——每只新眼睛都生出了渴求的深根。然而这也值得。你在私人舱室里解开绷带，自豪地检查每一只。

把金色印章从昏暗的坟墓中取出来时，你的手颤抖不已。

previousOriginal:
You touch two wires together, triggering a violent explosion that spins your locomotive sideways through the sky. Lamps shatter, plunging it into darkness. 

But still they come. Was the mutiny more widespread than you knew? Had they learned of your trap in advance? Was your timing off? It doesn't matter now. You drag yourself up. You'll not die on your knees.

The end is a scuffle in the dark, a slithering knife, and blood.

你在一片黑暗中迎来终结：扭打搏斗，刀刃一闪，血溅当场。

Outside, the stars shine evenly, untroubled by the bloodshed that grips your engine. The mutiny, in the end, was brief. There is blood on your shoes. Perhaps that would have troubled you, once. Not now.

哗变者们没有准备好面对死者。沉默的蒙面遗魂在机车的走廊上徘徊；安静地执行杀戮。哗变者在闷声尖叫中挨个死去。一些人被扔入空中，这明显是出于遗魂们的乐趣。戴面具的身影们回来了，满身赤红。

地板上遍布列车员们的内脏。你的补给没能在屠杀中幸存。

车外，群星照常闪耀，对你车上的流血事件置之不理。最后，哗变没能持续太久。你的鞋子上沾了血。也许曾经的你会因此不安。但现在不会了。

previousOriginal: As you step out among them, their heads lift. Their eyes are lambent, like the eyes of lions. Interested and hungry. Their teeth bare. Their sinews tense. You turn to flee back to the bridge. They pounce.
currentOriginal: As you step out among them, their heads lift. Their eyes are lambent, like the eyes of lions. Interested and hungry. Their teeth bare. Their sinews tense. You turn to flee back to the bridge. They pounce.
previousTranslation: 当你走到他们中间，他们的头猛然抬起。他们的眼睛炯炯有神，像狮子的那样。他们兴致盎然，饥肠辘辘。他们露出牙齿。他们肌肉紧绷。你转身逃回车桥。他们向你扑来。

previousOriginal:
Outside, your crew bay and shriek. After a while the engines judder and die. Later still, an explosion from the gun batteries cants your vessel to the side. 

Then someone snuffles outside your door. The handle rattles, experimentally. You raise your pistol, but they move away on socked, shuffling feet. 

You emerge when all is quiet. There are bodies in the corridor and cordite on the cold air. Any surviving crew, it seems, have returned to their senses and their cabins. Near the guns, a detonation has torn through your hull and hold. The surrounding supports groan, plaintively.
currentOriginal:

Then someone snuffles outside your door. The handle rattles, experimentally. You raise your pistol, but they move away on socked, shuffling feet. 

You emerge when all is quiet. There are bodies in the corridor and cordite on the cold air. Any surviving crew, it seems, have returned to their senses and their cabins. Near the guns, a detonation has torn through your hull and hold. The surrounding supports groan, plaintively.
previousTranslation:
舱外，列车员们厉声尖叫。不久后，引擎抖动一下，便熄火了。又过了一段时间，炮塔发生的爆炸把你的机车震得倾向一边。

此时，你听见门外有人喘气。把手转动出声，仿佛在试探。你举起手枪，但门外的人拖着受伤的脚离开了。

等一切归于寂静，你打开门。尸体横卧在走廊上，空气中弥漫着火药味。看起来，剩下的所有列车员都恢复理性，回到各自舱室中了。主炮附近，一次爆炸轰开了车壳和仓库。周围的支架正发出哀鸣。

previousOriginal: You find other crew in the galley, and tell them of your dream. They are unsettled. They had the same dream too.
currentOriginal: You find other crew in the galley, and tell them of your dream. They are unsettled. They had the same dream too.
previousTranslation: 你在厨房里找到其他列车员，对他们讲述了你的梦。现在他们相当不安。他们也开始做起了同样的梦。

previousOriginal: On your way to the galley you round up as many crew and officers as you can, and lead them on a midnight raid of the pantry. Brandy is drunk. Murgatroyd's Fungal Crackers are devoured in bulk.
currentOriginal: On your way to the galley you round up as many crew and officers as you can, and lead them on a midnight raid of the pantry. Brandy is drunk. Murgatroyd's Fungal Crackers are devoured in bulk.
previousTranslation: 你前往厨房，途中尽可能地召集列车员和车务官，并带着他们对储藏室进行了一次午夜洗劫。大家痛饮白兰地，大吃穆氏真菌饼干。

previousOriginal: How neatly the tales and your dream fit together! But the revelation is not a satisfying one. It only hints at something grander and more terrible still. Because if these awful things are true, then the world that permits them must be more awful still.
currentOriginal: How neatly the tales and your dream fit together! But the revelation is not a satisfying one. It only hints at something grander and more terrible still. Because if these awful things are true, then the world that permits them must be more awful still.
previousTranslation: 这些故事和你的梦境多么匹配！但这一发现没法让你满足。它只是在暗示更宏大、更骇人的东西。因为如果这些可怕的事情是真的，那么允许它们发生的世界一定更加可怕。

previousOriginal: The search will cost fuel, but it might prove profitable. Perhaps it has a pocket-watch or a silver brooch, or other valuables.
currentOriginal: The search will cost fuel, but it might prove profitable. Perhaps it has a pocket-watch or a silver brooch, or other valuables.
previousTranslation: 搜索将花费燃料，但或许能捞到油水。尸体上说不定有块怀表、银胸针，或者其他贵重物品。

previousOriginal: A dour companion
currentOriginal: A dour companion
previousTranslation: 沉闷的伙伴

previousOriginal: Since you took to the skies, you have seen horrors to humble them!
currentOriginal: Since you took to the skies, you have seen horrors to humble them!
previousTranslation: 你在天空中目睹的骇人景象足以让它们自愧不如！

previousOriginal: Morale is strained, and someone has been careless. One of the barrels in your hold wasn't securely fastened. It has split, spilling the precious hours across the floor. Already, the hours' insistent melancholy has begun to permeate the engine, and your clocks are becoming erratic.
currentOriginal: Morale is strained, and someone has been careless. One of the barrels in your hold wasn't securely fastened. It has split, spilling the precious hours across the floor. Already, the hours' insistent melancholy has begun to permeate the engine, and your clocks are becoming erratic.
previousTranslation: 士气低落，有人因此大意了。你货舱里的一只木桶没有固定好。它裂开了，宝贵的时间洒落一地。这些时间经久不息的忧伤已经开始渗进引擎，你的时钟也变得不稳定了。

previousOriginal: You and the once-caged catch clash in the hold, each of you giving as vigorously as you get. But its bulk is overwhelming. Trampling you, it blunders through the door, crashes through your engine to an exterior hatch and – barging it off the hinges – escapes into the sky. Behind it, it leaves a trail of smashed windows, bent pipes, and jets of hissing steam.
currentOriginal: You and the once-caged catch clash in the hold, each of you giving as vigorously as you get. But its bulk is overwhelming. Trampling you, it blunders through the door, crashes through your engine to an exterior hatch and – barging it off the hinges – escapes into the sky. Behind it, it leaves a trail of smashed windows, bent pipes, and jets of hissing steam.
previousTranslation: 你和曾被关在笼中的猎获在货舱中厮斗，双方都使出浑身解数。但它的体型大出你太多。它踏过你的身子，冲出门外，一路撞过机车来到一扇外舱门——撞脱门上的铰链——逃入了天空。它身后留下由粉碎的窗玻璃、弯曲的管道和喷射而出的蒸汽组成的轨迹。

previousOriginal:
The sky-beast careens through your locomotive, breaking pipes and fracturing supports until it finds a warm corner of the engine room in which to resolve its predicament. 

There it bellows until its offspring is born, whereupon the infant turns on and devours its parent: a process that the original sky-beast submits to placidly. While the sated infant dozes, lazily, your crew heave it into a new cage and return it to the hold.
currentOriginal:

previousTranslation:
天兽在你的机车上飞奔，打破管道，撞断支柱，直到终于在引擎室找到一个温暖的角落来处理它的窘境。

它在那里不断鸣叫，直到它的孩子出生，于是幼崽开始吞噬它的母亲：原本的那只野兽顺从地屈服于这个过程。当幼崽吃饱喝足，懒洋洋地打起瞌睡时，你的列车员们把它搬到一只新的笼子里，然后将其放回货舱中。

previousOriginal: Soon the shards are swept away and new panes fitted in the casings. The stars are once more hidden away behind their prismatic glass, glowing in sullen hues of green and purple and red.
currentOriginal: Soon the shards are swept away and new panes fitted in the casings. The stars are once more hidden away behind their prismatic glass, glowing in sullen hues of green and purple and red.
previousTranslation: 很快，碎片就被清扫干净，而新的窗玻璃被装进窗框。群星被颜色绚丽的玻璃再次阻挡在外，发出绿色、紫色和红色的沉闷色调。

previousOriginal: You need your crew (and yourself) in sound mind. Repair the windows with a Pane of Stained Glass from your hold.
currentOriginal: You need your crew (and yourself) in sound mind. Repair the windows with a Pane of Stained Glass from your hold.
previousTranslation: 你需要列车员们（当然还有你自己）保持头脑清醒。用货舱里的一块彩色玻璃修复窗户。

previousOriginal: Better not to know. Whatever treasure, horror, or debris wandered into your path, you will leave it to the mists.
currentOriginal: Better not to know. Whatever treasure, horror, or debris wandered into your path, you will leave it to the mists.
previousTranslation: 还是不知道的好。不管是什么宝藏，骇人之物或残骸漂泊到了你的路上，你都会把它留在迷雾中。

previousOriginal: It would use up fuel. There might be danger. But perhaps whatever you hit was valuable. Or perhaps it needs help.
currentOriginal: It would use up fuel. There might be danger. But perhaps whatever you hit was valuable. Or perhaps it needs help.
previousTranslation: 这会花费燃料。还可能会有危险。但你撞到的东西或许很值钱。又或者，它需要帮助。

previousOriginal: A fruitless search
currentOriginal: A fruitless search
previousTranslation: 搜寻无果

previousOriginal: Conduct a lottery
currentOriginal: Conduct a lottery
previousTranslation: 组织一次抽签

previousOriginal:
You block the windows with boards and rags. You burn paraffin in a copper bowl; its blue flames lazy in the dark. You paint your face with soot and ash so it resembles a gaping mouth.

As one, you and the crew swear an oath of loyalty. If any of you break it, may the Burrower take whatever time remains to you all.
currentOriginal:
You block the windows with boards and rags. You burn paraffin in a copper bowl; its blue flames lazy in the dark. You paint your face with soot and ash so it resembles a gaping mouth.

As one, you and the crew swear an oath of loyalty. If any of you break it, may the Burrower take whatever time remains to you all.
previousTranslation:
你用木板和破布堵住窗户。你在铜碗里点燃石蜡；幽蓝的火苗在黑暗中摇曳。你用煤灰把脸涂遍，形似张开的大嘴。

你和列车员们一同发誓忠诚。如果你们中任何一个人违背了誓言，就愿掘隧神取走所有人剩下的时间。

previousOriginal:
By day, the living are watched by the silent masks of the dead. By night, the living keep to their bunks in curfew, while the dead prowl the corridors of your engine. 

By morning, there are fewer of the living and more of the dead. There is less talk of mutiny now.
currentOriginal:
By day, the living are watched by the silent masks of the dead. By night, the living keep to their bunks in curfew, while the dead prowl the corridors of your engine. 

By morning, there are fewer of the living and more of the dead. There is less talk of mutiny now.
previousTranslation:
白天，活人被沉默面具下的死者所监视。到了晚上，活人在宵禁中躺上自己的床铺，而死者则在你机车的走廊上游荡。

到了早上，活人变少，死者变多。关于哗变的讨论也少多了。

previousOriginal: Some utter fool has scrawled eyes all over your walls!
currentOriginal: Some utter fool has scrawled eyes all over your walls!
previousTranslation: 某些彻头彻尾的傻瓜在你的墙上画满了眼睛！

previousOriginal: You impose no punishment. Meanwhile, your engine develops an undignified splutter. Abrasions on the hull worsen into draughty rents. The cylinder leaks. Pipes crack.
currentOriginal: You impose no punishment. Meanwhile, your engine develops an undignified splutter. Abrasions on the hull worsen into draughty rents. The cylinder leaks. Pipes crack.
previousTranslation: 你没有施加任何惩罚。与此同时，你的引擎不体面地噗噗作响。车体上的擦伤恶化为漏风的裂缝。汽缸漏气。管道破裂。

previousOriginal: They appear unmoved. When you dismiss them, they shuffle away. Matters do not improve. Suffering under their lack of care, your engine develops an undignified splutter. Abrasions on the hull worsen into draughty rents. The cylinder leaks. Pipes crack.
currentOriginal: They appear unmoved. When you dismiss them, they shuffle away. Matters do not improve. Suffering under their lack of care, your engine develops an undignified splutter. Abrasions on the hull worsen into draughty rents. The cylinder leaks. Pipes crack.
previousTranslation: 他们似乎无动于衷。你下令解散，他们便走开了。情况并没有改善。在他们的漠然下，你的引擎不体面地噗噗作响。车体上的擦伤恶化为漏风的裂缝。汽缸漏气。管道破裂。

previousOriginal: No sooner are you all out of the engine room than a deafening blast rips through it. Scouring steam fogs its glass hatch, preventing you from seeing the extent of the damage.
currentOriginal: No sooner are you all out of the engine room than a deafening blast rips through it. Scouring steam fogs its glass hatch, preventing you from seeing the extent of the damage.
previousTranslation: 你们刚逃出引擎室，就听见其中传来一声震耳欲聋的爆炸。灼热的蒸汽模糊了玻璃舱口，你们无法看见损坏的程度。

previousOriginal: They hurry to the valves in a desperate attempt to ease the pressure. Their efforts are successful – the raging in the cylinder begins to ease. But not before a pipe bursts, filling the engine room with scalding steam and lead shrapnel.
currentOriginal: They hurry to the valves in a desperate attempt to ease the pressure. Their efforts are successful – the raging in the cylinder begins to ease. But not before a pipe bursts, filling the engine room with scalding steam and lead shrapnel.
previousTranslation: 他们慌忙扑向阀门，拼命想要降低压力。成功了，汽缸里的火势渐弱。但一根管道随即爆裂，引擎室里顿时被滚烫的蒸汽和飞溅的铅片吞没。

previousOriginal: Scavenge your supplies for enough materials to fashion a temporary repair. It won't offer any protection, but it'll see you back to port.
currentOriginal: Scavenge your supplies for enough materials to fashion a temporary repair. It won't offer any protection, but it'll see you back to port.
previousTranslation: 搜集补给品，找到足够的材料来临时修理。它不能提供任何防护，但能让你撑到下个港口。

previousOriginal: You work with your crew, flinging nets over the contents of the hold and lashing everything together. But another lurch from your engine makes a stack of crates lean, then topple. Some of your crew are trapped beneath it.
currentOriginal: You work with your crew, flinging nets over the contents of the hold and lashing everything together. But another lurch from your engine makes a stack of crates lean, then topple. Some of your crew are trapped beneath it.
previousTranslation: 你和列车员一起工作，用网罩住舱内的物品，把所有的东西绑在一起。但你的机车又猛地一震，一堆板条箱倾斜倒塌。有列车员被困在了下面。

previousOriginal:
You pick an empty cabin. There are no shortage of them now. The Devil knocks on your new door, to confirm that he was able to save most of the supplies.

Lying in your new bed, you hear the wind shrieking through your hold, taking its pick of your cargo.
currentOriginal:
You pick an empty cabin. There are no shortage of them now. The Devil knocks on your new door, to confirm that he was able to save most of the supplies.

Lying in your new bed, you hear the wind shrieking through your hold, taking its pick of your cargo.
previousTranslation:
你挑了一间空舱室。如今，这类房间并不稀缺。魔鬼敲响了你的新门，以确认他已设法救出大部分补给。

躺在你的新床上，你听到风在你的客舱里嘶吼着，挑选着你的货物。

previousOriginal:
You carry anything combustible to a cabin near the engine room, and pile it on the floor. It should make up for the missing fuel.

Your supplies are still woefully depleted, though, and without spare parts it is impossible to keep your engine in a satisfactory condition.
currentOriginal:
You carry anything combustible to a cabin near the engine room, and pile it on the floor. It should make up for the missing fuel.

Your supplies are still woefully depleted, though, and without spare parts it is impossible to keep your engine in a satisfactory condition.
previousTranslation:
你把任何可燃的东西搬到引擎室附近的车舱，堆放在地板上。这应该可以弥补缺少的燃料。

不过，你的补给仍然严重不足，如果缺少零件，就不可能让你的机车保持在一个令人满意的状态。

previousOriginal:
You pile everything combustible on the floor of a cabin near the engine room. It should keep you going. 

The Driver, meanwhile, has only occasionally been overzealous. Most things they cannibalised you can live without. Your stores are still drastically understocked, though.
currentOriginal:
You pile everything combustible on the floor of a cabin near the engine room. It should keep you going. 

The Driver, meanwhile, has only occasionally been overzealous. Most things they cannibalised you can live without. Your stores are still drastically understocked, though.
previousTranslation:
你把所有可燃物都堆在靠近引擎室的一个车舱的地板上。这些应该能让你继续前行。

与此同时，司机偶尔显得有些过度热心。那人拆下来的大部分东西都无关紧要。不过，你的库存仍然严重不足。

previousOriginal: You must keep your strength up.
currentOriginal: You must keep your strength up.
previousTranslation: 你必须维持体力。

previousOriginal: A member of the crew has fallen hopelessly in love with your [qvd:138886(Name)][qvd:138891(Name)][qvd:138890(Name)][qvd:138892(Name)] Forged Companion. They are lying on the floor of the Companion's quarters, gazing hopelessly up at the Companion. "Such eyes," they gasp, their face wet with tears. "The facets!"
currentOriginal: A member of the crew has fallen hopelessly in love with your [qvd:138886(Name)][qvd:138891(Name)][qvd:138890(Name)][qvd:138892(Name)] Forged Companion. They are lying on the floor of the Companion's quarters, gazing hopelessly up at the Companion. "Such eyes," they gasp, their face wet with tears. "The facets!"
previousTranslation: 一位列车员无可救药地爱上了你[qvd:138886(Name)][qvd:138891(Name)][qvd:138890(Name)][qvd:138892(Name)]锻造同伴。这人躺在同伴宿舍的地板上，无望地仰望着同伴。 “这样的眼睛，”此人叹着气，脸上被泪水打湿。“这样的面孔！”

previousOriginal: It is not as if you can understand the Companion's methods any better than the crew can.
currentOriginal: It is not as if you can understand the Companion's methods any better than the crew can.
previousTranslation: 你并不比你的列车员更能理解锻造同伴的方法。

previousOriginal:
The signaller is excited to have been chosen for such an important task, the details of which remain unclear to them. They eagerly comply as the Studious Forged Companion gestures for them to climb into the tank. The Companion pulls a series of levers, and directs your attention to a viewing window. 

The machine vibrates, and the signaller's beaming smile falters before disappearing completely as the inside of the viewing window is obscured by a thick splatter of— 

You close your eyes, but it is too late; you're not going to be able to forget your signaller's last moments.

The Companion's voice sounds distant as they explain that unfortunately, the process has not worked this time. However, you are not worry; they have identified the problem, and are fairly certain that the next attempt will be successful.

previousTranslation:
信号员感到很是兴奋，尽管其并不清楚自己面临的所谓“重要任务”的细节。当好学的锻造同伴打手势让此人爬进箱子时，其毫不犹豫地听从了命令。同伴拉动一系列杠杆，并让你的目光转向一个瞭望窗。

机器震动了一下，信号员灿烂的笑容立刻失色，随后便完全消失了。观察窗的内部顿时涂满厚厚的一层——

你闭上眼睛，但为时已晚——你此生再难遗忘那位信号员的临终时刻。

同伴解释说，很不幸，这次的处理过程并没有按照设想运作。它的声音似乎离你很远，说你无需担心，它已经发现了问题所在，下次一定可以成功。

previousOriginal: Your supplies are diminished, and the crew are squabbling over the remains. The Pugilistic Forged Companion arrives on the scene, fists at the ready. They will protect the supplies at any cost.
currentOriginal: Your supplies are diminished, and the crew are squabbling over the remains. The Pugilistic Forged Companion arrives on the scene, fists at the ready. They will protect the supplies at any cost.
previousTranslation: 你的补给减少了，列车员们正在为剩余的食物争吵不休。强健的锻造同伴来到现场，拳头已摆好架势。它将不惜一切代价保护这些补给。

previousOriginal:
You square your shoulders and hold the Pugilistic Forged Companion's [qvd:138894(Encounter)][qvd:139010(Encounter)] gaze as they approach. "There you are," they say, [qvd:138893(Encounter)][qvd:138888(Encounter)]. 

[qvd:138894(Encounter2)][qvd:139010(Encounter2)] They retaliate with a blow that catapults you into the hull with such force that it cracks, then drag you off the floor and hurl you into a hissing pipe. It cracks with the impact, filling the passageway with steam. The Companion disappears into it, triumphant.

The fight has left your locomotive in need of repair.

你昂首挺胸，回应强健的锻造同伴[qvd:138894(Encounter)][qvd:139010(Encounter)]的视线。“原来你在这儿，”对方说道，[qvd:138893(Encounter)][qvd:138888(Encounter)] 。

[qvd:138894(Encounter2)][qvd:139010(Encounter2)] 对方以将你轰到墙上的一击回应，其力道甚至让车体凹陷下去。他随即把你甩到地上，又扔向一根嘶嘶作响的管道。管道随之破裂，通道中霎时弥漫着蒸汽。取胜的同伴消失于其中。

previousTranslation:
粘土人列车主管勃然大怒，怒目圆睁，胸膛剧烈起伏——

但终归于镇定。他说：“如你所愿，是我又失察了。”说罢垂首，转身离去。

最后时日里，他只把自己关在铺位上。偶尔，你经过附近能听到几句唱词。他在下个车站下了车，没有与任何人作别。

previousOriginal:
There is a hammering upon your door, in the dead of night. The knocker is insistent. They will not go away. They will not let you sleep.

It is the Clay Conductor. "I wanted to tell you that I am not leaving. I assume that you thought that I would be – given my reasons for travelling have ... failed."

He draws a deep breath and his eyes finally meet yours. "I mean. Captain, I'd like to stay as your First Officer. If you'll have me?"

previousTranslation:
夜半三更，有人砸门。那人相当执着，不会善罢甘休，不会饶你入睡。

粘土人列车主管立于门外，说：“我想告诉你，我决定留下。我猜你以为我会离开，毕竟我已经没有理由继续此行了。”

他深吸一气，目光终于看向你，“我的意思是，车长，我想继续留任大副。你同意吗？”

previousOriginal:
"I shall find someone who can teach them those things I cannot. They must learn that there is more than just music. I caused my Companion to be made. I have a – a duty." He seems surprised by his own words. 

"I don't want them to become like me – limited. But nor do I want to leave you in the lurch. I shall provide compensation for the assistance you provided. It should cover hiring a replacement." He turns away. "Thank you, Captain."

They depart at the next port. The last you see of them, the Conductor is striding away into the mists, the Companion at his side.

“我不想他们和我一样局限，却也不愿置您于困境。我会付钱补偿您给我们的帮助，足够雇请接替我的人。”他转过身。“多谢，车长。”

previousOriginal:
You shake the crew awake and order them to the galley. There, you pour out the whisky, and all exchange stories of your cold, distant dreams.

When they return to their cabins, one crewman finds one of the Felined Eccentric's cats still sleeping on his bunk. The cat is twitching, deep in a dream. "Get off, mog," the crewman says, and tries to lift it away. It doesn't move. He tries both hands, and strains until he's red-faced. The cat is cold and heavy as a slab of stone.

Then the cat – Beleth, the narrow, black one – wakes, stretches, and wanders away.

previousTranslation:
你把列车员们摇醒，把他们叫去厨房。你将威士忌倾入杯中，寒星般遥远的梦境碎片在酒精中浮沉交叠。

返回自己的舱室时，有位列车员发现猫咪怪人的一只猫仍盘踞在他的铺位上酣睡。那猫抽搐着，沉陷梦境。“滚下去，畜生，”列车员说着，试图拎开它。猫身纹丝不动。他改双手使力，憋得满脸通红，那猫却如石板般死沉冰凉。

然后那只猫——布锐斯，又瘦又黑的那只——突然惊醒，抻个懒腰，慢悠悠踱出门去。

previousOriginal: And the stone, statue'd courtroom where the silent dead file before you. You were looking down at them, as if you were very tall. Their faces, behind their porcelain masks, were turned to the floor.
currentOriginal: And the stone, statue'd courtroom where the silent dead file before you. You were looking down at them, as if you were very tall. Their faces, behind their porcelain masks, were turned to the floor.
previousTranslation: 又是那遍布雕像的岩石法庭，无声亡者们在你面前排成长队。你俯视他们，自己仿佛成了巨人。他们那藏在瓷质面具之下的脸低低下垂。

previousOriginal: Your engineers manage to repair the worst of the damage, but when your locomotive passes through a bank of heavy fog something plucks two of them from the hull and bears them away. All that is left is their severed lifelines, streaming like bunting behind your locomotive.
currentOriginal: Your engineers manage to repair the worst of the damage, but when your locomotive passes through a bank of heavy fog something plucks two of them from the hull and bears them away. All that is left is their severed lifelines, streaming like bunting behind your locomotive.
previousTranslation: 工程师们设法修复了最严重的损伤，但是当你的机车撕开浓雾帷幔时，有什么东西把其中两人从车体上拽下来、带走了。剩下的只有他们被切断的救生绳，像彩旗一样飘在机车后方。

previousOriginal: You've had your own encounter with death.
currentOriginal: You've had your own encounter with death.
previousTranslation: 你自己就曾与死神打过照面。

previousOriginal: You harry them until they curse your name (in whispers, of course – none of them dare risk you overhearing). Their brush with death is all-but forgotten. You have shown them something worse.
currentOriginal: You harry them until they curse your name (in whispers, of course – none of them dare risk you overhearing). Their brush with death is all-but forgotten. You have shown them something worse.
previousTranslation: 你步步紧逼，直到他们咒骂起你的名字（当然是压低声音的——没人敢冒被你听到的风险）。他们完全忘了自己曾与死神擦肩而过。你已经让他们看到了更糟糕的事情。

previousOriginal:
You tether your engine, and lead your crew to a neighbouring sky-rock. There, you construct a camp, ration your supplies, burn fuel for warmth, and hope to wait out the Guests' visit.

Unfortunately, on the second day, the Candlewind finds you. It blows your tents away and fills the air with its procession of pale candle-flames. The cold thickens. Hunger bites.

In desperation you are forced to return to your locomotive. The Guests have concealed themselves behind panelling and under the flooring. But they are only biding their time.

previousTranslation:
你固定住机车，带领列车员来到邻近的天石上。你们建造营地，定量配给，烧火取暖，并希望借此熬到寄客虫自行离开。

不幸的是，第二天蜡烛风就找上了你们。它吹走帐篷，在空中排满苍白的烛火。寒冷加剧，饥饿噬人。

迫于绝望，你们只得回到机车上。寄客虫藏在了护板后、地板下，但它们只是在拖延时间。

previousOriginal:
You open a window to let the wind in, and set out the appropriate tokens. A bowl containing a handful of crumbs. A ring, never worn. An empty house (in this case, the doll's house an engineer was building for her child).

In threes, the Guests slither in. They approach the pitiful tokens. Beads of gelatinous moisture squeeze from ducts in their frontal parts of their flesh.. Are those tears?

Then they slither out through the window, contorting themselves into sleeping-knots as they tumble away to await another locomotive. Yours has been sanctified.

previousTranslation:
你打开窗户让狂风涌进来，并放置好合适的信物。装了一把碎屑的碗、从未佩戴的戒指、无人居住的房屋（是一位工程师为她孩子搭建的玩偶小屋）。

寄客虫三只一组溜进来。它们接近这些可悲的象征物。一颗颗凝胶状的液体从肉团前方的管腺中挤出……这是眼泪吗？

然后它们又溜出窗外，一边摇晃着离开，一边蜷成一团进入休眠，静候下一列机车到来。你的机车已被洁净了。

previousOriginal:
The room is uncommonly cold. Perhaps there is a crack in the window, or its rubber seal has rotted. You leave, and return in your thermals.

It is a sleepless night. Boisterous winds buffet your engine. Your breath mists in the air. Eventually, in the bleak ends of the night you doze off, only to snap suddenly awake again. Were those footsteps you heard, lightly crossing the room?

You fumble for the lamp, but your fingers are stiff. Giving up, you open the shutters and bathe the room in starlight. It gleams, silver, on a set of frosty footsteps. It twinkles on the pale fingerprints that dapple your book. Something has been reading it while you slept.

You mention nothing to the crew.

previousTranslation:
房间冷得非同寻常。或许是车窗有裂缝，或是橡胶封带烂掉了。你离开片刻，换上保暖衣回来。

这是个无眠之夜。狂风拍打着机车。你呼出的气息凝成白雾。最终你在凌晨将尽时打了个盹，却又猛然惊醒。你是不是听到了轻轻穿过房间的脚步声？

你摸索提灯，但手指僵硬不听使唤。你放弃了，打开遮光板，任星光倾泻而入。银光闪烁在一串结霜的脚印上。映亮了你书本上斑驳的苍白指纹。某物趁你睡着的时候翻阅过这本书。

你对列车员们闭口不提。

previousOriginal:
A mysterious outbreak of nostalgia is spreading through your crew. 

Frequently, they stop work to stare away into misty remembrance. They gather during the evenings to meditate on times gone by, and debate the ways in which the past was superior to the present. The air is full of sighs.

一股神秘的怀旧情绪突然爆发，在列车员之间传染。

The stowaway picks her nose, defiantly.

Then your foe trips. You both fall to the ground, and the weight of your body drives the knife deep into his breast.

Your inquiry induces a rare spirit of cooperation in the scholars. "The last expedition into the woods found a document written in the Correspondence. It contained directions to a place called the Steward's Font," the Theologian explains. 

Alas, that is all it needs to break their alliance. The Paleographer begins to argue that the Steward was a chief position in Charlemagne's household. The Classicist makes a pointed reference to Inanna's husband. 

The Theologian's smile is forced. "If you could find the Font, it would be an immense boon to my work." There are sputters of protestation. "Our work."

[You can begin this expedition from 'Expeditions into the Deep of the Wood'.]

previousTranslation:
你的询问激发了学者们罕见的合作精神。“上一次进入树林的远征发现了一份用信符写成的文件。它上面记载了通往‘总管的洗礼台’的路，”神学家解释道。

可惜，这话正好撕裂了他们的同盟。古物学家开始争辩，总管曾是查理曼王廷里的高阶官职。古典学者则话里带刺地提起了伊南娜的丈夫。

神学家笑得很勉强。“要是你能找到那个洗礼台，对我的研究帮助会非常大。”随后就有人抗议道。“是我们的研究。”

[你可以从“深入林地的远征”处开始此项远征。]

previousOriginal:
Blue smoke rises from a camp at the fringes of the Palewood. A great bronzewood has come down in a storm. Lumberers swarm over its vast trunk, boring into its core to extract the most supple wood.

There is more than can be burned for charcoal and more than the Company will pay for. Rather than leave it to slowly rot in the rain, the lumberers are willing to sell it to those captains with a reputation for discretion.

即使减去用来烧炭和卖给公司的部分，木材还省下很多。与其让它在雨中慢慢腐烂，伐木工们更愿意把它卖给那些以谨慎著称的车长。

The other replies: "How did you know I'd return?"

"You always have before. I'm glad you're all right."

They wander off, each catching the other up as to what has passed in their time apart.

previousOriginal:
What was briefly a modest, pleasant town on the Mother of Mountains now runs on increasingly desperate dreams of riches. 

Fools sell their futures for the chance to mine years from the Mountain's frozen sides. Sharper minds sell pickaxes, supplies, and the promise of a warm bed at the end of a bitter day's work.

previousOriginal:
Lustrum is home to a single raucous, rancorous auction house, held in the back room of the Hanged Man on the occasional Wednesday.

Within these grimy confines, miners and factory owners rub-shoulders, salivating at the bit at the curios, oddities and occasional bargain that the lugubrious auctioneers puts before them.

Asking how the auction house comes by the goods in such quantities, however, will earn you a one way ticket to a small pit in a cold field at the foot of the mountain. Some things are best left unspoken.

previousOriginal:
The hour of the factory visit arrives. Your sleeves quiver with excited rats; but in the jostle of gawpers, busy-bodies, stakeholders and hangers-on, no one notices. 

The wrought iron gates with their cheery motif of butterflies swing open. A sharp-smiled Company forewoman is on hand to lead the tour. 

Inside is an orderly purgatory of wheels, spindles and great creaking looms. Steam, smoke, and the crystalline gleam of cracked hours makes visibility poor. Your sleeves squeak impatiently.

参观工厂的时候到了。激动的老鼠们把你的袖子搞得不停抖动，但有这么多目瞪口呆的参观者、忙活的工人、股东和攀附权贵者摩肩接踵，根本没有人会注意到。

装饰着生动蝴蝶图案的熟铁大门打开了。一位笑容满面的公司领班担任导游。

工厂内是一座轮轴、纺锤和吱嘎作响的巨大织机构成的炼狱。蒸汽、浓烟和破裂时间晶体的反光遮蔽视线。你的袖子不耐烦地吱吱叫起来。

previousTranslation: 你的悲伤蜘蛛如今已长得比你的眼球还大——当然，这颗眼球如今只是一颗无用的壳。

previousOriginal:
The offices of the Windward Company on Port Prosper are elegantly appointed, if antiquated. Paintings of old London adorn the walls.

The Parsimonious Chairman has work for ruthless captains. He sits behind his imported mahogany desk, a decanter of brandy at his left hand and a series of neatly stacked reports at his right. A fire has been lit in the cavernous hearth. It is too warm.

迎风公司在兴荣港的办公室布置典雅，只是风格过时。墙上挂着旧伦敦的画作。

吝啬鬼主席正为无情的车长们准备差事。他坐在那张进口红木办公桌后，左手边搁着一瓶白兰地，右手边是一沓整齐叠放的报告。宽敞的壁炉里燃着火，暖得有些过分。

previousTranslation: 公司保存着整柜的许可，以便顺利与阿尔比恩进行各种交易。

previousOriginal: This is what they requested.

previousTranslation: 这就是他们的要求。

previousOriginal:
"Is it her? Is she in there?"

No, you are forced to admit. Not her, only her voice. She can speak only the words she is given.

"So that is all you could do." His voice is husky, in that it is a husk.

He clasps the jar to his chest, tears running down his cheeks. "I love you," says the jar tonelessly. "I love you."

The Industrialist retreats to his quarters, locking the door. As you exit the mansion, you can still hear the hollow "I love you" echoing through its halls, underscored by cacophonous sobbing.

“是她吗？她在里面？”

不是她，只有她的声音。她只能说被给予的话语。你别无他法，只好承认。

“所以这就是你所能做的一切。”他沙哑的声音从空洞的躯壳中传出。

他把罐子紧紧抱在胸前，泪水顺着脸颊流下来。“我爱你。”罐子的声音缺乏起伏，“我爱你。”

实业家退回到他的房间，锁上了门。离开豪宅时，你仍可以听到“我爱你”的声音，伴着不和谐的呜咽声，在大厅里回荡。

previousTranslation: 采集唱诗蜂群的灵魂历来是一项繁重的工作，此刻由于隐姓埋名的公主让它们分了心，因此变得简单了一些。她站在她的舷窗边，鼻子紧贴着玻璃，而蜂群的幽灵般的残骸则争先恐后地靠近她。“哦，你们这些小家伙已经爱上我了，”她低声说着，内心激动不已。\n\n当公主在与蜜蜂亲近时，你有一个更艰巨的任务：慢慢地将灵魂从蜜蜂濒死的残骸上释放出来，同时避开其蜂刺最后的徒劳的​​抽搐。

previousOriginal: The Empire values ingenuity. "The sciences," her Majesty has claimed, "will bridge the heavens."
currentOriginal: The Empire values ingenuity. "The sciences," her Majesty has claimed, "will bridge the heavens."
previousTranslation: 帝国重视独创性。女王陛下声称：“科学将为天界架起桥梁。”

previousOriginal:
Perhaps you were educated at one of the esteemed colleges of Benthic or Summerset. 

Perhaps you taught yourself, through trial and error and grit. 

But what was your field of study?
currentOriginal:
Perhaps you were educated at one of the esteemed colleges of Benthic or Somerset. 

Perhaps you taught yourself, through trial and error and grit. 

But what was your field of study?
previousTranslation:
你曾是学者。

或许你曾就读于著名的本栖或萨默塞特大学。

又或许你靠着反复试验、自我摸索和坚韧意志，自学成才。

那么，你专攻的学科是？

previousOriginal: You ran souls and sunlight to Gaider's Mourn and the Isle of Cats. You sailed, lampless, through the concealing dark. You lurked in hidden coves while the excisemen passed by.
currentOriginal: You ran souls and sunlight to Gaider's Mourn and the Isle of Cats. You sailed, lampless, through the concealing dark. You lurked in hidden coves while the excisemen passed by.
previousTranslation: 你曾将灵魂与阳光走私至加德的哀悼与猫岛。你熄灭船灯，在黑暗中航行，行踪隐秘。你藏匿在隐秘的海湾，任由执法者从附近驶过。

previousOriginal: The Department of Sensibility is considered the heart of the Ministry. It was a solemn place to work: its employees take their responsibilities very seriously indeed.
currentOriginal: The Department of Sensibility is considered the heart of the Ministry. It was a solemn place to work: its employees take their responsibilities very seriously indeed.
previousTranslation: 感知局是公德部的核心，是庄严的工作场所：工作人员也确实十分严肃地对待自身承担的职责。

previousOriginal: You notched each dismal day onto the cell wall. You steered clear of the monsters and the meek they preyed upon. You dreamed of the day of your release.
currentOriginal: You notched each dismal day onto the cell wall. You steered clear of the monsters and the meek they preyed upon. You dreamed of the day of your release.
previousTranslation: 你在牢房的墙上刻下每一个凄惨的日子。你避开了怪物和被它们捕食的温驯者。你梦着自己被释放的那一天。

previousOriginal: You said what you had to, and they sent you home. Even now, your world is red and gold and splendid.
currentOriginal: You said what you had to, and they sent you home. Even now, your world is red and gold and splendid.
previousTranslation: 你说了你该说的话，他们就把你送回了家。即使现在，你的世界仍然鲜红、金黄、灿烂。

previousOriginal: You lost your mind, once. They put you in a splendid hotel managed by a Cheery Gentleman who would determine when you could leave.
currentOriginal: You lost your mind, once. They put you in a splendid hotel managed by a Cheery Gentleman who would determine when you could leave.
previousTranslation: 你曾一度失去理智。他们把你安置在一家由一位开朗的绅士管理的体面旅馆里，他将决定你何时可以离开。

previousOriginal: Secret letters, warm and yearning. Furtive assignations, where desires (among other things) could be unlaced. The reports were salacious.
currentOriginal: Secret letters, warm and yearning. Furtive assignations, where desires (among other things) could be unlaced. The reports were salacious.
previousTranslation: 秘密情书，里面充满了温暖与渴望。暗中约会，有人能在那里释放欲望（还有其他的一些东西）。相关报导淫秽不堪。

previousOriginal: You were the gossip of London's salons, and the target of blistering editorials in the Gazette. Mad, they said. Bad, they said. Dangerous to know.
currentOriginal: You were the gossip of London's salons, and the target of blistering editorials in the Gazette. Mad, they said. Bad, they said. Dangerous to know.
previousTranslation: 你曾是伦敦沙龙里的八卦话题，也曾是《公报》上那些刺耳社论的靶子。他们说你丧心病狂，说你道德败坏，说你是个危险人物。

previousOriginal: A revolutionary invention! Its possibilities are thrilling, but have yet to be realised by lesser minds. At least your peers appreciate your ingenuity.
currentOriginal: A revolutionary invention! Its possibilities are thrilling, but have yet to be realised by lesser minds. At least your peers appreciate your ingenuity.
previousTranslation: 一个革命性的发明！它的可能性令人激动，但尚未被一些头脑较为平庸的人所认识。至少你的同行们欣赏你的聪明才智。\n

previousOriginal: And concealed within its three comprehensive and erudite volumes – which are approvingly stamped by the Ministry of Public Decency – is an encrypted, but spirited, call to revolution.
currentOriginal: And concealed within its three comprehensive and erudite volumes – which are approvingly stamped by the Ministry of Public Decency – is an encrypted, but spirited, call to revolution.
previousTranslation: 而在这三本详尽而博学的著作中，隐藏着一个加密但充满激情的革命号召。这些书都已经被公德部批准盖章。

previousOriginal: You would not let your education go to waste. You poured years of sleepless nights, setbacks and research into one great work. They called you brilliant, eccentric, and obsessive.
currentOriginal: You would not let your education go to waste. You poured years of sleepless nights, setbacks and research into one great work. They called you brilliant, eccentric, and obsessive.
previousTranslation: 你不会让你受的教育白白浪费。你投入了无数个不眠之夜、挫折和研究，用于完成一部伟大的作品。他们说你很聪明，很古怪，很执着。

previousOriginal: It was crammed with clattering machinery. A chipped workbench was streaked with ruddy stains. Something coiled, miserably, in the oily contents of a bell-jar.
currentOriginal: It was crammed with clattering machinery. A chipped workbench was streaked with ruddy stains. Something coiled, miserably, in the oily contents of a bell-jar.
previousTranslation: 这里堆满了铮铮作响的机器装置。一张破损的工作台上布满了红色的污渍。有什么不幸的东西盘在一个钟形罐子里的油状物质中。

previousOriginal: It was rich and it was red, and there is power in deeds that others fear to do.
currentOriginal: It was rich and it was red, and there is power in deeds that others fear to do.
previousTranslation: 肥厚，鲜红。别人不敢行的事中蕴含有力量。

previousOriginal: His attempts to distance himself from his larcenous past were of mixed success. His guests were scarred and rough-spoken, and told bloody tales of smuggling and thief-oaths, and nameless murders.
currentOriginal: His attempts to distance himself from his larcenous past were of mixed success. His guests were scarred and rough-spoken, and told bloody tales of smuggling and thief-oaths, and nameless murders.
previousTranslation: 他试图与过去的盗贼生涯告别，这一举措成败参半。他的客人们满身伤疤，言语粗鲁，口吐着走私、盗贼誓言和无名谋杀的血腥故事。

previousOriginal: For a time, you enjoyed the favour and protection of a mentor; someone who saw your potential and decided to nurture it.
currentOriginal: For a time, you enjoyed the favour and protection of a mentor; someone who saw your potential and decided to nurture it.
previousTranslation: 有一段时间，你享受着导师的喜爱和保护。有人看到了你的潜力，并决定培养它。

previousOriginal: They said you were impetuous, ungrateful, headstrong. They said other, less complimentary things. Then they ordered you from their home, and said you must make your own way. So you did.
currentOriginal: They said you were impetuous, ungrateful, headstrong. They said other, less complimentary things. Then they ordered you from their home, and said you must make your own way. So you did.
previousTranslation: 那人说你很急躁，忘恩负义，刚愎自用，还说了些别的不那么好听的话，然后命令你离开那人的家，还说你必须自立门户。于是你就这么做了。

previousOriginal: The smog painted your lungs black. Your knuckles were scarred. But it was honest. There were diamonds in the dirt.
currentOriginal: The smog painted your lungs black. Your knuckles were scarred. But it was honest. There were diamonds in the dirt.
previousTranslation: 烟雾把你的肺染成黑色，你的指关节上留下了伤痕。但那种生活是真实的。即使在泥土里也存在着钻石。

previousOriginal: You were at home
currentOriginal: You were at home
previousTranslation: 像家一样

previousOriginal: You spent much of your youth in the hard end of London, where the gaslamps are scarce, the prospects bleak, and the people as flinty as the cobbles.
currentOriginal: You spent much of your youth in the hard end of London, where the gaslamps are scarce, the prospects bleak, and the people as flinty as the cobbles.
previousTranslation: 你在伦敦的贫民区度过了你的大部分青春。那里煤气灯稀少，前途暗淡，人像路面的鹅卵石一样坚忍。

previousOriginal: Your breast has become translucent, and allows an educational – if distressing – view of your coursing veins and thumping heart. You take pains to conceal it.
currentOriginal: Your breast has become translucent, and allows an educational – if distressing – view of your coursing veins and thumping heart. You take pains to conceal it.
previousTranslation: 你的胸部已变成半透明状，让人可以看到你流动的血管和怦怦直跳的心脏。这看起来很有教学价值，也很让你苦恼。你为掩饰它想尽了办法。

previousOriginal: You suffer from a perpetual, hoarse cough, and occasionally expel clouds of emerald sand into your handkerchief.
currentOriginal: You suffer from a perpetual, hoarse cough, and occasionally expel clouds of emerald sand into your handkerchief.
previousTranslation: 你不停地，嘶哑地咳嗽。偶尔你会把翡翠色的沙尘吐到手帕里。

previousOriginal: You were wronged, and those ultimately responsible must be held to account. Whoever, or whatever, they are. It is just.
currentOriginal: You were wronged, and those ultimately responsible must be held to account. Whoever, or whatever, they are. It is just.
previousTranslation: 你被冤枉了，而那些最终对此负有责任的人必须被追究。无论他们是谁，无论他们是什么。这是正义。

previousOriginal: You swore yourself to silence, and built a sanctuary of ignorance. Some truths are too terrible to countenance.
currentOriginal: You swore yourself to silence, and built a sanctuary of ignorance. Some truths are too terrible to countenance.
previousTranslation: 你发誓保持沉默，并建立了不知的圣堂。有些真相太过可怕，以至不可被提出。

previousOriginal: Following London's relocation, the New Astronomy has become a crucial, well-funded discipline. But the fate and physiology of Albion's dead sun are strictly barred from study.
currentOriginal: Following London's relocation, the New Astronomy has become a crucial, well-funded discipline. But the fate and physiology of Albion's dead sun are strictly barred from study.
previousTranslation: 自伦敦抵达天野后，新天文学经费充足，已成为一门至关重要的学科。然而，当局却严禁有关阿尔比恩殒日之过往与天体结构的研究。

previousOriginal: The tale of your predecessor appealed to them. "Misunderstood," they said. "Ahead of their time," they said. "Tragic," they said.
currentOriginal: The tale of your predecessor appealed to them. "Misunderstood," they said. "Ahead of their time," they said. "Tragic," they said.
previousTranslation: 你前任的故事吸引了他们。“误会，”他们说道。“超前于他们的时代，”他们说道。“悲剧，”他们说道。

previousOriginal: You've always been a gambler. You'll risk it all on the throw of a dice or the turn of a card.
currentOriginal: You've always been a gambler. You'll risk it all on the throw of a dice or the turn of a card.
previousTranslation: 你向来是个赌徒。不管扔一次骰子还是翻一次卡牌，你都可以赌上一切。

previousOriginal: You were a temporary recruit, to help maintain order during London's perilous exodus to the sky.
currentOriginal: You were a temporary recruit, to help maintain order during London's perilous exodus to the sky.
previousTranslation: 你是一名临时新兵，在伦敦逃往天空的危急时刻协助维持秩序。

previousOriginal: You buried it. A death is a dangerous thing to keep nearby.
currentOriginal: You buried it. A death is a dangerous thing to keep nearby.
previousTranslation: 你把它埋起来了。把死亡放在身边是一件危险的事情。\n

previousOriginal: A new style might be just the thing.
currentOriginal: A new style might be just the thing.
previousTranslation: 一种新风格大概正是这样的。

previousOriginal: The bees won't get the better of the Titanians yet.
currentOriginal: The bees won't get the better of the Titanians yet.
previousTranslation: 蜜蜂尚不足以战胜狄坦妮娅人。

previousOriginal: The cheek of the thing! Peeking and prying!
currentOriginal: The cheek of the thing! Peeking and prying!
previousTranslation: 那东西的脸皮！在瞥视和窥探着！

previousOriginal: The door shuts. How did it come to be open in the first place? Something is frozen in the crust of stellar ice at its lip: a single shoe.
currentOriginal: The door shuts. How did it come to be open in the first place? Something is frozen in the crust of stellar ice at its lip: a single shoe.
previousTranslation: 门关上了。它最初是如何被打开的？某个东西被冻结在其边缘的恒星冰壳中：一只鞋。

previousOriginal:
What's this? On the floor? A smudge of frost. It almost looks like a bootprint. How curious. 

You go about your business. The locomotive is draughty from the open hatch, so you don a coat and scarf.
currentOriginal:
What's this? On the floor? A smudge of frost. It almost looks like a bootprint. How curious. 

You go about your business. The locomotive is draughty from the open hatch, so you don a coat and scarf.
previousTranslation: 地板上有东西？这是什么？一块霜痕。看起来几乎像是靴印。真奇怪。  \r\n\r\n你继续忙你自己的事。机车上寒风瑟瑟，于是你穿上大衣和围巾。

previousOriginal: A Scrive-Spinster, Defeated
currentOriginal: A Scrive-Spinster, Defeated
previousTranslation: 被打败的纺书人

previousOriginal: A selection of obscenely large seeds, in prickly shells. A musky scent emanates, redolent of persimmons and guano. Your stoker moans as she puts one down, blood on her teeth, having mistaken it for a fruit.
currentOriginal: A selection of obscenely large seeds, in prickly shells. A musky scent emanates, redolent of persimmons and guano. Your stoker moans as she puts one down, blood on her teeth, having mistaken it for a fruit.
previousTranslation: 精选的硕大种子，壳里满是刺。散发着麝香味，散发着柿子和鸟粪的芬芳。你的司炉在放下一颗时发出了呻吟，她的牙齿上沾满了血迹，她刚把它误认成某种水果了。

previousOriginal: The decanter is empty. Closer examination reveals it is merely cheap glass. But the cloth it rests upon – a sliver of exquisite fabric shrouded in shadow. It drinks light like a prisoner having his first cup of wine on freedom.
currentOriginal: The decanter is empty. Closer examination reveals it is merely cheap glass. But the cloth it rests upon – a sliver of exquisite fabric shrouded in shadow. It drinks light like a prisoner having his first cup of wine on freedom.
previousTranslation: 醒酒器是空的。仔细观察，你会发现它不过是廉价的玻璃。但它底下的布料是一片被阴影笼罩的精致织物。它汲取着光芒，如同囚徒在自由之时饮下第一杯美酒。

previousOriginal: The final lock falls revealing a device wrapped in chains. Warnings in a variety of languages have been scored onto the links. They all intimate a state of considerable failure, a general desire for the reader to avoid the contraption, and a specific desire not to press that button.
currentOriginal: The final lock falls revealing a device wrapped in chains. Warnings in a variety of languages have been scored onto the links. They all intimate a state of considerable failure, a general desire for the reader to avoid the contraption, and a specific desire not to press that button.
previousTranslation: 随着最后一把锁落下，一个被锁链缠得严严实实的装置显露出来。锁链上刻着警告，以各种语言写就。所有警告均暗示着严重事故的风险，且都建议避免使用此装置，并明确指示不要按下那个按钮。

previousOriginal: A Miniature Folding Bureau
currentOriginal: A Miniature Folding Bureau
previousTranslation: 一个微型折叠写字台

previousOriginal:
The box slides open to reveal nothing. You shake it. There is a clunk and a rattle. Something is inside. 

Further investigation reveals a false bottom. Once you have disarmed the spring loaded poison concealed within, you unearth a sheaf of crumpled pages. The writing is poor, but their message is clear. A favour is owed to the bearer of these letters; a debt, they say,  will not go unpaid.
currentOriginal:

盒子滑开，空无一物。你摇一摇。有一声闷响和咔嗒声。里面有东西。

previousOriginal:
It does not respond to movement, heat or light. It does, however, seem inclined towards sound, emitting a puff of spores in the direction of two chattering crewmen. 

You perform further experiments. It ignores the noise of the engines, and is unresponsive to music. But it does respond to singing. Apparently, the fungus likes voices.

previousTranslation: 它对运动、热量或光线没有反应。不过，它似乎对声音有兴趣，它朝两名喋喋不休的船员的方向喷出了一股孢子。\n\n你进行进一步的实验。它无视机车的噪音，对音乐也没有反应。但它对唱歌有反应。很明显，这种真菌喜欢人声。

previousOriginal:
Your stokers are all eagerness. Little sets of shaving knives are distributed for the task. Between all of you, you make light work of the peeling lichen and gather several barrels. Experimentation with matches suggest noseplugs will be required, but there appear to be no other ill effects. 

This opinion holds for several days until a resounding clang and an unhappy smell drift up from the boiler room. The source? A sporing boiler which proceeded to explode, embedding fungal fragments of itself in the hull.

previousTranslation: 钢制车架扭作一团，但在破碎的窗户后面，车桥似乎基本完好。

currentOriginal: A harried groomsman cuts slice after slice. "Please, take it. Or I'll be eating it for months." Well, it's the least you can do.

previousOriginal: A child tries to pull you into the revels. Her father smiles and apologises for her forwardness, but reiterates her invitation. Guests are helping themselves to the food, others are dancing.
currentOriginal: A child tries to pull you into the revels. Her father smiles and apologises for her forwardness, but reiterates her invitation. Guests are helping themselves to the food, others are dancing.

previousOriginal: You take a handful of stokers (whose lungs are used to smoke) and hurtle into the smouldering homestead. Posters of Tackety Jack blacken and peel from the walls; ramshackle leather roofing crackles like sausages in a frying pan. An intrepid stoker dares the fire-choked kitchen, and emerges black-faced but laden with barely charred provisions.

previousTranslation: 你带着几名司炉（他们的肺已经吸惯了烟尘）冲进闷烧的宅地。钉鞋杰克的通缉令变得焦黑，从墙上脱落：摇摇欲坠的皮革屋顶噼啪作响，就像煎锅里的香肠。一个勇敢的司炉冲进满是火烟的厨房，他黑着脸出来，但身上装满了几乎没有被烧焦的食物。

You order your crew forward, racing around the smouldering homestead and through the billowing smoke. There! A shadow ahead— A bullet whizzes through the choking smog. You are lucky; your signaller is not. Blood runs through the smoke. 

There is more gunfire. There are more bodies. You recover a hefty bag of coinage from the slightest corpse.

There is more gunfire. There are more bodies. You recover a hefty bag of coinage from the slightest corpse.

你命令你的列车员冲锋，绕过冒烟的宅地，穿越滚滚浓烟。看！前方有个黑影——一颗子弹飞啸着穿过呛人的烟雾。你很走运；你的信号员则不然。鲜血在烟雾中流淌。



枪声依旧持续。尸体依旧增多。你从最瘦小的尸体上搜到一袋沉重的钱币。

previousOriginal:
Your rounds ring off the house's iron skin, and find the gaps between its makeshift plates. There is an agonised scream; a spray of blood; the sound of a gun's chamber locking. They must be on the verge of surrender, surely? 

Then you smell burning. Someone's lit the steading ablaze. A door slams. You can see figures running through the smoke.

然后你闻到烧焦的味道。有人点燃了马厩。门砰的一声关上了。你看到在烟雾中奔走的人影。

previousOriginal: You could bury it somewhere in the homestead's grounds.
currentOriginal: You could bury it somewhere in the homestead's grounds.
previousTranslation: 你可以把它埋在宅地的某个地方。

previousOriginal: No one who lives in the wild is likely to welcome strangers.
currentOriginal: No one who lives in the wild is likely to welcome strangers.
previousTranslation: 野外生活的人不太可能欢迎陌生人。

previousOriginal: An Opportunity! Offer to trade for their surplus of seeds
currentOriginal: An Opportunity! Offer to trade for their surplus of seeds
previousTranslation: 机遇！提议换取多余的种子

previousOriginal: For better or worse, he will not be returning to Magdalene's.
currentOriginal: For better or worse, he will not be returning to Magdalene's.
previousTranslation: 无论是好是坏，他都不会再回到抹大拉之家。

previousOriginal: Tell the truth
currentOriginal: Tell the truth
previousTranslation: 告知真相

previousOriginal: The ice crunches underfoot, caking your boots with a pitchy crust. There is no door on the church.
currentOriginal: The ice crunches underfoot, caking your boots with a pitchy crust. There is no door on the church.
previousTranslation: 脚下的冰嘎吱作响，你的靴子上结了一层黑乎乎的冰壳。教堂上没有门。

previousOriginal: The sky churns as you make your way to the pitiful domes. Most are empty, awaiting a well-wisher. But the third one is not. It contains a corpse, stiff as an icicle – some supplicant who died before their wish was granted. You move on. In the fifth dwelling you find a sallow petitioner, her eyes feverish. "I saw gold in the well," she croaks, unprompted. "Glistering in the deeps!"

previousTranslation: 天空汹涌澎湃，你走向那些可怜的穹顶建筑。它们大多是空的，等待着向井许愿的人。但第三座却不是。里面有一具尸体，如冰锥般僵硬——某个愿望没被满足就死了的求道者。你继续前进。在第五座房子，你发现一个面色蜡黄的请愿者，她的眼神狂热。 “我在井里看见了金子，”她自发地嘶哑道。“在深渊中闪闪发光！”

previousOriginal:
The assembly is difficult. The well-winds howl, dragging any unsecured tools or equipment over the edge. The cold bites, freezing fingers and faces. Picks and hammers break on the packed black ice.

Eventually, the machinery is ready, the bathysphere poised at the well's edge. Below it is the roiling, thirsty depth: blacker than oil, blacker than pitch, blacker than the space between the stars.

"Do you know," the Baroness says, in a low voice only you can hear. "I'm not certain I can do this."

previousTranslation:
过程十分艰难。井风呼啸，把没有固定的工具和设备拖进井里。寒风刺骨，冻住了手指和脸。凿子和锤子在密实的黑冰上折断。

终于，设备准备就绪了，潜水球悬在井口边缘。下面是咆哮的、饥渴的深渊：比石油更暗，比沥青更黑，更甚于群星之间的虚空。

“知道吗，”女爵士低声说道，只有你能听见。“我不确定能不能做到。”

previousOriginal: Perhaps your grievances are invented. Perhaps they are complex, and need to be translated into more compelling terms to meet the Minister's flinty standards.
currentOriginal: Perhaps your grievances are invented. Perhaps they are complex, and need to be translated into more compelling terms to meet the Minister's flinty standards.

previousOriginal: Your predecessor spoke occasionally of the Chamberlain's journal and the Martyr-King's Cup. Ever since you heard those stories, your dreams have been bathed in moonlight. Beware: this ambition can be failed. If you fail, you will be able to choose another Ambition to pursue. A future captain may succeed.

previousOriginal: The captain's cabin is empty. The food is stale. A glass of wine sits on the table, rotten and vinegary. Dust shrouds that which your guns haven't already scorched. No one has been in here for a very long time.
currentOriginal: The captain's cabin is empty. The food is stale. A glass of wine sits on the table, rotten and vinegary. Dust shrouds that which your guns haven't already scorched. No one has been in here for a very long time.
previousTranslation: 车长室是空的，食物都发霉了。桌上放着一杯酒，已经变质，散发出醋味。灰尘笼罩着未被你的炮手烧尽的东西，这里已经很久没有人进来了。

previousOriginal: The captain's cabin has been stripped bare. Did they flee during the fight? Or perhaps you stumbled upon a locomotive in mutiny. You uncover a series of drawings in the chief engineer's quarters. It's rare for the Tacketies to keep written records for fear of capture, but the engineer had a fine hand. Intricate depictions of winds and stellar tides near and far, some familiar, more not, litter the desk.

previousTranslation: 车长室已经被净空了。他们在战斗中逃跑了吗？又或者你意外发现了一辆处于叛乱的的机车。你在轮机长的宿舍找到了一系列图纸。钉鞋党害怕被逮捕，往往极少留下书面记录，但这位工程师心灵手巧。桌上散落着对远近风向和恒星潮汐的复杂描述，有些比较熟悉，更多是你陌生的。

previousOriginal:
A lady in a jacket bodice with boned sleeves looks you up and down. "What do you think, Mildred?" A murmur of assent runs through the crowd of starched and corseted ladies. A gentleman adjusts his moustache. "Yes, you'll do." 

You spend the day with some of the self-described notables of Port Prosper. You eat roast chestnuts, sip glasses of Greyfields ("All the way from old London!"), and even participate in a 'Riding', charging through the narrow streets pursued by several braying fellows in a dragon.

previousOriginal:
You are treated as a curiosity and viewed from all sides with suspicion. Still, you find yourself in conversation with an elderly colonel, who has retired to Port Prosper. "A bulwark of sanity," he calls it, "A line in the sand against all the stuff out there." He introduces you to one of the 'Riders' in the procession, who takes you on a tour of the carnival. You converse with chestnut-sellers and flower-arrangers, drink in the outdoor pubs, and dance with several of the vaudeville players. 

At the end of the day, you've learnt many names and faces, and even acquired a few calling cards.

previousOriginal: You slip into the shadows to better observe proceedings. Hidden away, you see all sorts of things you suspect the factory owners would prefer you not to. Barrels being assigned to destinations based on bribes rather than need. Fatigued workers revivified by sips of unrefined hours. Shifts extended and extended again, for time has little meaning here. You are disturbed by a sudden cry of, "I say, who's that lurking behind the barrels." It is time to be off.

Only the most youthful and vigorous workers have been assigned to the workstations the tours pass through. The rest wait in less sightly rooms, in the shadows. One aged man catches your eye and winks.

previousOriginal: A few East-End staff are kept on retainer, for the less rarefied requirements of the Nelson's running.
currentOriginal: A few East-End staff are kept on retainer, for the less rarefied requirements of the Nelson's running.
previousTranslation: 一些东区的工作人员被保留下来，以满足纳尔逊茶楼中不那么重要的要求。

previousOriginal: There is much that can be learned here at the heart of polite society. If you're discreet.

previousTranslation: 在上流社会的核心，我们可以学到很多东西。如果你足够谨慎的话。

previousOriginal: You engage in the great game of Port Prosper with aplomb, commenting on this dignitary's hemline and that gentleman's awful propensity for trying to keep pace with the Albion fashions. You are just starting to enjoy yourself when one of the waiting staff catches your eye. "Don't I know you?" You make your excuses.

previousTranslation: 你潇洒地参与了兴荣港的博弈，评论着这位政要的下摆和那位绅士试图跟上阿尔比恩时尚的糟糕倾向。你才刚开始享受这些，一名侍者就引起了你的注意。“我是不是认识你？”你找了个借口搭话。

previousOriginal:
The Admiral Nelson is Port Prosper's most exclusive tea house. West-Enders congregate here to sit amongst the many little tables of ornamental shepherds and bulldogs and drink tea from little saucers with Her Renewed Majesty's face on them. 

The Admiral Nelson is so exclusive, in fact, that it opens only occasionally and never does anything so crass as advertise. People know by word of mouth. Initially, at least. Afterwards, most Prosperans join the queue.

previousOriginal: You find your companions in the stalls, armed with boiled sweets and roast chestnuts. You soon have the vicar hopping about the stage, while the exuberant widow is almost beside herself with laughter. The interval, and subsequently the rest of the second act, is a hazy affair.

previousOriginal: The Lammas Fair is a time to see and, crucially, be seen.
currentOriginal: The Lammas Fair is a time to see and, crucially, be seen.
previousTranslation: 拉马斯闹市是一个既可以显摆也可以看别人显摆的地方。

previousOriginal: Carnival barkers accost you with promises of wonderful kaleidoscopes that'll show you visions of life on the frontier. Old sky-captains have been wheeled out to tell tall tales of life out in the Reach: daring escapes predominate, their reasons for retiring in Port Prosper are left undisclosed. Several acquaintances catch up with you by the bridge and you promenade together, taking in the sights and sounds of the main stalls, while avoiding the smells from the side streets.

previousOriginal: A disgruntled parlour maid has been press-ganged into serving canapes. She is the favourite of several of the notables in attendance, and sufficiently irritated to disclose a very great deal indeed. One particularly boastful functionary has been sent to Port Prosper to remove him from doing any more damage, rather than the promotion he believes it to be. She adjusts her smile before returning to the throng.

previousTranslation: 行空车长在舞会上总是很受欢迎。你是舞池中静止轨道上的新奇人物。

Several servants snicker as they pass you by, refusing to top up your champagne.

previousTranslation: 我们便可以通过它们的食性来确定它们与其他生物间的关系，随后我们就可以知道更多这个新疆界的历史。

previousTranslation:
这只藐视锚虫身上有什么不对劲。

举例说，它有一只眼，其内结膜脉络充血赤红，好似它已在无休止的哀痛中度过了千万载岁月。那藐视锚虫，它的种族通常拥有着锯齿般的几何形状，显得病态，它的身体则扭曲且因毒瘤而流脓，带着非自然尺寸的囊肿。

这可能十分反常，但那藐视锚虫仍是一种原始的启示，古老而如此浸溺于苦痛，以至空气自身已在对其的同情中震颤。这并非那类凡俗或可理解的疼痛，而是于自身的广大无垠中某种几近神圣的事物，如一整个宇宙所受的创痛被尽数扭曲作一种存在。

previousOriginal: Piscine bodies ribboned with nearly human eyes. Starfish like human lips, razored and rinded with blue coral. Creatures even more peculiar still, more illusion than flesh, whirling through the Mists.
currentOriginal: Piscine bodies ribboned with nearly human eyes. Starfish like human lips, razored and rinded with blue coral. Creatures even more peculiar still, more illusion than flesh, whirling through the Mists.
previousTranslation: 鱼形身躯上镶嵌着近乎人眼的条纹。海星宛如人的嘴唇，被锋利的蓝色珊瑚切割并包裹。还有更加奇异的生物，与其说是血肉之躯，不如说是幻象，它们在迷雾中旋转穿梭。

previousOriginal: A Chaplain with an amiable smile and grey-streaked hair.
currentOriginal: A Chaplain with an amiable smile and grey-streaked hair.
previousTranslation: 这位牧师笑容和蔼，头发灰白。

previousOriginal: Grey hair, grey eyes, and a grey expression. More cement than steel.
currentOriginal: Grey hair, grey eyes, and a grey expression. More cement than steel.
previousTranslation: 灰暗的头发、灰暗的眼睛、晦暗的表情。比起钢铁，更像是水泥。

previousOriginal: Will the Chaplins free you of this turbulent skin of a princess?
currentOriginal: Will the Chaplins free you of this turbulent skin of a princess?
previousTranslation: 牧师们能把你从公主那张狂暴的皮肤中解放出来吗？

previousOriginal:
You can't bring yourself to truly torment the prisoners, and settle for prodding them gently and making awkward jokes at their expense. 

Nevertheless, the Performer seems satisfied. He grins and leads you further up a spiral staircase.
currentOriginal:

Nevertheless, the Performer seems satisfied. He grins and leads you further up a spiral staircase.
previousTranslation: 你没法真的折磨囚犯，只能轻轻地刺激他们，并在他们身上开一些尴尬的玩笑。\n\n尽管如此，表演者似乎对此感到满意。他咧嘴一笑，带着你继续往上，走到一个螺旋形的楼梯上。

previousOriginal:
You wrack your brain, and soon come up with torments that you suspect will amuse the Performer. You dangle prisoners over lengthy drops by their ankles, or lift them bodily and leave them on high ledges from which they can't escape. 

By the time you're finished, there are tears of laughter streaming from the Performer's empty eyes. "This reminds me of an old joke," he says. "Why didn't the skeleton go to the dance?"

You reply that you don't know.

"Because years earlier, he was murdered by his tour guide!" The Performer beams and leads you further up a spiral staircase.

previousTranslation:
你绞尽脑汁，很快就想出了一些你认为能取悦表演者的折磨方式。你把囚犯的脚踝吊在高台的吊柱上，或者把他们的身体悬挂在他们无法逃脱的高处窗台上。

当你完成的时候，表演者空洞的眼眶里流下了欢乐的泪水。“这让我想起了一个老笑话，”他说，“为什么骷髅没去跳舞？”

你回答说你不知道。

“因为多年前，他被他的导游谋杀了！”表演者笑了笑，带着你走到一个螺旋形的楼梯上。

previousOriginal:
Attempting to navigate through Piranesi is like trying to steer a nightmare. Bridges shift beneath your feet, taking you back to where you began. Every corner you turn reveals another mile of identical hallway. You must never, ever trust a staircase.

After seemingly-endless wandering, your shoes are in tatters and your feet blistered. You must be close by now! You simply must be—

You stop short, finding yourself back where you started.

previousTranslation:
试图在皮拉内西寻路就像试图驾驭一场噩梦。桥梁在你脚下移动，带你回到出发的地方。你转过的每一个角落都会显露出一英里长的相同厅室。你永远、永远无法信任楼梯。

经过了似乎无尽的流浪之后，你的鞋子已经破烂不堪，脚上也起了水泡。你现在肯定快到了！你肯定——

你突然停下脚步，发现自己又回到了起点。

previousOriginal: Search for an escape
currentOriginal: Search for an escape
previousTranslation: 寻找出路

previousOriginal: You can only see in greys and blues, and your fingers have retreated shyly into your hands. Piranesi has taken too much from you.
currentOriginal: You can only see in greys and blues, and your fingers have retreated shyly into your hands. Piranesi has taken too much from you.
previousTranslation: 你只能看见灰色与蓝色，而你的手指已胆怯地缩进了掌中。皮拉内西已从你身上拿走了太多东西。

previousOriginal:
Your pilot grazes the wreck's hull, and has to reverse. Your navigator's hand slips while winching the locomotives close. A clang resounds throughout your engine.

When you've finally docked, you select a few of your crew to join you. The outer door to the Boatman is rimmed with frost. The bolts shriek as they are pulled across.

Inside, your torchlight reveals a narrow corridor in sombre black, opening onto darker doorways; likely the crew cabins. There is a long moan from somewhere deeper in the engine. "Probably the boilers," your stoker whispers. Pressing forward through the cabins, you hear the rattle of something that might be chains. "A bolt loose in the chassis," your stoker suggests, less confidently.

previousTranslation:
驾驶员驾车擦过车体残骸，不得不倒车。领航员手下一滑，绞索猛然收紧。两车相撞，金属撞击声在你的车内回荡。  

终于完成对接后，你挑选了几名列车员同行登船。船夫号的外舱门覆着冰霜，拉开门闩时，金属摩擦的尖啸声在死寂中格外刺耳。

进入车内，你举起手电，映照出一条狭窄的走廊，墙壁漆成肃穆的黑色，通向更深、更暗处的门廊，有可能是宿营舱。船夫号深处传来一声悠长的金属呻吟声，司炉径自嘀咕道：“可能是锅炉在响吧。”你们一行人继续穿行于舱室之间，耳边又响起金属碰撞的窸窣声，像是锁链相碰。司炉补了一句：“应该是车底的螺栓松了”，但这次，语气明显没那么确定了。

previousOriginal: Your old injury fades. So does the memory.
currentOriginal: Your old injury fades. So does the memory.
previousTranslation: 你的旧伤逐渐消失。记忆亦然。

previousOriginal: Your old injury fades. So does the memory.
currentOriginal: Your old injury fades. So does the memory.
previousTranslation: 你的旧伤逐渐消失。记忆亦然。

previousOriginal:
The corpse nods stiffly. Its fingers close around your own. There is an uncomfortable moment where you almost leave with more fingers than you started with, but eventually, and with many a courteous "Excuse me!", you extract yourselves. 

"We're glad you didn't run away," the skeleton says.
currentOriginal:

previousTranslation: 尸体僵硬地点点头。它的手指紧抓住你的手指。有一瞬间，几乎把它的指头拔下来的感觉让你有些不适，但最终，在许多声礼貌的“抱歉！”中，你们彼此都脱了身。\n\n“我们很高兴你没有逃跑，”骷髅说。

previousOriginal: It's only polite.
currentOriginal: It's only polite.
previousTranslation: 遵守礼节。

previousOriginal: This engine has been claimed by the dead. Let them keep it.
currentOriginal: This engine has been claimed by the dead. Let them keep it.
previousTranslation: 这台机车已被死者占据。让他们留着它吧。

currentOriginal: A Grave Mistake

previousOriginal: The secrets of St Dunstan's Rendezvous are locked behind a nigh impenetrable cipher.
currentOriginal: The secrets of St Dunstan's Rendezvous are locked behind a nigh impenetrable cipher.
previousTranslation: 圣邓斯坦会议的秘密被锁在一个几乎无法攻破的密码后面。

previousOriginal: A smell of baking wafts through your locomotive.
currentOriginal: A smell of baking wafts through your locomotive.
previousTranslation: 一股烤饼的味道在你的机车上萦绕。

previousOriginal:
You organise your hardiest stokers into a rota, slowly but steadily widening the gap between the pallid walls of quivering fungal flesh. The smell is direful, as are the ominous bulges protruding from the mushroom bulk. 

Thanks to your capable direction, however, a wide path is cleared straight through the fungus, bisecting it like two lungs separated by the trachea. You pass through, unharmed.

previousTranslation: 你把手下最得力的炮手组织起来轮流开火，缓慢而稳定地扩大着颤抖的苍白真菌肉壁的缝隙。气味非常可怕，蘑菇体中突出的不祥的隆起也是如此。\n\n尽管如此，在你的指挥下，一条宽阔的道路打通了真菌，将其一分为二，就像气管将两个肺片分开。你通过了肉壁，毫发无伤。

previousOriginal: Fruiting sacs send clouds of vitriolic orange into the air.  Passing through will be hazardous to the health. The engine room is just beyond.
currentOriginal: Fruiting sacs send clouds of vitriolic orange into the air.  Passing through will be hazardous to the health. The engine room is just beyond.
previousTranslation: 孢囊向空气中喷出腐蚀性的橙色气体，走进去绝对有害健康。引擎室在车厢后面。

previousOriginal:
You go alone. Your crew disappear behind you, lost in a haze of orange and gold. Above, sacs of sporing fungus encrusted to the metalwork begin to erupt. Showers of spore and viscous liquids render the terrain still more hazardous. 

You feel a peculiar sensation; your hands tingle, as though wishing to reach out, to touch the fungus, as though for one more drink. You increase your speed.

At last, you leap over a final hissing sac of fungal eggs, and find yourself before the engine room door.

previousTranslation:
你独自深入。你的列车员在身后消失，迷失在一片橙金色的朦胧之中。在上方，包覆在金属物件上的孢子菌囊开始喷射。孢子和粘稠液体喷洒而下，使地形更加危险。

你泛起一种奇特的感觉；你的手在发抖，仿佛在渴望触摸真菌，就像想再喝一杯。你加快脚步。

最后，你跃过了最后一个嘶嘶作响的菌卵，发现自己站在引擎室门前。

previousOriginal:
"We met the Children on Hybras. We sought to know each other. Wanted to go to the wood. Wanted to see what was kept from us." Percy is drooling as he speaks.

The gramophone clicks, as yet another patriotic dirge begins to play. Percy Blythe struggles in his bonds, pulling himself up to stand a little straighter. "We made contact on Hybras. The fungus was so bright, so beautiful." 

His eyes shine gold. "I brought it aboard, God forgive me. I wanted the crew to see. To know." 

Oil leaks from those hollow eyes. "I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. Some came willing. Others refused to join us. We had to—" He breaks off into silence, staring away into the middle distance.

previousTranslation:
“我们在海波拉遇到了孩子们。我们试图了解对方。想去森林里看看。想看看有什么东西被瞒着我们。 ”珀西边说边滴下口水。

留声机咔咔作响，又一首爱国的悲歌开始播放。珀西·布莱斯在束缚中挣扎着，把自己拉起来，站得更直一些。“我们和海波拉取得了联系。真菌是如此明亮，如此美丽。”

他的眼睛闪着金光。“我把它带上了车，上帝原谅我。我想让列车员们去看，去了解它们。”

珀西凹陷的双眼中漏出了油。“我很抱歉。我真的很抱歉。有些人愿意来。其他人拒绝加入我们。我们不得不……”他陷入了沉默，凝视着远方。

previousOriginal:
"Just don't let him give them any ideas," Amberley tells you. The Clay Conductor requests that they sing for him. The other Clay Men look reluctant, embarrassed even, but one with shale skin steps forward. "It has been too long. But we should still sing." 

Following his lead, the Clay Men launch into a mournful, hollow aria that resonates within your rib cage. Even Amberley Murgatroyd shivers as the last notes die away. 

The Clay Conductor is quiet for a long minute. At last, he gives his verdict. "No." He stomps away, back towards your engine.

previousTranslation:
“千万别让他说什么坏点子。”安布利对你说。粘土人列车主管请求他们为他唱歌。其他陶土人看起来很不情愿，甚至有些尴尬，但其中一个有着页岩皮肤的陶土人走上前。“已经太久了。但我们应该还能唱。”

在它的带领下，陶土人们开始了一段哀伤而空灵的咏叹调，那声音在你的胸腔内回响。即使是安布利·穆加托德，在最后一个音符消逝时也不禁打了个寒战。

粘土人列车主管沉默了许久。终于，他给出了评价：“不。”然后他跺着脚走开了，回到你们的机车那边。

previousOriginal: An encounter
currentOriginal: An encounter
previousTranslation: 一次邂逅

previousOriginal: You issue the order. Your engine, amidst its skirts of steam, lumbers around until the wastes are to the aft. The crew work briskly, and soon you are thundering back into less terrible spaces. In a moment of relief, someone blows the engine's whistle.
currentOriginal: You issue the order. Your engine, amidst its skirts of steam, lumbers around until the wastes are to the aft. The crew work briskly, and soon you are thundering back into less terrible spaces. In a moment of relief, someone blows the engine's whistle.
previousTranslation: 你下达了命令。你的机车环绕在蒸汽中，笨拙地挪动向前，直到荒漠被甩到车尾。列车员们利落地干活，你很快就轰隆隆地回到了不那么糟糕的地方。在这如释重负的时刻，不知是谁拉响了机车汽笛。

previousOriginal: They emerge, curious, from the caves. Once, they were dapper in pinstripe or delicate in brocade. Now, they wear rags. Their brocade has frayed; their pinstripe faded to porridgey grey.
currentOriginal: They emerge, curious, from the caves. Once, they were dapper in pinstripe or delicate in brocade. Now, they wear rags. Their brocade has frayed; their pinstripe faded to porridgey grey.
previousTranslation: 他们好奇地从洞穴里走出来。曾经，他们衣冠楚楚，身着细条纹衣服或精致的锦缎衣服。如今，他们衣衫褴褛。他们的锦缎已经磨损，细条纹衣服褪成了粥灰色。

previousOriginal: A spur of ice juts precipitously over the well. At the end of it sits a bandstand, worn by the wind. There, the devils sing their hymns.
currentOriginal: A spur of ice juts precipitously over the well. At the end of it sits a bandstand, worn by the wind. There, the devils sing their hymns.
previousTranslation: 一根冰刺从井口向内陡然伸出。在它的尽头，坐落着一个被狂风吹得破破烂烂的音乐台。在那里，魔鬼们唱着他们的赞美诗。

previousOriginal: He climbs from your engine, his caged bee tucked under his arm, and looks grimly around at the ice.
currentOriginal: He climbs from your engine, his caged bee tucked under his arm, and looks grimly around at the ice.
previousTranslation: 他从你的机车上爬下来，笼子里的蜜蜂被塞在他的胳膊下。他面无表情地看着周围的冰面。

previousOriginal: As she leaves your locomotive, the wind picks up. Her eyes retreat to opposing sides of her face to avoid the stinging particulate.
currentOriginal: As she leaves your locomotive, the wind picks up. Her eyes retreat to opposing sides of her face to avoid the stinging particulate.
previousTranslation: 当她离开你的机车时，狂风呼啸。她的双眼向后退到脸的两侧，以避开刺痛的颗粒物。

previousOriginal: Its vast jaw displays a row of yellowing fangs, sharp as chisels. Each is stubbornly rooted in the scarlet, glistening gum, and the beast's head itself is too huge to display. You settle instead for a long-fingered claw. It can hang in the engine room as a reminder of your victory – at least till the smell becomes intolerable.

You settle instead for a long-fingered claw. It can hang in the engine room as a reminder of your victory – at least till the smell becomes intolerable.
previousTranslation: 它巨大的下颚上陈列着一排发黄的尖牙，好似根根利凿。每一根都顽强地嵌在闪闪发光的猩红牙床中。而兽首本身过于巨大，无法展示。你转而选择了一根较长的爪指。它可以挂在引擎室里，昭示你的胜利——至少在它的气味变得不堪忍受前可以。

previousOriginal:
The shapeless idol looms over you. Someone has scratched jagged teeth around each of its holes, transforming them into many, many mouths.

A heavy hook is affixed into the stone, just higher than you can reach, while at the base of the idol, two depressions have been dug into the ice. The first holds a knout, with hooks knotted in its thongs. The second holds a buckled strap of something like leather.

previousTranslation: 一尊形状怪异的神像将你笼罩。它每一个孔洞的边缘都被人削刮成利齿状，变成了数不清的嘴。\n \n一只沉重的钩子固定在石头上，刚好让你够不着它。神像底部的冰面则被挖了两个浅坑。第一个盛着一根鞭节绑有钩子的鞭子。第二个盛着一条似乎由皮革制成的扣带。

previousOriginal:
The spine is thin, and passes easily between your metacarpals. Searing pain settles in your jaw. Your injured hand is as a graze: this is the anguish of profound sorrow. 

There is a scent of sweat, sharp like fear. The sound of a scream cut short. A crew – not yours – destroyed, punctured. (They had travelled far. Not far enough.) An Empyrean vessel, broken between rocks and the Fluke's bitterness. The crew, without time to don sky-suits, picked off one by one. (None knew of Axile. But someone must.) 

When you return to your locomotive your crew is flighty and unsettled. Finally, your navigator admits: "We could hear you screaming from here."
