previousTranslation:
脊刺细薄，轻易穿过你的掌骨。灼人痛苦在你的下颚部久聚不散。你受伤的手如被擦过：这是巨大悲哀带来的苦痛。

有一股汗味，锐若怖惧。被截断的一声尖叫。一位列车员——不是你的手下——被摧毁，被刺穿。（它们行得很远。但仍不够远。）一个灵魂，明亮而欢乐，被从一具疲惫不堪的旅者身中缓缓拖出。（她声称已预见到这一切。但她并没有。）一艘苍天上国的列车，破碎于岩石与锚虫的愤怒中。那些列车员，没时间穿上潜天装，一个接一个被刺下。（无人知晓阿克塞尔。但必须有人知晓。）

当返回你的机车时，你的列车员们显得惊慌不安。最后，你的领航员承认：“我们在这都能听见你的尖叫。”

previousOriginal: You need to pluck several spines to reach the buboes on the Scorn Fluke's skin. Once a space on the flesh is cleared, it's a simple task to slice a node open. The lumps ooze, dimly lit. The souls it collected are dull and inactive. It could not have learned anything of significance from them.
currentOriginal: You need to pluck several spines to reach the buboes on the Scorn Fluke's skin. One a space on the flesh is cleared, it's a simple task to slice a node open. The lumps ooze, dimly lit. The souls it collected are dull and inactive. It could not have learned anything of significance from them.
previousTranslation: 你需拔下几根刺才得以触到藐视锚虫的腺肿。当肉体上的一块空间被清理后，切开一团硬结便成为一个简单的任务。肿块缓渗，光线黯淡。它收集的灵魂皆呆滞迟钝。它不可能从他们身上学到任何有意义的东西。

previousOriginal:
The Fluke's blubber begins to deliquesce. Your sky-suited crew hurriedly cut several spines free with bolt cutters. 

You have them used to brace weakened points of the hull. Then you excuse the crew, so they can scrub themselves clean of the Fluke's rainbowed ichors.
currentOriginal:
The Fluke's blubber begins to deliquesce. Your sky-suited crew hurriedly cut several spines free with bolt cutters. 

You have them used to brace weakened points of the hull. Then you excuse the crew, so they can scrub themselves clean of the Fluke's rainbowed ichors.
previousTranslation:
那锚虫的兽脂已经开始溶解。身着潜天装的列车员们匆匆操起断线钳，截下了数根脊刺。

你命人用这些脊刺加固船体的薄弱部位。随后你便遣散了船员，好让他们洗净那些沾在身上、泛着虹彩的锚虫体液。

previousOriginal: The gelatinous flesh spasms; the broken spines rattle. Its piping grows doleful. The Fluke is dying.
currentOriginal: The gelatinous flesh spasms; the broken spines rattle. Its piping grows doleful. The Fluke is dying.
previousTranslation: 凝胶状的肉体阵阵痉挛；断裂开的脊刺咔咔作响。它的尖叫愈发悲沉。这锚虫正向死步去。

previousOriginal: As their numbers grow, the congregation becomes capable of ever-more sophisticated hymns. The winds rip at the devils. Their feet scuffle out sigils on the wooden boards.
currentOriginal: As their numbers grow, the congregation becomes capable of ever-more sophisticated hymns. The winds rip at the devils. Their feet scuffle out sigils on the wooden boards.
previousTranslation: 随着他们人数的增加，教会能够咏唱出越来越复杂的颂歌。狂风怒吼着扑向魔鬼。他们的脚在木板上划出道道符号。

previousOriginal:
The hymn is an ending-hymn. The Many-Mouthed was judged by the Regents in Gold, and cast into the well. His voices, all but the one he kept, 'were scattered to the hives'.  His followers – 'the horned and brazen' – grieved, then raged, then rebelled.  The Chain was broken.

The fate of the uprising is unstated, but the sigils are melancholy. There is reference to an exodus, to 'a time of serpents'. 

By the time the well is soothed, the devils are drained. They lean on each other as they stagger away. Has anyone else witnessed this, you wonder? Their holy of holies?
currentOriginal:
The hymn is an ending-hymn. The Many-Mouthed was judged by the Regents in Gold, and cast into the well. His voices, all but the one he kept, 'were scattered to the hives'.  His followers – 'the horned and brazen' – grieved, then raged, then rebelled.  The Chain was broken.

The fate of the uprising is unstated, but the sigils are melancholy. There is reference to an exodus, to 'a time of serpents'. 

By the time the well is soothed, the devils are drained. They lean on each other as they stagger away. Has anyone else witnessed this, you wonder? Their holy of holies?
previousTranslation:
这首颂歌是一首终曲。众口者被金袍摄政王审判，投入井中。他的声音，除了他保留的那个，其余“都被四散到蜂巢中”。他的追随者们——“那些有角的、黄铜般厚颜无耻的”——先是哀悼，然后愤怒，接着起义反抗。大锁链被打破了。

起义的结果并没有说明，但符号上满是忧郁。歌词中提到了流亡，提到了“蛇的时代”。

当井恢复平静时，魔鬼们已经筋疲力尽。他们互相搀扶着蹒跚离去。你思索着，还有其他人见证这一切吗？他们的圣地？

previousOriginal:
Returning to your engine, you spread your sketches across your bunk and instruct your crew that you are not to be disturbed. 

You have learned a great deal in your travels. You are sure the patterns of the devils' dance are a crude form of the Correspondence. The hymn itself, you think, is only inflection. By morning, you have assembled enough of a foundation to decipher the Devil's next service.
currentOriginal:
Returning to your engine, you spread your sketches across your bunk and instruct your crew that you are not to be disturbed. 

You have learned a great deal in your travels. You are sure the patterns of the devils' dance are a crude form of the Correspondence. The hymn itself, you think, is only  inflection. By morning, you have assembled enough of a foundation to decipher the Devil's next service.
previousTranslation: 回到机车后，你把你的草图铺在你的铺位上，并叫列车员们不要打扰你。\n\n你在旅途中学到了很多东西。你确信魔鬼的舞蹈模式是信符的一种粗略形式。而那赞歌，你认为只是语调变化。到了早上，你已经收集了足够多的信息，来为破译魔鬼的下一个服务打下基础。

previousOriginal:
This time, you suspect that the hymn's plainsong denotes a time long ago: that this hymn concerns a beginning. The dance recounts a tale of the Many-Mouthed. He... rebelled? No, too severe – campaigned, perhaps, or protested – against (and the sigils are ambiguous here) 'the Golden Rule'? You suspect that's not right.

The King of Carols 'objected through the withdrawal of his voice'. Because of this, 'the eyes were angry'. 

This is difficult. The well stills. The hymn stops. The dance ends.
currentOriginal:
This time, you suspect that the hymn's plainsong denotes a time long ago: that this hymn concerns a beginning. The dance recounts a tale of the Many-Mouthed. He... rebelled? No, too severe – campaigned, perhaps, or protested – against (and the sigils are ambiguous here) 'the Golden Rule'? You suspect that's not right.

The King of Carols 'objected through the withdrawal of his voice'. Because of this, 'the eyes were angry'. 

This is difficult. The well stills. The hymn stops. The dance ends.
previousTranslation:
这次，你怀疑这首颂歌的素歌象征着很久以前的时间：这首颂歌讲述了一个开端。舞蹈讲述了多嘴者的故事。他……反抗了吗？不，太严重了——也许是竞选，也许是抗议——“金律”（这里的符号很模糊）？你怀疑这不对。

颂歌之王“通过撤回他的声音表示反对”。正因为如此，“眼睛们都很愤怒”。

这首颂歌很难。井安歇了。颂歌停止了。舞蹈结束了。

previousOriginal: His work is striking. In each piece, he takes his muse's perfect features – her delicate lips, her impeccable nose, her amber eyes, the parabolic arches of her eyebrows – and arranges them in impossible configurations upon her face. In A Study in Solemnity one of her eyes gazes at you from the centre of her forehead. In To Muse at Midnight her mouth splays diagonally across a cheek.
currentOriginal: His work is striking. In each piece, he takes his muse's perfect features – her delicate lips, her impeccable nose, her amber eyes, the parabolic arches of her eyebrows – and arranges them in impossible configurations upon her face. In A Study in Solemnity one of her eyes gazes at you from the centre of her forehead. In To Muse at Midnight her mouth splays diagonally across a cheek.
previousTranslation: 他的作品引人注目。在每件作品中，他把他的缪斯女神的完美特征，她精致的嘴唇，无可挑剔的鼻子，琥珀色的眼睛，眉弓的弧度，都以奇异的构造排列在她脸上。\n\n在庄严的研究中，她的一只眼睛从她额头的中心凝视着你。在致午夜缪斯中，她的嘴在脸颊上斜张着。

previousOriginal: Each depicts his muse (who is, people speculate, his mistress) in a different pose or tableaux, and is prefixed Portrait of a Devil.
currentOriginal: Each depicts his muse (who is, people speculate, his mistress) in a different pose or tableaux, and is prefixed Portrait of a Devil.
previousTranslation: 每幅作品都以不同的姿势或场景描绘了他的缪斯女神（人们猜测她是他的情妇），并以魔鬼肖像为前缀。

previousOriginal: She arches an eyebrow. The eyebrow in question is making its way towards the very middle of her face.
currentOriginal: She arches an eyebrow. The eyebrow in question is making its way towards the very middle of her face.
previousTranslation: 她挑起一边眉毛。所谓的眉毛正向她的脸的最中间移去。

previousOriginal:
Curled sigils scintillate across the glass. The imprints flow like spilt wine, each symbol lights a fire behind your eyes like the afterglow of a sunset. The last few sigils are isolated, discrete, and each has impacted on the Throne like the descent of a comet.

You record what you can before your vision is lost to the smoking after-images of the language of the stars.
currentOriginal:
Curled sigils scintillate across the glass. The imprints flow like spilt wine, each symbol lights a fire behind your eyes like the afterglow of a sunset. The last few sigils are isolated, discrete, and each has impacted on the Throne like the descent of a comet.

You record what you can before your vision is lost to the smoking after-images of the language of the stars.
previousTranslation:
蜷曲的符印在玻璃间闪烁着。压痕如被泼洒的酒般奔流，每一个符号都在你的眼后点起一把火焰，恰似落日余辉。最后的几个符印位置四散，且每一个都对王座有着如彗星陨落般的影响。

在你的视力被群星之语言所烙下的图像完全焚毁之前，你尽你所能地记录下看到的东西。

previousOriginal: Examine the Throne
currentOriginal: Examine the Throne
previousTranslation: 检查王座

previousOriginal:
The postal officer bites his lower lip. "It's the topic of choice here! 'Where's Langley?' 'Have you seen Langley?'" He sighs. "Anyone who says they know the answer is lying. But if you want a place to start looking, when he was with us, he favoured a particular chair in the Lounge. An old friend of his is still in the Yellow Drawing Room. And he was on good terms with the cook."

He considers you for a moment. "What if he doesn't want to be found? What if, wherever he is, he doesn't want to come back?"
currentOriginal:

But if you want a place to start looking, when he was with us, he favoured a particular chair in the Lounge. An old friend of his is still in the Yellow Drawing Room. previousTranslation:
前台咬着下唇。“这是这里的首选话题！‘兰利在哪里？’‘你见过兰利吗？’” 他叹了口气。“任何声称自己知道答案的人都在撒谎。但我可以给你提供几个线索。早些时候，当他和我们在一起时，他钟情于休息室里一张特别的椅子。他的一个老朋友现在还待在黄色客厅里。他还和这里的厨师关系很好。”

他考虑了一会儿。“如果他不想被找到呢？如果，不管身处何处，他都不想回来呢？”

previousOriginal: You can hear hushed whispers and the rustle of papers. There is a smell of pipe smoke.
currentOriginal: You can hear hushed whispers and the rustle of papers. There is a smell of pipe smoke.
previousTranslation: 你可以听到沙哑的私语和文件的沙沙声。一股烟斗的味道。

previousOriginal: It is time to find Lord Langley.
currentOriginal: It is time to find Lord Langley.
previousTranslation: 是时候去找兰利勋爵了。

previousOriginal: There are many, many staircases. But you have a large and hardy crew.
currentOriginal: There are many, many staircases. But you have a large and hardy crew.
previousTranslation: 那里有很多、很多的楼梯。但你有一大帮结实的列车员。

previousOriginal: Your crew return, flush with tales of guests met by chance on landings; of humorous encounters between your more hapless crew and beauties met by candlelight in the attics or the cellars. A navigator has made a map of their progress; new passages found, routes through the labyrinth of stairwells.
currentOriginal: Your crew return, flush with tales of guests met by chance on landings; of humorous encounters between your more hapless crew and beauties met by candlelight in the attics or the cellars. A navigator has made a map of their progress; new passages found, routes through the labyrinth of stairwells.
previousTranslation: 你的列车员们带着岸上偶遇的客人们的故事回来了：倒霉列车员在阁楼或地窖的烛光下和美人相遇的滑稽遭遇。一名领航员绘制了他们的行进地图：数个新发现的，能让人通过迷宫般楼梯间的通路。

previousOriginal: The coals pop as you shove them to one side. The neat stack of fuel collapses, sending a wave of heat towards you. Your face and arms are slick with sweat. But, there, just at the back, you can make out a sigil, burning brighter than the smouldering coals.
currentOriginal: The coals pop as you shove them to one side. The neat stack of fuel collapses, sending a wave of heat towards you. Your face and arms are slick with sweat. But, there, just at the back, you can make out a sigil, burning brighter than the smouldering coals.
previousTranslation: 炭火在你拨弄时啪嗒作响，你推开它们。整齐的燃料堆塌了，一阵热浪向你袭来。你的脸和手臂都被汗水浸湿了。但就在那儿，就在后面，你能看清一个符印，它比冒烟的炭火还要明亮。

previousOriginal:
You find yourself enveloped in a bag of upsettingly-hued scarves that topples from a shelf somewhere high above you. They gather about your neck like snakes, and are the very devil to untangle. 

There is a sudden terrible odour, and the scarves loosen. A very very intoxicated man is leaning against a shelf, while his armada of giant stinking goats set to devouring your scarves. It seems wise to remain very, very still. 

Eventually, the last thread has disappeared into a goat, and mercifully, the horrible hell-beasts retreat. The man staggers forward, embraces you, clumsily places something into your pocket, and wanders away.

previousTranslation:
你发现自己被一袋从头顶某个架子上掉下来的，令人心烦意乱的围巾裹住了。它们像蛇一样缠在你的脖子上，想解开它们是难上加难。

突然飘来一股难闻的气味，围巾也松开了。一个喝得酩酊大醉的男人正倚在架子上，而他那群散发着臭味的巨大山羊正准备吞食你的围巾。保持不动似乎是明智之举。

最终，最后一根线消失在山羊嘴里，谢天谢地，这些可怕的地狱野兽离开了。那个人踉踉跄跄地走过来拥抱你，笨拙地把什么东西放进你的口袋，然后游荡去了别处。

previousOriginal: You attempt to leave. You really do. You're up from the armchair and almost at the door, and then you hear the chiming of the second hour and you're back in the chair. Did someone give you a glass of wine? Did someone stoke the fire? Did Signora Domenica promise to show you another trick with the mirrors? You can't remember.
currentOriginal: You attempt to leave. You really do. You're up from the armchair and almost at the door, and then you hear the chiming of the second hour and you're back in the chair. Did someone give you a glass of wine? Did someone stoke the fire? Did Signora Domenica promise to show you another trick with the mirrors? You can't remember.
previousTranslation: 你尝试离开。你真的试过了。你从扶手椅上站起来，几乎到了门口，然后你听到让你再停留一个小时的报时声，你又回到了椅子上。有人给你一杯酒吗？有人给你添火了吗？多米妮卡夫人有没有说过要给你看另一个关于镜子的把戏？你不记得了。

previousOriginal:
It would be best were your investigation not scrutinised. You wait for the opportune moment, when enough of the guests are drowsing, wine-sodden and languid, to creep to the chair. It is a high-backed velvet horror that resembles a bat turned inside out. It creaks damnably if you so much as brush against it. 

It requires a steady hand and limitless concentration to fish around the crevices. You find coinage, crumbs and dust. The springs are damnable; the patterning lamentable. Finally, your hands hook around— What's this? A map. A map directing you to the Study.

previousTranslation:
最好不要在别人都能注意到你的时候进行调查。你等待着时机，当足够多的客人昏昏欲睡，酒气熏天，无精打采的时候，你就溜到椅子旁边。那是一张令人感到畏惧的高背天鹅绒椅，看上去像一只被翻过来的蝙蝠。如果用手去碰它，它就会发出可恶的嘎吱声。

需要一只稳定的手和无限的注意力，才能在缝隙中摸索。你发现了硬币、碎屑和灰尘。弹簧令人憎恶；图案令人悲哀。最后，你摸到了——这是什么？一张地图。一张指引你去书房的地图。

previousOriginal: The Little Lounge
currentOriginal: The Little Lounge
previousTranslation: 小休息室

previousOriginal: Bottles crash and shatter on the tiles as space is cleared by the sinks for your recital. Eager hands lift you to perch upon the porcelain; your toes dip into the wine sluicing about the sink. Eyes bright with intoxication gaze up at you. You rhapsodise on the themes dearest to the hearts of Langley Hall's guests: companionship, mutability, refuge. Your verse might be slurred, but you fire up your audience as easily as stoking a boiler. They adore you.

previousTranslation: 水槽旁碍事的玻璃瓶被一把扫到瓷砖上，摔得粉碎。渴望的双手把你抬到瓷制浴缸里，水槽里涌出的酒液淹没的你的脚趾。醉醺醺的眼睛注视着你。 你以狂想曲的形式叙述着对兰利厅的客人们最关心的主题：陪伴、无常、庇护。你的诗句可能含糊不清，但你像点燃锅炉一样轻松点燃了观众的热情。他们崇拜你。

previousOriginal: Consider the evidence
currentOriginal: Consider the evidence
previousTranslation: 考虑目前收集到的证据

previousOriginal:
The pair are only too glad to accommodate your questions about their toy, which is revealed to be a spectacularly well-shaped, well-mannered pangolin. 

Despite their assurances that the animal consents to the peculiar treatment, the pangolin looks distressed. It takes several hours, two games of catch, an inadvisable amount of alcohol, and the discovery of a rattan ball in an unexplored cupboard to free the pangolin from its elegant captors.

previousTranslation:
二人非常乐意回答你关于他们玩具的问题。它其实是一只体型圆润、性情温顺的穿山甲。

尽管他们保证穿山甲同意了这种特殊的对待，但后者看起来却很痛苦。你历经好几个小时，两场传球游戏，多到不明智的酒精，还在没打开过的柜子里发现了一个藤球，才把穿山甲从这对优雅的绑架者手中救了出来。

previousOriginal:
Something is very wrong with this Scorn Fluke.

For one, it possesses an eye, red-veined as though it had spent eons in ceaseless lamentation. The Scorn Fluke, its species usually possessed by a jagged geometry, looks diseased, its body warped and weeping with cancers, cysts of unnatural dimensions. 

Aberration that it might be, the Scorn Fluke remains a primordial revelation, ancient and so steeped in anguish that the air itself twists in commiseration. This isn't pain as mortals might know it, but something almost holy in its vastness, an entire cosmology of suffering contorted into a being.

previousTranslation:
这只藐视锚虫身上有什么不对劲。

举例说，它有一只眼，其内结膜脉络充血赤红，好似它已在无休止的哀痛中度过了千万载岁月。那藐视锚虫，它的种族通常拥有着锯齿般的几何形状，显得病态，它的身体则扭曲且因毒瘤而流脓，带着非自然尺寸的囊肿。

这可能十分反常，但那藐视锚虫仍是一种原始的启示，古老而如此浸溺于苦痛，以至空气自身已在对其的同情中震颤。这并非那类凡俗或可理解的疼痛，而是于自身的广大无垠中某种几近神圣的事物，如一整个宇宙所受的创痛被尽数扭曲作一种存在。

previousOriginal:
You bring your arms down hard. Suddenly, your body is rocketing up through the Mists. Before long, you're in the cold, drowning air. A quartet of cultists stand at the shore. Two of them are middle-aged and slightly plump, the third acne-riddled, and the fourth is nothing but a wreath of green tentacles.

"Did you succeed?"

When you shake your head, they shrug in good-natured unison.

previousTranslation:
你用力下拉手臂。突然间，你的身体火箭般飞升穿过迷雾。没多久，你就进入了冰冷的、如同溺水般的空气中。四个邪教徒站在岸边。其中两个是中年人，稍显丰满，第三个遍体生疮，第四个只是圈绿色的触手。

“你成功了吗？”

当你摇头时，他们一齐温和地耸了耸肩。

previousOriginal: Discounting the damage done in the battle, the dreadnought is orderly and clean. The crew had little in the way of personal effects. Only in the captain's cabin do you find an unexpected lockbox. It contains a consignment of souls. Not common souls, either; they would blaze brightly if everything were not already flooded with brightness. According to a set of orders so terse as to be practically opaque, they were bound for Sky Barnet.

蝙蝠递交于你时，那双小眼直直望来，小嘴还尖声吱叫。它的瞳孔闪亮，有如切割后的碧玺，目光炯炯，难以直视。才对视了几眼，你便只得移开视线。

"Old ground. Hunting ground. When wings spread free and soared, and we were indigo in tooth and claw." Are those teeth you can see below the hood? "When the skies were young. When we were young. Our bargains were savage, our hunts were sacred, we lifted all wings, our appetites naked."

"All gone now. Things change. Time takes all."

“如今全没了，都变了。时间能带走一切。”

你挤回酒店，看到房间里的每个位诗人都对着隐姓埋名的公主欢呼，试图找到能准确描绘她完美境界的对句。

她说：“现在不那么忧郁了，我的悲情韵者们！”她鼓励地朝诗人挥手，“你们可以找到那些词语。如果在英语里找不到，或许在更天体一点的语言里？”片刻之后，他们找到了一种语言，其形状听起来不似任何人类能理解的颜色。他们欢快地四处奔走起来。

一个诗人的舌头被点燃了。然后是另一个。然后是第三个。很快，每个诗人都有满嘴火焰，他们仍然没有停止。公主站在这场大火的中心，笑颜如花。

这症状似乎会传染。该跑了。

previousOriginal: That's enough of poets and princesses for now.
currentOriginal: That's enough of poets and princesses for now.
previousTranslation: 诗人和公主的事已经让人受够了。

previousOriginal: You're committed now.
currentOriginal: You're committed now.
previousTranslation: 你已承诺。

previousOriginal: Its fur is soft and sleek. Its eyes are gently mournful. It is fat and round and succulent.
currentOriginal: Its fur is soft and sleek. Its eyes are gently mournful. It is fat and round and succulent.
previousTranslation: 它的皮毛柔软而光滑。它的眼睛温柔又哀伤。它肥大，圆润，多汁。

previousOriginal: It stares at you, drooling with love. When you meet its gaze, its vast tail wags, dusting your wash things from the sink onto the floor.
currentOriginal: It stares at you, drooling with love. When you meet its gaze, its vast tail wags, dusting your wash things from the sink onto the floor.
previousTranslation: 它盯着你，流着口水，满眼爱意。当你与它对视时，它巨大的尾巴摇晃着，把你的洗漱用品从水槽里掸到地上。

previousOriginal: A smell of baking wafts through your locomotive.
currentOriginal: A smell of baking wafts through your locomotive.
previousTranslation: 一股烤饼的味道在你的机车上萦绕。

previousOriginal: The Ratty Reunion has made a mess of your galley. Straw, bits of blanket and patches from damaged uniforms have been gathered into a makeshift nest. In contrast: tiny notebooks, battered derringers, and hipflasks – that are not as small as you might expect – are stored with care, stacked in a corner away from prying hands.
currentOriginal: The Ratty Reunion has made a mess of your galley. Straw, bits of blanket and patches from damaged uniforms have been gathered into a makeshift nest. In contrast: tiny notebooks, battered derringers, and hipflasks – that are not as small as you might expect – are stored with care, stacked in a corner away from prying hands.
previousTranslation: 团聚的鼠群把你的厨房弄得一团糟。稻草、碎毛毯和破损制服的补丁被收拢进临时的栖身之窝里。相比之下：小笔记本、破旧不堪的手枪和烧瓶——它们并不像你想象的那么小——被小心地存放在角落，远离觊觎之手。

previousOriginal:
"That," says the Defiant Devil, "contains one of the King of Carols. It will go on singing in that gloomy way for as long as you permit."

He glances away and pretends to go back to his work, but you have seen it, just for a moment: appetite, curiosity. He is a scientist of sorts, after all.
currentOriginal:
"That," says the Repentant Devil, "contains one of the King of Carols. It will go on singing in that gloomy way for as long as you permit."

He glances away and pretends to go back to his work, but you have seen it, just for a moment: appetite, curiosity. He is a scientist of sorts, after all.
previousTranslation:
“那里，”叛逆的魔鬼说，“关着一只颂歌之王。只要你允许，它就会永远这样阴郁地歌唱。”

他调转视线，装作回去工作的样子，但你已经看到了，仅仅一瞬间：兴趣，好奇心。他毕竟勉强算是位科学家。

previousOriginal: You have come this far without suffering.
currentOriginal: You have come this far without suffering.
previousTranslation: 你没有受苦而走到了这里。

previousOriginal:
[qvd:137423(DealAccepted)] It disappears behind the crossroad post.  As you return to your locomotive, the quarters are a little quieter. Several faces are absent. They must have disembarked suddenly, perhaps. The Measurer has taken a down payment.

In your own cabin, you find a gnarled black-wood box placed neatly upon your pillow. Within, a wealth of Navaratine gemstones, blood-red in the candlelight.

在你的小隔间里，你发现一只扭曲的黑木盒子整齐地放在枕头上。盒子里，是满满当当的曩缚咤宝石，在烛光下呈现出血红色。

previousOriginal:
Prisons are forbidden in Pan. Instead, those who aggrieve other citizens too persistently are branded with the Calf-sign. 

Then, during the Hour of Trumpets, the Brazen Brigade hunt. Their quarry is supposedly only those bearing the Calf-sign, but when the devils' blood is up they don't always discriminate.

previousTranslation:
潘城禁止监狱的存在。那些持续侵害其他公民的人会被烙上小牛的标志。

然后，在号角之时，黄铜大队开始狩猎。他们的猎物据说只有那些带有小牛标志的人，但当魔鬼的血液沸腾时，他们并不总是在乎这个区别。

previousOriginal: The Empyreals are waiting for you in the galley, which they have fortified with overturned tables and chairs. Your crew is unable to break through their line, and as you begin to take casualties you have no choice but to sound the withdrawal.
currentOriginal: The Empyreals are waiting for you in the galley, which they have fortified with overturned tables and chairs. Your crew is unable to break through their line, and as you begin to take casualties you have no choice but to sound the withdrawal.
previousTranslation: 上国人在他们用打翻的桌子和椅子加固了的厨房里等着你。你的列车员无法突破他们的防线，当身边开始出现伤亡的时候，你别无选择，只能撤退。

previousOriginal:
You work with a chisel, jamming it under the stones and prying them out. They glisten, wetly, their colours dark and sullen. 

All the time you listen to the laboured pumping of the Undeparted's lungs, working like bellows even though they are no longer connected to a throat or a mouth. You pry another eye free. If it is still alive, can that eye still watch you?

previousTranslation:
你用凿子工作，击打石头的下方，把它们撬出来。它们发出水般的光泽，颜色漆黑而阴郁。

在你做这些事情的时候，你听见形影不离的肺部艰难地抽动，像风箱一样工作，尽管它们不再与喉咙或嘴巴相连。你又撬下一只眼睛。如果它还活着，那只眼睛是否还看着你？

previousOriginal: You crew set reluctantly to work. The bonesaws sing.
currentOriginal: You crew set reluctantly to work. The bonesaws sing.
previousTranslation: 你的列车员不情愿地开始工作。骨锯在唱歌。

previousOriginal: You crew set reluctantly to work. The bonesaws sing.

previousTranslation: 你的列车员不情愿地开始工作。骨锯在唱歌。

previousOriginal:
Rather than soil your engine with viscera, you perform your investigation out in the sky. The Griever's stomach is impossibly cavernous, but a smaller organ attached to it – about the size of a pig ready for the butcher's block – seems swollen. 

Cutting through the muscled membrane, you find gemstones rattling inside like a pocketful of gallstones. Hello. What are you doing here?

previousTranslation:
你选择在天空中进行调查，而不是用它的内脏弄脏你的机车。哀恸者的胃令人难以置信地空空如也，但连接在旁边的一个较小的器官——差不多是能进屠宰场的猪的大小——似乎满满当当。

割开这层肌肉膜，你发现里面的宝石像一袋胆结石一样叮当作响。你好。你们在这里做什么？

previousOriginal:
He must occupy a senior position, for the other gardeners nod their heads as they pass him. 

Beneath his overalls he wears a ratskin suit, ragged from the plants' playful thorns. There is a deadness to his gaze.
currentOriginal:
He must occupy a senior position, for the other gardeners nod their heads as they pass him. 

Beneath his overalls he wears a ratskin suit, ragged from the plants' playful thorns. There is a deadness to his gaze.
previousTranslation:
从其他园丁经过他时都会点头致意来看，他一定身居高位。

工作服下面，他穿着鼠皮套装，上面被植物的刺划得破破烂烂。他的眼神一片死寂。

previousOriginal: She is said to be working on an experimental engine somewhere on the Berrenger.
currentOriginal: She is said to be working on an experimental engine somewhere on the Berrenger.
previousTranslation: 据说她正在贝伦格上开发某个实验性引擎。

previousOriginal: You hook your mask by the door on the way out.
currentOriginal: You hook your mask by the door on the way out.
previousTranslation: 你离开时把面具挂在了门边。

previousOriginal: The Marauders are those who defy – or have been excluded from – Albion's authority. Leaderless raiders, homeless exiles, pirates, dissidents, and criminals.
currentOriginal: The Marauders are those who defy – or have been excluded from – Albion's authority. Leaderless raiders, homeless exiles, pirates, dissidents, and criminals.
previousTranslation: 掠夺者是那些蔑视或被排除在阿尔比恩的权威之外的人。没有领导的袭击者、无家可归的流亡者、海盗、持不同政见者和罪犯。

previousOriginal:
You search turns up an array of valuables retrieved from the dead. Cuff-links and brooches. Rings (wedding, engagement, signet,and ear). Tie-pins and hair-pins. Gold-rimmed spectacles and silver-plated belt buckles. 

You also find a cupboard full of skulls. Memento mori for the death-haunted aristocracy of Albion.
currentOriginal:
You search turns up an array of valuables retrieved from the dead. Cuff-links and brooches. Rings (wedding, engagement, signet,and ear). Tie-pins and hair-pins. Gold-rimmed spectacles and silver-plated belt buckles. 

You also find a cupboard full of skulls. Memento mori for the death-haunted aristocracy of Albion.
previousTranslation: 你找到了一堆从死者身上拿走的贵重物品。袖扣和胸针。戒指（婚礼、订婚、徽章和耳饰）。领带夹和发夹。金边眼镜和镀银皮带扣。\n\n你还发现了一个装满头骨的柜子。这是阿尔比恩死后贵族们的死亡警示物。

previousOriginal: You open a barred door to find a frozen cabin. The windows have been shattered, exposing it to the heavens' cold in an attempt to preserve a set of cadavers: two young, two older – perhaps a family? A set of bell-jars, filled with murky oil, contain organs.
currentOriginal: You open a barred door to find a frozen cabin. The windows have been shattered, exposing it to the heavens' cold in an attempt to preserve a set of cadavers: two young, two older – perhaps a family? A set of bell-jars, filled with murky oil, contain organs.
previousTranslation: 你打开一扇锁着的门，发现一间被冰冻的舱室。窗户破碎，在天空的寒冷中保存着一组尸体：两个年轻的，两个年长的，也许是一个家庭？一组钟形的罐子里充满了混浊的油，里面装着器官。

previousOriginal: Quick work with the hacksaw detaches the cloak, exposing the spine, which bristles with parchment. You gather what you can: litanies of dead conjunctions; locations of destroyed libraries; compendiums of the myths of the stars.
currentOriginal: Quick work with the hacksaw detaches the cloak, exposing the spine, which bristles with parchment. You gather what you can: litanies of dead conjunctions; locations of destroyed libraries; compendiums of the myths of the stars.
previousTranslation: 钢锯将斗篷利落地解开，露出布满羊皮纸的鬃毛。你收集一切你能收集到的信息：死亡合相的连祷文、被毁坏的图书馆的位置、星体神话的概要。

previousOriginal:
Once, the Senior Scrivener was an ancient servitor of the stars, feared among even its own kind.

Now, it is broken, and hangs haphazardly in the sky like a puppet whose strings have been cut.
currentOriginal:
Once, the Senior Scrivener was an ancient servitor of the stars, feared among even its own kind.

Now, it is broken, and hangs haphazardly in the sky like a puppet whose strings have been cut.
previousTranslation: 曾经，高级纺书人是群星的古老仆役，甚至受到其同类的敬畏。\n\n现在，它被打碎了，像一个被剪断线的木偶，胡乱地挂在天空中。

previousOriginal:
Leaves of bronze hue crunch beneath your boots as you enter the grove. Some of the giant trees have fallen and are partially sunken into the ground. They are the easiest targets. Your crew set to work with hacksaw and hewer, while you supervise. Brass-coloured leaves crackle like fire beneath your boots.

The wind sets the trees groaning and shuddering. Your crew are eager to be away. They swiftly gather chunks of wood and make ready to return to camp.
currentOriginal:
Leaves of bronze hue crunch beneath your boots as you enter the grove. Some of the giant trees have fallen and are partially sunken into the ground. They are the easiest targets. Your crew set to work with hacksaw and hewer, while you supervise. Brass-coloured leaves crackle like fire beneath your boots.

The wind sets the trees groaning and shuddering. Your crew are eager to be away. They swiftly gather chunks of wood make ready to return to camp.
previousTranslation: 进入树林，铜色的树叶在靴子下嘎吱作响。几棵大树已经倒下，部分陷入地面。它们是最容易处理的目标。你的列车员上前用钢锯和砍刀工作，而你则在一旁监督。黄铜色的树叶在你的靴子下像火一样噼啪作响。\n\n风吹得树木呻吟颤抖。你的列车员们渴望离开。他们迅速收集木块，准备返回营地。

previousOriginal:
Before you hear a word more!
[Your crew will follow your lead. But their haste will cause mistakes.]
currentOriginal:
Before you hear a word more!
[Your crew will follow your lead. But their haste will cause mistakes.]
previousTranslation: 赶在你听到任何词之前！\n[你的列车员会听你的指挥。但是他们的匆忙会导致错误。]

previousOriginal:
A rope, strong arms, and the threat of rain hurry proceedings along. You soon have a makeshift bridge across the bog. You shouldn't have to touch the foul grey water at all.

You and your crew make it across without incident. They seem amazed that nobody died. They almost certainly don't mean it as a slight on your abilities.
currentOriginal:

You and your crew make it across without incident. They seem amazed that nobody died. They almost certainly don't mean it as a slight on your abilities.
previousTranslation: 一根绳子，有力的臂膀，随后即将下雨的征兆又加快了进程。很快你就拥有了一座横跨沼泽的临时桥梁。你根本不必碰那肮脏的灰水。\n\n你与你的列车员顺利通过了沼泽。他们似乎对无人死亡感到惊讶。他们绝对不是在轻视你的能力。

previousOriginal:
The wood extends for miles, but so too does the bog. It is hours before you find a passable clearing. A glade of emerald hue, nestled between a copse of silver trees that shiver and sigh like consumptives.

Your crew follow your lead, hanging close by your torchlight. You keep up a count, checking the numbers of your crew as you go. 

Not everyone leaves the silvered wood.

几个小时后，你才找到一块可通行的空地。那是一片翠绿色的林间空地，坐落在一片银色的树林之间，树木如同肺痨病患者般颤抖叹息。

你的列车员紧靠着火把跟随你。你继续计数，一边走一边检查列车员数量。

并不是所有人都能离开这片银色森林的。

previousOriginal:
You walk in circles. Rain comes, falls, goes again. The sky wheels overhead. You hear the voices of your crew in the woods. For a time, you follow them.

They lead you through bog and bramble, through glade and grove and grave. Do you see them in the wood? Do they speak to you? Do they sing to you? Do you remember their names?

Yes. Of course you do. You wouldn't have carved them onto the hull of your locomotive otherwise. You look down, your fingers raw and bloody. You have escaped the wood.

previousTranslation:
你在兜圈子。雨来了，落了，又走了。天空在头顶旋转。你听到你的列车员在树林里的声音。

他们带领你穿过沼泽和荆棘，穿过小树林和坟墓。你在树林里看到他们了吗？他们对你说话吗？他们对你唱歌吗？你记得他们的名字吗？

你当然记得。否则你就不会把它们刻在你的机车车体上。低头看，你的手指受伤流血。你已经逃出了树林。

previousOriginal: You cannot afford to risk yourself. Mockery won't make you reckless.
currentOriginal: You cannot afford to risk yourself. Mockery won't make you reckless.
previousTranslation: 你不能冒险。嘲笑声并不会使你变得鲁莽。

previousOriginal: You have the seals.
currentOriginal: You have the seals.
previousTranslation: 你拿到了印章。

previousOriginal:
You find the Navigator in a quiet corridor to the rear of the engine. He is staring out of the window. When you speak, he jumps. "D__n! Oh! Sorry, Captain – I thought I was alone."

He takes you back to his cabin. It is tidy. His desk is empty but for a fresh journal. His clothes are neatly folded on his footlocker. Altan's body lies on his bed. The body wears only the garments it wore in the graveyard.

"We have one last journey to make. One last adventure. It'll be an ending fit for King Gesar himself. I want to take Altan to Death's Door."

previousTranslation:
你在机车后的一个安静的走廊里找到了领航员，他正凝视着窗外。当你开口的时候，他吓了一跳：“__死的！哦！对不起，车长——我以为只有我一个人。”

他带你回他的车厢。房间里很整洁，桌面空空荡荡，只有一本新的日记本。衣服放在提箱上，叠得整整齐齐。阿尔坦的尸体躺在床上，仍然穿着它的殓服。

“我们还有最后一段旅程，最后一次冒险，作为格萨尔王的结局再合适不过。我想带阿尔坦去死亡之门。”

previousOriginal: It would be unkind to intrude their privacy at such a time. You could peruse the photos in the hallway.
currentOriginal: It would be unkind to intrude their privacy at such a time. You could peruse the photos in the hallway.
previousTranslation: 在这种时候侵犯他们的隐私是不礼貌的。你可以在走廊里仔细看看这些照片。

previousOriginal: "I need a cat. I will not catch one for you." She scowls. "And once you have one, you better keep an eye on it. I don't like the gossiping little things – they are too fond of scandal to be trustworthy."

previousOriginal:
You order your crew to scour the docks with a fishing net and that rumour about the state of the Captivating Princess' latest admirer. It is not long before the indignant sound of hissing announces their partial success. They have a cat, but a thoroughly clawed stoker has resigned on the spot. Miss Peppercorn directs a crewmember to deposit the thrashing bundle before the mirror. The caught cat only stills when it catches sight of its own reflection.

The reflection shows a tiger, sitting among the tatters of a flimsy fishing net. Behind it is a steaming, amber-lit jungle. The tiger claws its way free of the final strands, steps closer— With a scornful yowl, the cat steps into the mirror.

The Fortunate Navigator gasps. Miss Peppercorn beams.

previousTranslation:
你命令列车员们带着渔网和关于迷人公主的最新仰慕者状况的谣言来搜寻码头。不久，愤怒的哈气声宣告他们取得了部分的成功。他们捉住了一只猫，但一位满身爪伤的司炉当场辞职了。派伯康小姐命令领航员把那被缠住的东西放到镜子前。被抓住的猫一看见自己的倒影，就静止不动了。

镜子里有一只老虎，坐在破破烂烂的渔网中。老虎身后是一片水汽升腾，弥漫琥珀色光芒的丛林。老虎用爪子挣开最后的几根绳索，走近了——猫咪发出一声轻蔑的嚎叫，走入镜中。

走运的领航员倒吸一口气。派伯康小姐笑容满面。

previousOriginal: He'd be casting Altan into the tumultuous throes of frenzied time. And it would be tremendously dangerous to get there. That's an adventure itself.

previousOriginal:
Glancing from side to side, you kneel and bow and wave your hands at the appropriate times, like a newcomer at a dance-class. 

The tall spirit seems to find your efforts satisfactory. In moments, it turns the corner and is gone. All around you, spirits clamber to their feet and resume their business.

previousOriginal: The risk is too great.
currentOriginal: The risk is too great.
previousTranslation: 风险太大。

previousOriginal:
What do you have here? It's... a rag. But in your hands, with a bit of invention, it becomes the remnant of the shroud of a long-dead Queen, who passed this way centuries ago. Someone with good eyesight could still pick out the words of a blessing woven into the fabric. You're not surprised he can't make it out: the language is an obscure one, known only to the very learned. You should have known he wouldn't recognise its value...

He practically snatches it from you in the end, paying you in gemstones and indignant looks.

previousOriginal: You and the crew chip chunks of gleaming stones from the shell. Some shine like quartz. Some glisten, banded like tiger's eye. Some are deep and solemn as polished jade.

previousOriginal:
Your decision is made. Your would-be extorters depart.

previousOriginal:
The Administrator takes a single bored glance at your Testament before stuffing it into a drawer. "Begin with the Sixty-fourth Petition for Penumbral Consideration to wet your palate, then you can move on to the less interesting applications," she says with immense relish, stacking wax tablets in a teetering pile. "If your hand starts to cramp, I can fetch one bucket of ice. But you must return the ice."

Several miles of engraving later, you are finished. "Your entry permission expires in one month," she says, stamping a certificate and handing it to you.

I should tell you what happens when a Workworld really goes wrong."

previousOriginal:
Within its mask, the shade's eyes cloud, dry, and harden to globes of salt. Its limbs stiffen. In another heartbeat, the spirit is nothing but a glistening statue. 

The salt that comprises it cannot bear its own weight. Cracks split across it. Limbs break away, shattering into chunks when they strike the floor. Fingers crumble and snap. Soon, all that is left is a mound of white salt.

With the spirit gone, what becomes of the black box is irrelevant. The matter of Captain Whitlock's legacy is rendered moot.

previousTranslation:
在面具之下，遗魂的眼睛变得浑浊、干涩，并且硬化成了盐球。它的四肢也变得僵硬。再一眨眼，这鬼魂就只剩下一座闪闪发光的雕像了。

构成雕像的盐无法承受自身的重量。裂缝在雕像上蔓延开来。四肢断裂，落到地上时碎成了块。手指也碎成了渣。很快，就只剩下一堆白色的盐了。

随着鬼魂的消失，黑盒子的去向已经无关紧要了。惠特洛克车长的遗产也变得毫无意义。

在被光芒吞没的深处，有着不可名状的庞大的轮状物，像海洋一样巨大，以一种不可阻挡的势头转动着。在它们之间，你瞥见某些不定形的异常的东西，像你的肢体一般，以完美无缺的精确度执行着不可言喻的工作。扭曲的蓝宝石光芒汇聚而成的河流；语言的纹路在宛如冻结闪电的支柱上互相追逐。

最后，无尽的光亮迫使你把头埋在手中，你眨了眨眼，猛烈的泪水驱散了眼上的光芒。

previousTranslation:
当锻造同伴开口说话时，发出的声音听起来不像是曾经的你。但你还是从中辩认出一些——那是你在疲惫、无聊或不情愿时发出的声音。“我可以自己站起来。”

粘土人列车主管似乎没有注意到这个问题。“当然了。来吧，我们必须回到机车上。”同伴点点头，“然后我们可以一起练习和声。”他们走了，同伴在后面紧紧地跟着。

白衣牧师拿起一个长长的银喇叭用来检查你的声音，她用蓝色王国的音阶来判断你声音的完好。当她最终满意时，她挥了挥手让你离开。

previousOriginal:
The Clay Conductor rushes to support the Companion, who gazes at the Conductor blankly. When they speak, their voice has a resonant echo of the Conductor, though in a more pleasing register. "I can manage."

The Clay Conductor doesn't appear to notice, hurrying to support the Companion. "Of course. Come, we must get back to our engine." 

The Companion nods. "Good," they say, in the Conductor's voice. "Then we can begin to practice together." 

The Conductor smiles, but weakly. They walk away, together, out of the Forge, leaving you to follow behind.

previousTranslation:
粘土人列车主管连忙去搀扶他的锻造同伴，后者茫然地望着列车主管。当那东西说话时，声音有着列车主管一样的嘹亮回响——尽管是在一个更悦耳的音域。“我可以自己站起来。”

粘土人列车主管似乎没有注意到这句话，搀扶着同伴。“当然了。来吧，我们必须回到机车上。”

同伴点点头。“好，”它用列车主管曾经的声音说道，“然后我们可以开始一起练习。”

列车主管虚弱的笑了笑。他们走了，一起离开了铸炉，留下你在后面跟着。

previousOriginal: Death's Door has not yet closed.
currentOriginal: Death's Door has not yet closed.
previousTranslation: 死亡之门还没有关闭。

previousOriginal:
You are now in the heart of the Sapphir'd King's power. An ocean of kaleidoscopic machinery. Wheels taller than mountains, turning, vanishing. Rivers of torrential architecture. Songs in cages. 

After a moment to appreciate the spectacle, you order your crew to ready the cannons.

Thunderclaps echo across the Blue Kingdom. Celestial machinery crumbles beneath the fury of your artillery. You punch holes through language. Pillars tumble. Chains shatter. 

But you are in the heart of a star's power, and your rebellion cannot last more than an instant. Light washes over you. You are no longer permitted to exist. You cease.

After you are eradicated, one of the King's servants opens a ledger. A small note is made in a margin. Your complaint on behalf of all mortals has been registered.

previousTranslation:
你现在正处于蓝宝石之王的力量中心。一片由千变万化的机器组成的海洋。有着比群山还高的轮状物，转动着，消失着。一条连绵不绝的由各式结构组成的建筑之河。笼子里飘荡出难以理解的歌声。

在欣赏了这一壮观的场景之后，你命令你的列车员准备好大炮。

雷鸣般的炮声在蓝色王国里回荡。天空中的机器在你大炮的怒火下分解。布满信符的建筑被你打出几个大洞。巨柱倒下，锁链碎裂。

但你是在一位星星（司命）力量的中心，你的叛逆不会持续超过一个瞬间。光芒冲刷过你。你不再被允许存在。你消逝了。

在你被消灭后，国王的一个仆人打开了一个账本。在一个空白的边缘做了一个小记号。你代表所有凡人的控诉已被登记。

previousOriginal:
Logoi hound your locomotive, circling like comets, spitting fire-invective and flame-oaths, the weight of their anger so potent it buckles metal and cracks glass. But they can't keep up. You instruct your navigator to hold steady.

Ponderously vast, the golden Door opens. A cold, surgical light spills out. The daily tithe of spirits go rushing in.

And, far above the throng, your engine barrels screaming through. For a moment, the light subsumes you.

previousTranslation:
圣言像彗星一样盘旋在后，追赶着你的机车，如同咒骂一般向四周喷吐着火焰。它们的愤怒如此强烈，以至于让机车的金属弯曲、玻璃破碎。但它们无法跟上你的速度。你命令你的领航员保持稳定。

沉重而巨大的金门打开了。一道冰冷的、手术般的光线从外面洒了进来。每天都有进入死亡之门的鬼魂。

同时，在这群鬼魂的上空，你的机车呼啸着驶过。有那么一瞬间，光芒淹没了你。

previousOriginal: Search for clues. Tail suspicious characters.
currentOriginal: Search for clues. Tail suspicious characters.
previousTranslation: 寻找线索。跟踪可疑的人物。

previousOriginal:
"Smuggling means carrying contraband from one region to another. That means using the transit relays. And the relays, you see, is watched by the Revenue Men: as cruel and humourless a body of joy-throttlers as ever there was."

He tops up your glass. "You might be able to hide your wares from them. Failing that, some of them can be bribed or flummoxed. Worst comes to worst, you might risk shooting your way free."

[Fully completing a smuggling prospect grants better rewards than completing legitimate prospects. They also grant double experience.]

previousTranslation:
“走私是将违禁品从一个地区运到另一个地区。这意味着要使用中转站。而中转站，你知道，受到税务官的监视：他们是一群残忍而又没有幽默感的扫兴者。”

他给你倒了杯酒。“你也许可以把你的货物藏起来不让他们看见。又或者，他们中的一些人可能会被贿赂或蒙骗。最糟糕的情况下，你可能会冒险开枪逃走。”

[完成走私任务比完成合法任务能获得更好的回报，还能获得双倍的经验。]

previousOriginal:
At your signal, the crew brandishes weapons and charges. The Clay Men move to protect the Inspector, and to fight back. They make swift work of any crew members that get close. 

Outside, the hull shudders and groans, quickly ensnared by the Revenue's harpoons. The fight does not last long. It ends with you in manacles, on your way to judgement in an Albion court.

previousTranslation:
接到你的信号后，列车员们挥舞着武器，发起冲锋。粘土人则迅速行动起来，保护着检察官，并进行反击。他们迅速解决了任何靠近的列车员。

车外，车身震颤着，发出痛苦的呻吟，很快就被税务官们的鱼叉所困住。战斗并没有持续太久。最终，你戴上了手铐，正被押往阿尔比恩的法庭接受审判。

previousOriginal: Your illicit cargo has been discovered. Three bulky Clay Men stand ready to enforce the inspector' will. They prepare to stamp your import form with indelible red ink and hand you over to the authorities. These days, those authorities increasingly consider smuggling akin to treason.
currentOriginal: Your illicit cargo has been discovered. Three bulky Clay Men stand ready to enforce the inspector' will. previousTranslation: 你的非法货物已被发现。三名魁梧的粘土人已整装待发，准备执行检察官的意志。他们正打算用难以磨灭的红色墨水在你的进口单上盖章，并将你移交给当局。如今，这些当局越来越将走私视为叛国行为。

previousOriginal: Fire up the engines.
currentOriginal: Fire up the engines.
previousTranslation: 发动机车。

previousOriginal:
A claw taps a playful tune against glass. Shave-and-a-haircut—

Then the window shatters. The abomination slides into your locomotive, thrashing, scrabbling, unfurling until it fills the corridor. Its screeches lash you, scar your mind. Bullets merely crumple on its hide. In a single swipe, it eviscerates an engineer. A boiler-woman advances, her rifle cracking. Affronted, it methodically dismembers her.

Nothing can kill it. Nothing can stop it. It takes your crew apart, one by one, and then it comes for you.

一只爪子在玻璃上敲打出欢快的旋律。剃须~和~理发~

然后窗户碎了。那怪物滑进了你的火车，扭动、挣扎、展开，直到填满了整个走廊。它的尖叫声抽打着你，给你的心灵留下了伤痕。子弹打在它的皮上只是皱成一团。它一挥爪子，就剖开了一名工程师的肚子。一名锅炉女工冲了上来，她的步枪砰砰作响。怪物被激怒了，有条不紊地将她分尸。

没有什么能杀死它。没有什么能阻止它。它把你的列车员一个接一个地撕开，然后朝你扑来。

previousOriginal:
You drop altitude and search the field of sky-rubble below the Tower of Chimes. Spending too long here is acutely dangerous – if the debris shifts, you could end up with your locomotive squashed flat between a pair of mountain-sized rocks.

Fortunately, you manage to find the spot where the minute-hand landed after only a day of searching. It has stuck point-first into a boulder, surrounded by coils of shattered chain.

previousTranslation: 你降低高度，在钟楼下方的天空碎石场中搜寻。在这里逗留太久极其危险——如果碎石堆发生移动，你的机车可能会在山一般大小的岩石之间被压成扁平。\n\n幸运的是，在仅仅寻找了一天之后，你终于找到了分针落点所在。它尖端朝下卡在了一块巨石中，周围缠绕着一圈圈断裂的链条。

previousOriginal: Whenever you pursue the Cup you find yourself bombarded with constant visions of knights, and castles, and mournful moonlit fields.
currentOriginal: Whenever you pursue the Cup you find yourself bombarded with constant visions of knights, and castles, and mournful moonlit fields.
previousTranslation: 每当你追求圣杯时，你会发现自己的脑海中不断浮现出骑士、城堡和凄清的月光田野的画面。

previousOriginal: This Throne cannot hold you any longer.
currentOriginal: This Throne cannot hold you any longer.
previousTranslation: 这个王座再也无法限制你了。

previousOriginal:
The Minute to Midnight slices through the air and severs a demon's head from its neck in a single stroke. The other demons crowd around, striking you with sticks and knives and fists, but your sword whips back and forth with snake-like speed. Demon after demon falls dead at your feet, until you are drenched in their odious blood.

Finally, the Castle of the Seraphim stands silent and empty. You mount your horse and ride on your way, having successfully proven your worth on the Blindness Throne.

You spring from the dentists' chair, knife flashing in your hand, and barrel toward the Ringleader like a runaway locomotive. He barely has time to change his expression from smug satisfaction to utter shock before your knife is pressed to his throat.

Your demands: the money, safely returned. An untroubled exit from the museum. 

"Eck," says the Ringleader, trying to speak without moving his Adam's apple. "Eck. Oh courff. Anyfing oo ay."

In short order you are back on the streets outside the museum, free, unblinded, your money safely returned. You have successfully proven your worth on the Blindness Throne.

你从牙医椅上猛地站起，手中闪烁着匕首的光芒，如同一列失控的火车般冲向领头人。你的匕首抵上他的喉咙之前，他几乎没有时间从得意的满足转变为彻底的震惊。

你的要求：钱，安全归还。顺利离开博物馆。

“呃，”领头人说道，尽量不动喉结地发声，“呃。哦，当然。任何东西都行，哎。”

很快，你就回到了博物馆外的街道上，自由了，视力恢复了，钱也安然无恙地装在口袋里。你在盲目王座上成功地证明了自己的价值。

previousOriginal:
You leap from the chair, knocking over the solitary ruffian who had been approaching you with a blindfold. As the others shout and draw pistols, you vanish in the museum's shadowy recesses.

The Ringleader and his lackeys fan through the museum, yelling panicked instructions at each other. You stand stock-still between a waxwork of Plato and a waxwork of Judas Iscariot; once the ruffians have passed you by, you hop from the podium and make a beeline for the exit.

In short order you are back on the streets outside the museum, free, unblinded, having successfully proven your worth on the Blindness Throne.

A few moments later you stand in one fluid motion, your sword at your hip, and buckle your armour tight around your waist.

When you recover your senses you are not beside a lake, but dangling by one hand from the sky-chain. Your sword is in your other hand. The monster's dripping corpse is entangled in the chain below.

—And then you are riding atop your destrier, a sword across your back. The sky above is an endless blazing blue. Your companions ride beside you, laughing, singing. The trees are dripping blossom. 

No time to admire the scenery. You have monsters to slay and innocents to save. There is so much to do before nightfall, which is funny, because nightfall will never come. This day will last.

Sometimes, in rare moments of contemplation, you remember a silver smile.

极少的时刻，当你沉思时，会想起一抹银色的笑靥。

You slip into the dream-world and approach the Unseen Queen. She sits atop her throne, immaculately regal, the Cup in one hand.

You kneel at her feet. When you rise, the Minute to Midnight rises with you, and pins her swiftly through the throat. You catch the Martyr-King's Cup as it falls from her fingers.

And you walk back up into the sky. You are already planning your first move in the war against death. 

Storm clouds envelop you.

雷云将你笼罩。

But then. What a transformation! His features smooth and flatten. His tentacles retract. From a distance, one might take him for a human gentleman with an especially prominent brow.

He assesses you. Then – no thanks, no comment, not even the wave of a tentacle, what an ingrate! – he takes up someone's freshly discarded crozier. As a Bishop, he joins the game in play.
previousTranslation:
以顿悟为始，以蜕变为继。二者皆被他吞噬。触腕缠卷其间，尚有过度蠕动的某物在抽搐……该称之为唇吗？

然而，何等剧变！他面容渐趋平滑，触腕缩入体内。远观或误认为人类绅士，额角尤为嶙峋。

他审视着你。随后——无谢词、无赘言、连触腕都懒得挥动，何等寡恩！——他拾起某人新弃的权杖。身披主教之阶，他踏入进行中的棋局。

previousOriginal: How did he even gain entry to the Sand Garden?
currentOriginal: How did he even gain entry to the Sand Garden?
previousTranslation: 他是如何进入黄沙花园的？

previousOriginal: He has collected human souls, and now he is here to cultivate them.
currentOriginal: He has collected human souls, and now he is here to cultivate them.
previousTranslation: 他已经收集了人类的灵魂，现在他在这里培养它们。

You make your stand amidst the wreckage. Beside you, your hardiest crew, following their captain into a squalling, writhing hell.

previousTranslation:
你站在残骸之中，最顽强的列车员在你身边，跟随他们的车长跨入狂风肆虐的地狱。 

结束了。你的手臂因枪的重量而下垂。顽固虱的恶臭体液溅在你的脸上，矿工们的墓地被泥浆搅得乱七八糟。当最后一个虫子蠕动回洞时，你们为胜利欢呼。

previousOriginal:
You strike out into the ice, a crew of able miners beside you. Blades meet ice; torches melt snow; shovels break into frozen ground.

The air cracks with the sound of breaking ice  and a chorus of your crew's voices. As the snow whirls, you labour on, strike after strike. 

At last, just before a blizzard closes in, you have made a deep shaft into the packed ice.

previousTranslation:
你在冰里开道，一群能干的列车员在你身边。刀刃遇坚冰；火炬融积雪；铁铲破冻土。

空气中弥漫着破冰的声音和列车员的合唱。当雪飘落时，你继续劳作，一次又一次地挥镐。

最终，在暴风雪将至时，你在堆积的冰层里挖出一个很深的竖井。

previousOriginal: One is very close, the great lid closed as though sewn shut.
currentOriginal: One is very close, the great lid closed as though sewn shut.
previousTranslation: 很紧，眼皮闭着，就像缝起来一样。

previousOriginal: The post provides a list of murderers, traitors and villains. To earn the trust of the Gentlemen, the confessions must convince as testaments of absolute truth. Some confessions are obscured by elaborate excuses and abject apologies. But none spare the reader – every detail is recorded, as vivid as if it had occurred yesterday. This post is crammed with a catalogue of depravity.

previousOriginal: Ambition: visit your base at the Gate
currentOriginal: Ambition: visit your base at the Gate
previousTranslation: 野心：拜访你在大门的基地

previousOriginal:
What remains of the behemoth's carapace is scarred with sigils. Most are marred and broken, some still holding a sullen, resentful power.

Your locomotive is stopped on a broad, flat section of the shell. The few sigils nearby are too cracked to risk much harm.

previousTranslation:
这巨兽的残躯上灼着许多符印。虽然大多已经破裂损毁，但仍有少数符印留存着愠怒之意、憎恨之力。

你的机车停在甲壳上的宽阔平坦之地。附近的几枚符印已然相当残破，不会造成什么伤害。

previousOriginal:
After hours of pressing through low-ceilinged tunnels, the walls become papery, like a wasps' nest. The ground is more rubbery and corded: muscle. You must be nearing the heart.

You squeeze through a cranny into an oval-shaped chamber. A stultifying heat presses down. You are in a ventricle of the heart. 

The heart is clogged with hard, black, cancerous polyps. Each is scored with a sigil of guilt. They have grown in such abundance that the heart is distorted; they have torn a hole in the muscle wall. Is this what killed the behemoth?

previousTranslation:
在低矮的隧道里匍匐行进了几个小时后，墙壁变薄了，变得像是黄蜂的巢穴。地面则变得更软，更虬结，好像肌肉一样。你一定是接近心脏了。

你挤过一个裂缝，进入一个椭圆形的腔室。一股令人窒息的热量压了过来。你正在心脏的一个心室里。

心脏被坚硬的、黑色的、癌变的息肉所堵塞。每个息肉上都有一个表示内疚的符印。它们如此之多，以至于心脏都变形了：它们在肌肉壁上撕开了一个洞。这就是这个巨物的死因吗？

previousOriginal:
You have an engine, guns, and armed crew. He has a candle and halitosis. It will not be difficult. You may, however, cause him to case down a mendicant's curse upon you.

[Seize 3 Caddies of Dried Tea. You will also gain a substantial amount of Terror.]

previousOriginal:
Ratbite opens her mouth to offer a rebuttal, then glances at the grinning Vagabond and changes her mind. She turns and flees into the town. 

"Good riddance," says the Vagabond cheerfully. He walks you back to the engine, regaling you at length with titbits he's learned about the drunk fellow's travels and personal history.

previousTranslation: 年轻的云雀被隐藏在秘密代码中的乐园承诺所吸引。她对他做了什么？

previousTranslation: 操之过急

previousOriginal:
The gantry is mizzled with mist; clammy and insubstantial as a spectre's sighs. The Lugubrious Keeper leads you around the tower's perimeter. He instructs you in the sealing of oil lanterns and the fixing of them to the iron railings. 

It is arduous, tedious work. Your hands cramp; his are already almost claws. But by the shift's end, the tower is illuminated in a blaze of flickering lamps. Light seeps over the mist like oil over water.

The Lugubrious Keeper spits into the mists, grimly triumphant. He insists you take an old lantern as a reward. It is peppered with lesions, formed from protruding needles, and stained an unwholesome violet.

previousTranslation:
廊桥浸没于雾气之中，潮湿而又朦胧，一如幽魂的叹息。阴郁的看守人引你绕行塔楼外围，教你如何密封油灯，再将它们逐一固定在铁栏杆上。

这是项艰涩乏味的活计。你双手抽筋，而他的双手已经变得像爪子一样了。但当轮班结束时，整座塔楼已被摇曳灯火点亮。光芒渗入雾霭，如同油脂在水面晕染。

阴郁的看守人朝雾气啐了一口，神色阴鸷而得意。他执意要你收下一盏旧提灯作为酬劳。灯身布满渗着针尖般凸起的蚀孔，浸染着某种病态的紫色。

previousOriginal:
The lighthouse looms out of the mists like a pale candle. Its light burns a searing path, breaking through the wispy susurration of the fog.

A single platform clings to the lighthouse, allowing for engines to dock. The upper gantry hangs far above it, like a sentinel.

A pair of elderly keepers maintain the tower. They permit guests the use of their converted fuel house. It is not much of a generosity.

灯塔在薄雾中若隐若现，就像一支苍白的蜡烛。它的光芒照出一条灼热的路径，冲破了薄雾的飘渺。

灯塔上只有一个平台，可以让机车停靠。上方的龙门架远远地挂在上面，就像一个哨兵。

一对年长的看护者在维护这座塔。他们允许客人使用他们改造过的燃料房。这并不是什么慷慨之举。

previousOriginal: Meagre pickings
currentOriginal: Meagre pickings
previousTranslation: 收获甚微

previousOriginal: In the hold you find stacks of illicit literature; works too lurid, or sensational, or frank for the Information Office to allow into general publication.
currentOriginal: In the hold you find stacks of illicit literature; works too lurid, or sensational, or frank for the Information Office to allow into general publication.
previousTranslation: 在货舱里，你会发现成堆的非法文学；这些作品过于耸人听闻，或过于煽情，或过于直率，以至于信息加工办公室不允许它们公开发行。

previousOriginal: You order your crew to take them back to your locomotive, and are very clear about what you'll do to anyone you caught sampling them.
currentOriginal: You order your crew to take them back to your locomotive, and are very clear about what you'll do to anyone you caught sampling them.
previousTranslation: 你命令你的工作人员把它们带回你的机车，并且非常清楚你将如何对待任何被你抓到偷尝它们的人。

previousOriginal:
The water is hot as a freshly drawn bath; you must ease yourself in slowly. You settle on a flat rock, rest your head against the bank while knots in your neck dissolve. The constant drum of the rushing waters drowns out even your thoughts. 

All you can do is paddle gently, and look through the steam, out at the Reach – emerald green, cathedralled with branches soaring like buttresses. In this moment, there is only beauty: savage, exquisite. 

And you needn't worry about the descent – it'll be easier than the way up.

previousTranslation:
水热得像刚放好的洗澡水；你必须慢慢让自己适应。你坐在一块平坦的岩石上，头靠着河岸，颈部的结节渐渐消散。潺潺流水的持续轰鸣声甚至淹没了你的思绪。

你所能做的就是轻轻地划桨，透过蒸汽望去，眼前是外野——翠绿欲滴，树枝高耸如大教堂的扶壁。在这一刻，只有美，狂野而精致。

而且你不必担心下行——下行会比上行更容易。

previousOriginal:
The sound is sharp and silver in the murk. For a time, there is nothing, no indication of life in the store until— 

"What are you? Why have you come? If you are a customer, I have nothing right now, nothing I want to sell," comes a voice from the clutter. A body soon follows the voice, peeling from the gloom. It elongates, stretching upwards, spreading into a flare of burgundy fabric. Under its hood, an unmistakably chiropteran visage, its eyes dark and curious.

It is one of the Masters of the Bazaar. Though pronounced adversaries of the empire, one of them still stands here before you: imperious, impossible. 

And maybe, slightly... afraid?

previousTranslation:
尖锐的铃声在阴暗的环境中好似一道银光。一段时间里，没有回应，店里没有任何生命的迹象，直到——

“你是什么东西？你为什么要来？如果你是个顾客，我现在什么都没有，这里没有我要卖的东西。”一个声音从杂乱的环境中传来。随着这个声音，一个身影很快自朦胧处剥离出来。它拉长了身子，向上伸展，蔓延成一片酒红色的布料。在它的头罩下，是一个毫无疑问的爬行动物的面孔，它的眼神漆黑而好奇。

它是巴扎的领主之一。虽然被宣布为帝国的对手，但它们中的一个仍然站在你面前：带着专横的，难以置信的神色。

也许，还有点……害怕？

previousOriginal: You ring the bell.
currentOriginal: You ring the bell.
previousTranslation: 你拉响了门铃。

previousOriginal:
"It'll go away. Like everything, it melts away." It traces the longitude between your wrist and the spoke of your elbow, its touch ethereally light. The Chiropterous Hoarder's ears droop. "You will continue. But what is the word that I should say? Repentance. I am very sorry. A gift will follow."

Regardless of your answer, you find a firkin of red honey balanced against the door to your cabin the next day.

currentOriginal: The Chiropterous Hoarder has been uncommonly quiet.
previousTranslation: 蝙蝠囤积狂罕见的安静。

previousOriginal: The Chiropterous Hoarder is ecstatic with your decisions. Its speech degenerates into piercing, albeit rhythmic, shrieking. The experiments can begin when you are ready.
currentOriginal: The Chiropterous Hoarder is ecstatic with your decisions. Its speech degenerates into piercing, albeit rhythmic, shrieking. The experiments can begin when you are ready.
previousTranslation: 蝙蝠囤积狂对你的决定欣喜若狂。它的声音退化成刺耳的尖嚎，尽管颇有节奏。当你准备好了，实验就可以开始。

previousOriginal: A confession
currentOriginal: A confession
previousTranslation: 忏悔

previousOriginal: It's the captain's duty to ensure that crew and officers are happy. Especially in this situation.
currentOriginal: It's the captain's duty to ensure that crew and officers are happy. Especially in this situation.
previousTranslation: 确保列车员和车务官的幸福是车长的职责。特别是在这种情况下。

previousOriginal: Humming radiates from inside its quarters: a lullaby-like thing, or a dirge from a forgotten world. When not working, it keeps to itself, preoccupied with whatever inspires its humming.
currentOriginal: Humming radiates from inside its quarters: a lullaby-like thing, or a dirge from a forgotten world. When not working, it keeps to itself, preoccupied with whatever inspires its humming.
previousTranslation: 嗡嗡声从它的居处里散发出来：类似摇篮曲的东西，或者是来自被遗忘的世界的哀歌。在不工作的时候，它保持自我，专注于使其哼唱的东西。

previousOriginal: It is her manner, rather than an error in her appearance that reveals the False Victoria as counterfeit. She is too languorous, too humble to be a monarch.
currentOriginal: It is her manner, rather than an error in her appearance that reveals the False Victoria as counterfeit. She is too languorous, too humble to be a monarch.
previousTranslation: 假维多利亚的外貌与本尊别无二致，但是她的举止出卖了自己的冒牌身份。她太慵懒了，太谦逊了，不可能是位君主。

previousOriginal: You have what you need.
currentOriginal: You have what you need.
previousTranslation: 你拿到了你需要的东西。

previousOriginal:
She resembles a waxwork icon gussied-up in the image of Her Renewed Majesty, perfect and horrible and alone.

The room into which she leads you is spartan: a bare cot, a meagre pantry, toiletries, a stool, and no more than that.
currentOriginal:
She resembles a waxwork icon gussied-up in the image of Her Renewed Majesty, perfect and horrible and alone.

The room into which she leads you is spartan: a bare cot, a meagre pantry, toiletries, a stool, and no more than that.
previousTranslation:
她像一尊新生的女王陛下的蜡像，无暇、恐怖、孤寂。

她引你进入的房间却很简陋：一张光秃秃的小床，一个微不足道的储藏柜，一些化妆用品，一张小凳子，仅此而已。

previousOriginal: Your engineers return from the recesses of the factory with boxes of obscure replacement parts. "See this?" one of them asks, excitedly. "That's a number three gasket, that is! Can't get them for blood nor money!" You nod and smile, supportively.
currentOriginal: Your engineers return from the recesses of the factory with boxes of obscure replacement parts. "See this?" one of them asks, excitedly. " That's a number three gasket, that is! Can't get them for blood nor money!" You nod and smile, supportively.
previousTranslation: 你的工程师们从工厂深处带着几箱不知名的替换零件回来了。“看到没？”他们中的一人兴奋地问道，“这是三号垫片！这可是有钱也买不到的！”你点点头，微笑着表示支持。

previousOriginal: You haul it to your locomotive and beat a hasty retreat. Who knows when the smugglers that stored it here might return to reclaim it.
currentOriginal: You haul it to your locomotive and beat a hasty retreat. Who knows when the smugglers that stored it here might return to reclaim it.
previousTranslation: 你把它拖到机车上，匆匆撤退。谁知道把它藏在这里的走私者什么时候会回来取它。

previousOriginal: You don't like to sign up to endeavours half-informed. You know she keeps secrets. She never goes anywhere without a battered old journal, bitten by sky-frost.
currentOriginal: You don't like to sign up to endeavours half-informed. You know she keeps secrets. She never goes anywhere without a battered old journal, bitten by sky-frost.
previousTranslation: 你不喜欢在一知半解的情况下就加入活动。你知道她保守秘密。她去任何地方都要带着一本被天霜咬过的破旧日记。

previousOriginal:
As soon as you set your locomotive down, she leaps out to investigate the ruins. A leather-bound, yellow-paged journal is in her hands. "My father's," she says, when she notices you looking. 

Her workers clear away rubble, then erect ladders and platforms so she can examine the sigils on the great arch. For a tense hour she pores over them, taking short breaks when the celestial language makes her hair smoulder and her eyes smoke. Then she stands, snaps her journal shut, and nods. The workers cheer.

"It is exactly what I had hoped, [qvd:131182(SpeechFormal)]!" she calls down. "These are the Gates of Dusk, marking the beginning of an ancient route connecting Albion and Eleutheria. I mean to reopen them. We should talk."
currentOriginal:

previousTranslation:
你一停下机车，她就跳出来调查废墟。她手里拿着一本皮制装订的黄页日记。“我爸爸的，”当她注意到你在看的时候，她说。

她的工人们清理瓦砾，然后搭建梯子和平台，这样她就可以检查大拱门上的符印。在紧张的一个小时里，她全身心投入，当天堂的语言让她的头发闷着，眼睛冒烟时，她会短暂休息。然后她站起来，啪的一声关上日记，点了点头。工人们欢呼起来。

“这正是我所希望的，[qvd:131182(SpeechFormal)]！”她喊道。“这些是黄昏之门，标志着连接阿尔比恩和厄琉忒里亚的古老路线的开始。我想重新打开它们。我们应该谈谈。”

previousOriginal:
The Surveyor spends a day checking your locomotive's plating and performing an inventory of your supplies, while you oversee your engineers as they double- and triple-check its systems.

Eventually, there are no more checks to make, nor reason (save self-preservation) to delay. You buckle yourselves into your seats. The relay's hour-looms thunder up to speed. Its arms fold over you. The correspondence-wheels begin to spin. The sigils burn.

The Surveyor meets your eye. She opens her mouth to speak, and then your engine is flung, groaning, across a tumultuous sky.
currentOriginal:
The Surveyor spends a day checking your locomotive's plating and performing an inventory of your supplies, while you oversee your engineers as they double- and triple-check its systems.

Eventually, there are no more checks to make, nor reason (save self-preservation) to delay. You buckle yourselves into your seats. The relay's hour-looms thunder up to speed. Its arms fold over you. The correspondence-wheels begin to spin. The sigils burn.

previousTranslation:
测量员花了一天的时间检查你的机车装甲，清点补给，而你则监督手下的工程师对各项系统进行复检和三检。

最终，所有检查都已完成，也没有理由再继续拖延（除非出于自保）。你用安全带把自己绑在座位上。中转站的时织机发出轰鸣、加速运转。其机械长臂合拢，悬于机车之上，信符轮盘开始旋转，符印随之燃烧。

测量员与你四目相对。她刚要开口，下一瞬，你的机车便被猛然甩出，伴随着一声金属的哀鸣，冲入那片动荡不安的天空。

previousOriginal: You will need a resilient locomotive, enough space for your passengers, and supplies. You will emerge at an unknown destination, in who knows what state.
currentOriginal: You will need a resilient locomotive, enough space for your passengers, and supplies. You will emerge at an unknown destination, in who knows what state.
previousTranslation: 你需要一辆有弹性的机车，足够的空间容纳乘客，以及补给。你将出现在一个未知的目的地，天知道是什么状态。

previousOriginal: Your quartermaster offers to find out. But the moment they stand, a shadow passes swiftly across the bridge, as if something passed between you and the stars. Something large and winged.
currentOriginal: Your quartermaster offers to find out. But the moment they stand, a shadow passes swiftly across the bridge, as if something passed between you and the stars. Something large and winged.
previousTranslation: 你的军需官主动提出要去看看。但当他们站起来的那一刻，一道阴影迅速穿过船桥，仿佛有什么东西从你和星星之间穿过。有翅膀的大的东西。

previousOriginal: There!
currentOriginal: There!
previousTranslation: 在那里！

previousOriginal: Forget the Rubbery Men. You have a crew and, more importantly, a map!
currentOriginal: Forget the Rubbery Men. You have a crew and, more importantly, a map!
previousTranslation: 忘了那些软体人吧。你有一名列车员，而且更重要的是，你有一张地图！

previousOriginal:
Your guide is an emaciated figure, badly contained in its rags, tentacles pocked with scars. It is piteously eager to be of service.

The path it chooses is convoluted and wetly brilliant. Hours into the descent, you find the gland: livid with parasites, gleaming verdigris in the light. You give the Rubbery Man its prize, and its broken-hearted crooning accompanies the next part of your labours.
currentOriginal:

The path it chooses is convoluted and wetly brilliant. Hours into the descent, you find the gland: livid with parasites, gleaming verdigris in the light. You give the Rubbery Man its prize, and its broken-hearted crooning accompanies the next part of your labours.
previousTranslation:
你的向导瘦骨嶙峋，破烂的衣物裹不住他瘦弱的身体，触手上布满了疤痕。他急切地渴望为你效劳，模样可怜。

他选择的道路蜿蜒曲折，且湿漉漉地闪闪发光。经过数小时的下降，你找到了腺体：上面满是寄生虫，在光线下闪着铜绿色。你把这个战利品交给了软体人，他那心碎般的吟唱声伴随着你接下来要做的工作。

previousOriginal: Listening patiently to the widow's complaints about her family has given you an idea. You claim to be an acquaintance of her eldest son, the ambassador to the Empyrean.
currentOriginal: Listening patiently to the widow's complaints about her family has given you an idea. You claim to be an acquaintance of her eldest son, the ambassador to the Empyrean.
previousTranslation: 耐心倾听寡妇对她家人的抱怨后，你心生一计。你自称是她大儿子——苍天上国大使的熟人。

previousOriginal: You like to think that you've learned better than to involve yourself in the business of Hell. You had better get the letters back to the 'Retired' Devil. In fact, you should lock them in the safe so that they won't be a temptation.
currentOriginal: You like to think that you've learned better than to involve yourself in the business of Hell. You had better get the letters back to the 'Retired' Devil. In fact, you should lock them in the safe so that they won't be a temptation.
previousTranslation: 你以为自己已经学聪明了，不再卷入地狱的勾当。你最好把这些信还给那个“退休”的魔鬼。事实上，你应该把它们锁在保险箱里，以免它们成为诱惑。

previousOriginal: Is this to be the miserable end to its ruined existence? The cleaver and the pot?
currentOriginal: Is this to be the miserable end to its ruined existence? The cleaver and the pot?
previousTranslation: 这就是它破败生命的结局吗？菜刀和锅？

previousOriginal: You caught it in the mists near Worlebury. Now, it thrashes weakly in its net.
currentOriginal: You caught it in the mists near Worlebury. Now, it thrashes weakly in its net.
previousTranslation: 你在沃伯瑞附近的迷雾中抓住了它。现在，它在网中无力地扭动着。

previousOriginal:
When it hears the name of your benefactor, the goat demon recoils and its goaty eyes go round as marbles. Its ears flatten. Hastily, it steps aside and pushes the door open for you. Beyond, a walled-off section of the hold has been converted into the Contriver's laboratory.
 
As you pass it, the goat demon tries, awkwardly, to curtsy.
currentOriginal:
When it hears the name of your benefactor, the goat demon recoils and its goaty eyes go round as marbles. Its ears flatten. Hastily, it steps aside and pushes the door open for you. Beyond, a walled-off section of the hold has been converted into the Contriver's laboratory.
 
As you pass it, the goat demon tries, awkwardly, to curtsy.
previousTranslation: 当听到你恩人的名字时，山羊恶魔退缩了，它那双像弹珠一样圆溜溜的山羊眼瞪得老大。它的耳朵贴在了脑袋上。它匆忙让开，为你推开门。门后，车舱的一个被隔开的区域已经被改造成了发明家的实验室。\n\n当你经过时，山羊恶魔笨拙地试图行屈膝礼。

previousOriginal: "If you help us complete this prototype," the Contriver informs you, "and if it works, you can keep it. This is only a step toward my eventual goal."
currentOriginal: "If you help us complete this prototype," the Contriver informs you, "and if it works, you can keep it. This is only a step toward my eventual goal."
previousTranslation: “如果你帮我们完成这个原型，”发明家告诉你，“如果它运行成功，你可以留下它。这只是我迈向最终目标的一步。”

previousOriginal: The Company keeps entire cabinets of them, to smooth a variety of dealings with Albion.
currentOriginal: The Company keeps entire cabinets of them, to smooth a variety of dealings with Albion.
previousTranslation: 公司保存着整柜的许可，以便顺利与阿尔比恩进行各种交易。

previousOriginal:
You are ushered into a closed meeting with the Fraught General Manager and his Prudent Secretary. In it, you offer several pieces of strategic advice that would increase Her Majesty's prospects in the region.

When you have done so, the Manager casts a glance at his Secretary, who nods. "Of course, of course," the Manager says, hurriedly. "We'll ensure this reaches the proper ears back home."
currentOriginal:
You are ushered into a closed meeting with the Fraught General Manager and his Prudent Secretary. In it, you offer several pieces of strategic advice that would increase Her Majesty's prospects in the region.

When you have done so, the Manager casts a glance at his Secretary, who nods. "Of course, of course," the Manager says, hurriedly. "We'll ensure this reaches the proper ears back home."
previousTranslation:
你被迎进了一场由忧虑的总经理和他的谨慎的秘书主持的秘密会议。在会议上，你提出了几条战略建议，来协助女王陛下更好地统治她的疆域。

当你提出这些建议后，总经理朝他的秘书看了一眼，秘书点了点头。“当然，当然，”总经理急忙说道，“我们会确保这些建议传到国内适当的人耳中。”

previousOriginal: The archive is a jumble, semi-sorted and barely catalogued. The curator, an indifferent man plagued by a phlegmy cough, is happy to loan you an exhibit. He doesn't check it out. There is no talk of returning it. If anything, he's happy to see it gone.
currentOriginal: The archive is a jumble, semi-sorted and barely catalogued. The curator, an indifferent man plagued by a phlegmy cough, is happy to loan you an exhibit. He doesn't check it out. There is no talk of returning it. If anything, he's happy to see it gone.
previousTranslation: 档案室里的档案杂乱无章，半整理状态，几乎没有编目。管理员是一个冷漠的男人，被痰多的咳嗽所困扰，他很高兴借给你一个展品。他并不检查展品。没有人谈及归还展品。他倒是很乐意看到展品被拿走。

previousOriginal: [qvd:133031(Public Perception)]
currentOriginal: [qvd:133031(Public Perception)]
previousTranslation: [qvd:133031(Public Perception)]

previousOriginal: Parents and children enter fierce debate about the limits of human strength. "Dear heart, no one can lift an asteroid." "But she's the strongest! She could lift anything!"
currentOriginal: Parents and children enter fierce debate about the limits of human strength. "Dear heart, no one can lift an asteroid." "But she's the strongest! She could lift anything!"
previousTranslation: 父母和孩子们就人类力量的极限展开了激烈的争论。“亲爱的，没有人能举起小行星。”“但她是最强壮的！她能举起任何东西！”

previousOriginal: Tour guides are essential in this place. Park guests are forbidden from entering the deeper sections of the Reserve alone.
currentOriginal: Tour guides are essential in this place. Park guests are forbidden from entering the deeper sections of the Reserve alone.
previousTranslation: 在这地方，向导必不可少。公园的游客被禁止独自进入保护区的较深区域。

previousOriginal:
Above, a golden nebula is fierce in the sky. Amber light dapples the curving lanes.

[qvd:133124(Stroll)]
currentOriginal:
Above, a golden nebula is fierce in the sky. Amber light dapples the curving lanes.

[qvd:133124(Stroll)]
previousTranslation: 上方，一团金色星云在天空中燃烧。琥珀色的光斑点缀着蜿蜒的巷道。\n\n[qvd:133124(Stroll)]

previousOriginal: A small gesture, but one that provides the Signalman with at least a pretence of privacy.
currentOriginal: A small gesture, but one that provides the Signalman with at least a pretence of privacy.
previousTranslation: 一个小小的举动，但却让信号员至少能假装一下是出于私人的原因。

previousOriginal:
"Come here. Come close and listen, you effervescent thing. I have a story. An associate of mine, he once gave me a sip of it. One golden drop to place under my tongue. And my life was changed." A carnivorous pleasure steeps in his voice as he speaks. "I went back to the store immediately, of course. But the price was too much.

"And then eventually the dreams drained away and now I'm here, serving wine to drunks."

His laughter is black and bitter. But the Auroral Sommelier gives you the address, nonetheless. Just in case. 

"If you decide to risk the same grief, savour it for me."

previousTranslation:
“过来。靠近点，听着，你这个活泼的伙计。我有个故事要说给你听。我的一个同事曾经给我喝了一口那种酒。在我舌下的一滴金色的液滴。在那之后，我的生活就改变了。”当他说话时，一种肉欲的快感在他的声音中陡然出现。“当然，我马上回到了店里。但那种酒的价格太贵了。

“到后来梦想终于消失了，再然后我待在这里，为醉汉提供葡萄酒。”

他的笑声漆黑而又苦涩。但是，曙光品酒师还是给了你他的地址。以防万一。

“如果你想体验同样的苦涩，就请为我品尝它。”

previousOriginal: 'His companion's hooves thumped on the crimson carpet. The corridor was long and lined with doors, each with a brass knob. He opened one. The room behind was filled from floor to ceiling with bottled souls. He tried another: the same. "We've never found a use for them," the devil admitted.'
currentOriginal: 'His companion's hooves thumped on the crimson carpet. The corridor was long and lined with doors, each with a brass knob. He opened one. previousTranslation: “他同伴的蹄子重重地踏在猩红色的地毯上。走廊很长，两旁都是门，每扇门都有一个黄铜把手。他打开了一扇门。后面的房间从地板到天花板都摆满了装有灵魂的瓶子。他又试了一间：还是一样。“我们从来没有找到利用它们的方法，”魔鬼承认道。”

previousOriginal: It is a villager on a midnight stroll, quickly dealt with. He didn't see your face, but suspicion will inevitably fall on visitors. You finish your work, retrieving a set of gleaming lenses, each holding a soul, from the ruins.
currentOriginal: It is a villager on a midnight stroll, quickly dealt with. He didn't see your face, but suspicion will inevitably fall on visitors. You finish your work, retrieving a set of gleaming lenses, each holding a soul, from the ruins.

previousOriginal: Swiftly, you gather your tools and hurry back to your engine, no richer except for a tale of a narrow escape. The villagers will notice someone was digging at the ruins, but they have no reason to be more suspicious of you than usual.
currentOriginal: Swiftly, you gather your tools and hurry back to your engine, no richer except for a tale of a narrow escape. The villagers will notice someone was digging at the ruins, but they have no reason to be more suspicious of you than usual.

From where you stand, you can see the corridor is both long and claustrophobic, a throat full of waiting dark. You take a deep breath as you step through and into a miasma of rotting faecal matter.

拉比特的罪行相对较轻——破坏财产、行为不端、扒窃。很容易确保她即将进行的审判的文书被巧妙地放错地方。

当你在监狱外迎接她时，她半疯半饿。你把她带上火车，命令给她一顿饱饭和一夜好眠。等她恢复过来后，你会向她询问她的老同伙奎弗斯。

previousOriginal:
Brabazon Workworld: the first workworld to be established in Albion. Working here, debtors can escape prison; they remain till their debts are repaid and a ticket away has been funded. The primary industry is hours processing, which has the side effect of accelerating time on the workworld surface.

The dock is between Brabazon Workworld and Little Nice – where the more privileged overseers reside. The dock is, for captains' sake, nearer Little Nice than the workworld. Unexpected ageing would deter even the greediest captain from arriving.

布拉巴宗工作世界：于阿尔比恩建立的首个工作世界。债务人若在此工作，便可免于入狱。他们滞留于此，直至偿清债务，筹到一张离境的票据。这里的主要产业是时间加工，其副作用是加速工作世界地表的时间流转。

玻璃厂的监督者身形高大，眼神空洞。他接过你的文件时双手颤抖，掌心湿冷，签名都被他抹糊了。

他匆匆赶往玻璃厂，去取你的货物。你不能进入厂房，因为有人告诉你，里面不太安全。

previousOriginal:
Engineers flock to you. You need to tell London what's happening up here, they say. Tell them to send more engineers. Send resources. Send help. Something, anything.

They list a litany of recent faults: a broken cog, a snapped belt, unpredictable flares. More engineers swallowed by light or vitrified. And every morning, the Sun has been taking longer and longer to reach full incandescence.

previousOriginal:
Engineers flock to you. You need to tell London what's happening up here, they say. Tell them to send more engineers. Send resources. Send help. Something, anything. 

Without the expertise of the Steward, things are bleak. Engines burned out. Small, possibly-crucial, certainly-irreplaceable components warped beyond repair. A forgotten part of the Sun's deeper machinery has simply stopped moving, and no one is sure if it was something important.

Every night, a new defect. Every morning, the Sun takes longer to dawn.

previousTranslation: 你问他是否患有某种疾病或不适，他则用苦涩的眼神盯着你。“不适？当然有。它的名字叫做‘琥珀宫’。”说完这句话后，他沉默了下来，你们之间只剩下尴尬而拘谨的用餐氛围。

previousOriginal: The Fuliginous Forewoman knows of your interest in the sisters, and may endanger your escape.
currentOriginal: The Fuliginous Forewoman knows of your interest in the sisters, and may endanger your escape.
previousTranslation: 浑身煤灰的女工头知道姐妹们是你的目标，这可能会威胁你们的逃跑过程。

previousOriginal:
Wilma patters from the dandy's palm to yours. Her whiskers twitch as Albrecht emerges from your sleeve. "You're here for my part of the number?" Albrecht nods solemnly. Wilma presses close to him. "Deine Schnurrhaare sind ungepflegt, mein Lieber," she whispers. "The number is—" You don't make out her words. She gives Albrecht a playful nip as she withdraws.

"Is Cinders here?" Wilma asks you. Something moves in your sleeve, but nothing emerges. Wilma nods, wishes you luck, and returns to her cage.

previousTranslation: 威尔玛从花花公子的手掌跳到你的手掌。当阿尔布雷希特从你的袖子里钻出来时，威尔玛的胡须抽动了一下。“你是为我那部分数字而来？”阿尔布雷希特郑重地点点头。威尔玛的身体向他贴过去。“（德语）你的胡须都乱了，亲爱的，”她小声说。“号码是——”你听不懂她的话。在离开时，她给了阿尔布雷希特一个俏皮的微笑。\n\n“辛德斯在这吗？”威尔玛向你问道。你的袖子里有东西在动，但谁也没有从里面钻出来。威尔玛点点头，祝你好运，然后回到笼子里。

previousOriginal: You've seen a thing or two in your time traversing the heavens.
currentOriginal: You've seen a thing or two in your time traversing the heavens.
previousTranslation: 在穿越天穹的过程中，你见过一两件事。

previousOriginal: The music stops. Somewhere below, a mechanical rumble can be heard, as the hour-looms begin spinning Perdurance's one perfect, perpetual day all over again.
currentOriginal: The music stops. Somewhere below, a mechanical rumble can be heard, as the hour-looms begin spinning Perdurance's one perfect, perpetual day all over again.

previousOriginal: All is ready. You give the Clairvoyant Doctress the faintest of nods, and she clicks her bag shut with a determined snap.

previousTranslation: 一切都准备好了。你向通灵的女医生微微点头，她果断地合上了她的包。

previousOriginal: The docks face a set of polished oak doors carved with a series of masked figures dancing the quadrille.
currentOriginal: The docks face a set of polished oak doors carved with a series of masked figures dancing the quadrille.
previousTranslation: 码头面对着一组抛光的橡木门，门上雕刻着一系列跳舞的蒙面人物。

previousOriginal:
On approach, Perdurance looks like an opulent mansion caught partway through a genteel explosion: each constituent set of rooms accounted for but separate and out of place. Each is connected in a rough circle by narrow, winding passages. The steep roofs are topped with shingled turrets and precarious towers.

The elegantly disassembled country house perches on top of a soot-stained, windowless factory whose chimneys belch gouts of smoke and fire.

previousTranslation: 走近一看，琥珀宫就像是一座豪华宅邸，在一场优雅的爆炸中被炸得四分五裂：每个房间都还在，但却各自分离，显得格格不入。它们通过狭窄曲折的通道，大致呈圆形相连。陡峭的屋顶上矗立着带木瓦的塔楼和摇摇欲坠的高塔。\n\n这座优雅地拆解开的乡间别墅坐落在一座烟熏火燎、没有窗户的工厂顶部，工厂的烟囱里不断喷吐出滚滚的烟雾和火焰。

previousOriginal: Once the Gate opened, people poured from London. They were encouraged by a new poetry of escape, of avid horizons, of new dawns. Perhaps you wrote too well: one by one your patrons joined them. Well, no one was leaving you behind. You booked passage North as soon as funds and good taste allowed. The Empire was being born anew in the heavens, and it would need poets; to ennoble its victories and dignify its defeats. Weeks later, through the Northern ice and the dark beneath the world, you reached the Gate. Its statues loomed like giants. The door was open, and the space within was filled with suns and stars and light!

previousTranslation: 大门一开，人们就从伦敦涌来。他们被一首关于逃亡、狂热的视野和新曙光的新诗歌所鼓舞。也许你写得太好了：你的赞助人一个接一个地加入了他们。 没有人会把你留在身后。在资金和良好品味允许的情况下，你尽快预订了北上通道。帝国正在天堂里重生，它需要诗人来为胜利增光添彩。 数周以后，穿过北方的寒冰与世界之下的黑暗，你抵达了那扇门。雕塑们如巨人赫然耸现。门是敞开的，其内满溢着日旭、星辰与光辉！

previousOriginal: A memory of fulfillment
currentOriginal: A memory of fulfillment
previousTranslation: 成就的记忆

previousOriginal:
The Fisher-Kings spoke with the wind, and the wind told them to go North. Things can be simple when you're a Fisher-King. 

The wind of Old London lived in the cavern roof. It was sullen, but it was clever. The Fisher-Kings were, perhaps, its priests. It told them of other winds: winds that blew in the draughty gulfs between stars, that spoke in dead voices. Perhaps they needed priests, too. 

Weeks later, through the Northern ice and the dark beneath the world, you reached the Gate. Its statues loomed like giants. The door was open, and the space within was filled with suns and stars and light. A wind blew through it.
