previousTranslation:
渔人王们与风交谈，风告诉他们要去北方。当你是渔人王的时候，事情就是这么简单。

老伦敦的风住在洞穴的屋顶上。它很阴沉，但也很精明。渔人王或许算是它的牧师。它告诉他们其他的风：在群星间通风的峡谷中吹过的，用死亡之声说话的风。也许它们也需要牧师。

数周以后，穿过北方的寒冰与世界之下的黑暗，你抵达了那扇门。雕塑们如巨人赫然耸现。大门敞开，其内满溢着日旭、星辰与光辉。一阵风穿过。

previousOriginal:
The Church didn't have an especial interest in the opening of Heaven. There were still ministries in old London to tend to.

The Bishop of Southwark had other ideas. "Devils," he told you, "Someone has to keep an eye on them. They have old history with the Heavens." 

He booked you passage on a splendid steam ship zailing North. Your berth was comfortable and the zailors appreciated a person of God being present.

Through the Northern ice and the dark beneath the world, you reached the Gate. Its statues loomed like giants. The door was open, and the space within was filled with suns and stars and light.

previousTranslation:
教会对天堂的开放并没有特别的兴趣。仍有牧师倾向于在旧伦敦。

南华克主教另有想法。“魔鬼，”他告诉你，“必须有人监视他们。他们与天堂有着悠久的历史。”

他为你预订了乘坐一艘向北航行的华丽蒸汽船的位置。你的铺位很舒适，水手夫妇很感激上帝的人在场。

穿过北方的冰层和世界之下的黑暗，你到达了大门。雕塑们如巨人赫然耸现。大门敞开，其内满溢着日旭、星辰与光辉。

previousOriginal:
The church, and its new, bright-eyed clergy, was given purpose by Her Majesty's enterprise in the stars. You were to leave old London to its lightless cavern and journey to a place where light might thrive. 

You were given passage on a ship of priests and deacons, admirals and zailors, joined in the golden fervour of the New Sequence. Your bright hymnals sounded through the dark beneath the world.

Weeks later, through the Northern ice, you reached the Gate. Its statues loomed like giants. The door was open, and the space within was filled with suns and stars and light.

女王陛下在星空中的事业赋予了教堂及其新的、目光明亮的神职人员以目标。你将离开古老的伦敦，前往一个没有光的洞穴，前往一处光线可以茁壮成长的地方。

你获准乘坐一艘由牧师、执事、海军上将和水手组成的船，加入到新序列的金色热情中。你明亮的赞美诗在世界的黑暗中响起。

数周以后，穿过北方的寒冰与世界之下的黑暗，你抵达了那扇门。雕塑们如巨人赫然耸现。大门敞开，其内满溢着日旭、星辰与光辉。

previousOriginal:
Were you the victim of a spy? An informer for the Ministry? You'll never know.

What you do know is that your ship was raided, your crew impounded and your goods thrown into the zee. Or possibly the other way around. Regardless, you were alone and hunted. 

An old friend made contact. They knew of one way out – beyond the Avid Horizon. They were leaving their life behind, taking only their boat.

Weeks later, through the Northern ice and the dark beneath the world, you reached the Gate. Its statues loomed like giants. The door was open, and the space within was filled with suns and stars and light.

previousTranslation:
是间谍出卖了你？还是公德部的线人？你永远无从知晓。

你所知道的是，你的船遭突袭，你的船员被扣押，你的货物被扔进了地下海泽。记忆中事件发生的顺序可能和现实有所出入，但无论如何，你独自一人，仓皇逃窜。

一个老朋友联系上了你。那人知道在渴求之地平线后面还有一条出路。那人仅带一艘船出走，把过往生活抛在身后。

数周以后，穿过北方的冰雪与世界之下的黑暗，你到达了那扇门。它的雕像如巨人般赫然耸现。大门敞开，其内满溢着日旭、星辰与光辉。

previousOriginal:
Unlike the rest of the Office, this room is alive with colour. Faded posters advertising variety shows line the walls. A brass typewriter sits on a robust desk. A luxurious double bed fills the room like a disagreeable aunt.

You waste no time in ransacking the place. This Probiter shared his underling's fondness for meticulous record-keeping, and you uncover a lengthy correspondence with one 'Mr. Nightingale,' begun soon before the old Probiter's disappearance. The letters are in code, but amongst them you find an envelope with a London address. Inside is a key.

previousTranslation:
与办公室的其他地方不同，这个房间充满了色彩。宣传着综艺节目的褪色海报挂满了墙壁。一张结实的桌子上摆着一台黄铜打字机。一张豪华的双人床像一位令人困扰的姨妈般塞满了整个房间。

你毫不迟疑地搜掠此处。这位检察官与他下属一样，热衷于细致的记录工作；你发现了他与一位“南丁格尔先生”之间的长期通信，始于老检察官失踪前夕。信件是用密码写成的，但你在其中发现了一个带有伦敦地址的信封。里面有一把钥匙。

previousOriginal:
He looks up from his records, a mixture of trepidation and eagerness on his face. "Well?" 

He blanches when you mention Mr. Nightingale. "I received letters from too. He wanted me to go to London. A place called Starling House. Said there were things I ought to see. Threatened to reveal— burnt the letters, of course. Do you think my superior went there? Is that why he left me – the Home Office?" He blushes violently.

previousTranslation:
他从档案中抬起头来，脸上交织着忐忑与急切。“怎么样？”

你一提到南丁格尔先生，他便脸色煞白。“我也收到了信。他让我去伦敦，去一个叫做椋鸟府的地方，说有一些我应该去看看的东西。他威胁要揭露——当然，信已经被我烧了。你认为我的上司去过那里吗？这便是他离我而去，离内政部而去的原因吗？”他面颊涨得通红。

previousOriginal:
Between shelves of tat, lined in neat rows, a woman with hair as white as cobwebs sits in a novelty rocking chair. She seems to be dead as the Stovie Sam dolls sat among the merchandise. 

She doesn't respond when you address her. But when you show her the ticket, her eyes widen. "Someone came looking for me before," she confides. "But I played dead, see?"

She joins you on your locomotive. Next stop for her is [qvd:133472(Port)].

previousTranslation:
在整齐排列的破旧货架之间，一位头发雪白如蛛网般的女人坐在一把新奇的摇椅上。她看上去就像商品中的史多福山姆玩偶一样毫无生气。

当你和她说话时，她没有任何反应。但当你把票给她看时，她的眼睛睁大了。“以前也有人来找过我，”她悄声说，“但我会装死，就像这样。”

她加入了你的火车之旅。她的下一站是[qvd:133472(Port)]。

previousOriginal: The man watches you intently. His feet are bare, his face is still coated in ash. A Word-Eater, attired for the Hour of Veracity. He beckons you over. "I will take your egg." His voice is rough and soft, as if he is unaccustomed to speech.
currentOriginal: The man watches you intently. His feet are bare, his face is still coated in ash. A Word-Eater, attired for the Hour of Veracity. He beckons you over. "I will take your egg." His voice is rough and soft, as if he is unaccustomed to speech.
previousTranslation: 那个男人目不转睛地盯着你。他光着脚，脸上仍涂满灰烬。他是一位“食字者”，穿着真理之时的衣服。他向你招手。“我要你的蛋。”他的声音既粗犷又柔和，好像不习惯说话。

previousOriginal:
The King expects tribute first. "Something appropriate. Seven savage secrets. A crimson promise, steeped in old starlight. A moment of inspiration, pried from the skull of a—"

The Masked Citizen interrupts. "That sounds like a lot of work, and we're already here. Will one of these do, instead?" They draw a luminous bottle from their bag. Inside, a knotted soul stirs, the inconstant colour of a bluebottle's back. It opens seven slitted eyes, lazily.

"Goodness," the King says. "Yes, please." 

The eery soul changes hands. The King will speak, but – in accordance with Pan's restrictions on storytelling – only to one of you.

previousTranslation:
国王希望你们先拿出贡品。“合适的东西。七个残酷的秘密。一个浸泡在古老星光里的绯红承诺。一个瞬间的灵感，从头骨中撬出——”

蒙面公民打断了他的话。“听起来很麻烦，而我们已经在这里了。可以用这些东西代替吗？”这人从包里拿出一个发光的瓶子。在里面，一个拧结的灵魂翻动着，颜色如僧帽水母般变幻莫测。它懒洋洋地睁开七只开缝的眼睛。

“天哪，”国王说。“是的，拿给我吧。”

怪异的灵魂易主了。国王会开口，但按照潘的限制，其只会对你们中的一个人讲述故事。

previousOriginal:
Your crew develops a cautious affection for the Multiplicitous Hoarder. It causes no fuss, only sings to itself, serenading your stock of equipment as if it were an absent child.

The Multiplicitous Hoarder brings almost nothing aboard save for three golden apples swaddled in silk, silver thread, and a bronze needle, its tip speckled with rust.

previousTranslation: 选手们的表现并不突出，质量也是如此。无论是阿尔比恩还是外野，都没有找到真正可以替代烟草的好东西，尽管越来越疯狂的烟民们已经尝试点燃了几乎所有被发现的天空之花。\n\n一些行天客四处走动，查看低档口味的烟草，猜测麦考利今天究竟在用什么来切它们。而更昂贵的品牌则在玻璃柜里一动不动。如果不是因为它显然已经濒临倒闭（很可能是倒闭），你一定会怀疑这个地方是怎么开下去的。

previousOriginal: Give the signal to MacQuarry. There's work to be done.
currentOriginal: Give the signal to MacQuarry. There's work to be done.
previousTranslation: 给麦考利发信号。有工作要做。

previousOriginal:

"Those who escape from the workworlds are hunted. My—  Our patron arranges passage for as many as she can. We look for opportunities. Empty cargo trains. Drunken captains who won't notice a few extra hands on board their trains."

previousOriginal: You have to source replacement wood and call in a favour you won't get back anytime soon, but you secure the promise you need. The plaque she receives will not mention the Isambard Line – London does not celebrate failures. But it will testify to her hard work in a hostile sky. The Signalman is mollified. "It's all any of us can hope for in the end, isn't it? To be remembered."

Unless—" She peers closely at you. "Follow me to the crypt. They keep me on to make sure him below never escapes. But I've heard his whispering in the dark." Her eyes are fervent, her expression zealous. "The devils rebelled first, you see. So we should help them. Coming?"

previousOriginal: "Safe out of sight of the sun"

Grass, long as witch's hair, shivers and screams on the hillside. Bones, long and white, break beneath your feet. The pipes scream each hour as they go by. A journey that should take an hour at most takes a full day.

previousTranslation: 要求捕心花捕捉你预言中的卧床而死的命运

previousOriginal:
The inner gardens are surrounded by a hedge as thick as a fortress wall, knotted with thorns and strangled with vines. Behind it are the grove-homes of the Heart-Catchers, steeped in Eleutheria's midnight and frequented only by their favoured servants.

Within the Mimiricon, the Heart-Catchers are big as trees and clustered with mature heads. Each plant is a council of intellects, debating the secrets of the sky.

previousOriginal:
The Supercilious Attaché is a very busy man, apparently, but when you mention the Bleak Industrialist's name his secretary suddenly waves you through. You find the Attaché hunched at his desk, halfway through a mackerel sandwich.

"The bureaucracy here is utterly intractable," he moans. "I tried all the official channels, honestly, I filled forms until my hands bled. But they won't even tell me where she is! It's no use anyway. The dead can't go back."

The First Venturer, an old man with a fierce look in his eye, takes the souls with exaggerated care. "Just provisions," he tells you, blocking your view of the storehouse, "Should a friend ever return." 

Behind him, spirits gather your reward. After a few minutes, one emerges, its arm laden with stones that shine like fired suns. It bows its masked head and the exchange is made.

第一冒险家，一位眼神凶狠的老人，极其小心地接过灵魂。“只是补给，”他告诉你，还挡住了你对仓库的视线，“如果有朋友回来。”

在他身后，鬼魂们正在收集你的奖赏。几分钟后，一个灵魂出现了，它的手臂上满是像太阳般闪耀的石头。它低下蒙着面孔的头，交换完成。

previousOriginal:
You and your crew don robes and masks and enter the storehouse in the guise of spirits. 

Within is a trove of stones, ordered according to some celestial catalogue. Cerulean meets lapiz, before shading to amethyst and cerise. They gleam upon stone shelves that seemingly extend for miles into the gloom. They groan under the weight of the countless stones, like the plunder of avaricious emperors.

You take what you can reach.

你和你的列车员们穿上长袍，戴上面具，扮成鬼魂潜入仓库。

仓库里的石头依照某种天界的规律摆放着。天蓝宝石靠在青金石旁边，随后逐渐过渡到紫水晶和樱桃石。陈列架闪闪发光，延伸至数英里开外，直到没入黑暗。架子在无数石头的重压下呻吟，就像贪婪的皇帝掠夺而来的宝藏。

你带走了手边的一些宝石。

previousOriginal:
The only way in is guarded by shades. Well, you have shades of your own. You make your orders clear, and they bow their porcelain masks. They glide toward the storehouse. You see them approach the guards at the gate, and then are ushered within. It is assumed they are supposed to be here.

Time passes. They emerge, heads bowed. Their robes bulge with gemstones, which they deposit upon your desk.

When you write your report on Death's Door, it is difficult to avoid slipping into philosophy. What does it all mean? Is this all there is? After a few attempts, you find more luck in writing about the spirits of the dead as baldly and bluntly as though they are imported cabbages. 

Shades arrive in ever-greater numbers. The Blue Kingdom finds it difficult to meet demand. You've heard rumours that there are even disguised members of the living among the influx of spirits, trying to slip through the Door while alive. Outside the Shadow of the Sun, a rising chaos is barely contained.

previousOriginal:
This part of Pan is claimed by the Gentlemen: a notorious gang of smugglers, and their families, hangers-on, clients and parasites.

Lanterns hang on posts, making paths of pooled lamplight across the ruins. Ramshackle pubs have been built in tumbled naves and old arches. 

Here, in the lawless galleries of Pan, the Gentlemen have no need to hide their activities. Smugglers boast of their schemes and their murders. Wild laughter rings out. Knives glint.

不少灯笼悬挂在柱头，灯光汇聚在一起，在废墟之间勾勒出条条光路。酒馆筑在倾颓的中殿与残破的拱门之中，摇摇欲坠。

在潘城的这片法外之地中，绅士帮无需遮掩其行径。走私犯们肆无忌惮地吹嘘自己犯下的勾当与谋杀。狂笑声此起彼伏，刀锋寒光闪闪。

The outcome of the discussions is, as yet, unknown, but speaks to the Company's ambitions, and confidence in its position.","12":"A surprise declaration at Victory Hall this morning, sanctioning routine inspections of all mercantile ships coming into New Winchester, "in the interests of fairness." The Windward Company has cried foul, arguing that the line between merchant and fighter vessels is too loosely defined for Tackety engines, and the measure is merely a pretext to search Company ships alone.
","13":"Lustrum has been turned upside down this week. A raid on a prominent counting house has turned up evidence of collusion and collaboration with known criminal elements. The notorious agent provocateur, murderess and saboteur Sweet Jane is believed to be operating out of Lustrum. The Windward Company believe she has gone to ground, and will be significantly impeded in her activities for the near future. 
","14":"An old face has returned to frontline Reach politics. Sweet Jane has had her name cleared at a heated meeting of the Assembly, which ran well into the small hours of the morning. Despite fierce opposition from the Indurate Veteran, the Assembly ruled Sweet Jane innocent of wilful malice in the actions leading to the destruction of the Queensbridge during the Blockade, and thirteen of the other fifteen charges made against her dating from that period. The Governor of New Winchester, in exile in London, has declined to comment, though the family of her wife has expressed their opposition to the ruling.","15":"Stocks have risen in the Windward Company, following the restoration of the Parsimonious Chairman to Head of the Committee for Peacetime Liaisons, following a brief absence after what a spokesman referred to as 'a lapse'. It is understood that the Wilful Accountant is expected to make a swift recovery. Company engines have resumed operating around Port Avon and the Airy. 
","16":"A midnight skirmish in the outer region has been reported. A Windward Company engine destroyed on its way back from Traitor's Wood. Two Tackety captains have been hauled into Victory Hall for questioning, though a spokesperson for the Assembly has stated that a sudden loss of visibility is to blame. "After all, in the dark, who can tell the difference between a London engine and a Windward one?"","17":"Reports of a devastating battle above Titania are being reported. Several senior members of the Assembly have resigned, while the Windward Company is demanding the resignation of the Rhapsodic Mayor. The Gazette believes a planned raid by the Windward Company on a den of Tackety smugglers was almost thrown off course by the sudden intervention of a swarm of Chorister Bees. Most of the Company engines have been seen returning to Port Prosper. The Tacketies have vanished, or else perished altogether. ","18":"A secret munitions factory in the lower district has been shelled! Acting on hidden intelligence, the Indurate Veteran convened an emergency session of the Assembly, authorising lethal force to be used in removing the threat. No survivors are reported, and no casualties amongst the Assembly's men. The Windward Company has offered all the help it can in the ongoing investigation.","19":"With the sweeping and unexpected victory of the Windward Company during the Second Battle of New Winchester, the New Gazette would like to take this moment to offer our sincerest congratulations to the new masters of the port. We would also like to request that the Company take into account the unique history and character of New Winchester, as they press on with their reforms, and remember that we are not Port Prosper nor would we wish to be. We also hope that the Windward Company retire their Committee for Peacetime Liaisons forthwith. ","21":"Despite the victory, rumours are circulating throughout New Winchester's stations that the Company is building new engines in Port Prosper's workyards. Dreadnoughts have been spotted on the Isambard Line. It seems London will not abandon its proxy lightly. ","23":"Despite recent setbacks, the Assembly has had an extremely good week. New legislation introducing Independent Licenses to prospectors in Lustrum have proved very popular, while the new Rule from Home, Help from Afar Bill has been applauded by representatives from Port Avon, Titania, and even the Acting Government of Port Prosper. Meanwhile, Sweet Jane's raids on presumed abandoned Company outposts have borne fruit.","24":"The Windward Company continue to press their advantage, seemingly in response to the Assembly's perceived complacency. The Acting Government on Port Prosper suffered a coup late Monday evening, when the Cabinet was arrested at the Admiral Nelson, the temporary headquarters of the Government. The Windward Company has regained control of the civilian government, and is encouraging other ports to fight back against the "Tackety Tyranny." ","25":"In a dramatic sequence of events shocking to all those who haven't been following the pages of the New Gazette, the Assembly late last night voted to withdraw from the governments of many ports in the Reach, and to allow the Windward Company to return to New Winchester. The increasingly unpopular Assembly has had to contend with growing discontent over reduced supplies – spread even more thinly – and the limitations of their own abilities. Do we detect the Prudent Secretary's hand in the new accord?","27":"Despite this seeming victory, the Windward Company's hold is less secure than it seemed. The New Gazette can confirm the survival of several key figures in the Assembly, including the Indurate Veteran and Sweet Jane, both of whom have been sighted on Lustrum. Already there are murmurs of discontent in the far flung ports of the Reach, who will not take kindly to any attempts to impose Direct Rule upon them. 
","29":"We've received word from the Parsimonious Chairman that our doomsaying and bellyaching is becoming something of a headache. Meanwhile, we have also received a very nice note from the Prudent Secretary praising our recent work. Trade has improved to New Winchester, and the other ports are approaching the Board of Directors with offers to begin negotiations. So far, there seems little appetite for a resumption of hostilities from all but the most ardent of Tackety supporters.
","30":"The strident efforts on the part of the Company to flush out collaborators and sympathisers appears to have had the opposite effect to what was intended. There are now areas of the port (we are told) that are no-go for Company officials, including the entire Bishopbridge region. Pardoned members of the Assembly gather in the Round Table. Contact has been cut by many of the outlying ports, most ominously Lustrum.
","31":"We publish here, with only minor edits, a letter from the Prudent Secretary. "Following the recent period of turbulence, it has come to our attention that the Windward Company has been approaching the New Winchester situation incorrectly. We are not unsympathetic to the charges put against us: namely rigidity, inflexibility, conspiracy and espionage. We somewhat resent 'indiscriminate terror' however. It has been anything but. Nonetheless, it has become apparent we lack the public support to continue as we are without needlessly and injuriously imposing our program on the unwilling. As such, we have invited the Assembly to reconvene on New Winchester, with our full and fulsome support. I feel compelled to make clear that the Windward Company does not regard this as a defeat, but rather a new opportunity for peaceful cooperation and bipartisanship in the Reach."
","34":"All work at Victory Hall has been stalled by a measure introduced by the Prudent Secretary of the Windward Company, attempting to regulate the materials of engines the Company will accept trade with and from. It is widely believed the measure is an attempt by the Company to force the Assembly to reveal their part in supporting the practice of illegal engine construction from salvage taken from wrecked locomotives.","35":"The Amenable Host at Magdalene's has reported an influx of traumatised and sky-mad Tackety crew. They all refer to an unprovoked attack off Port Avon, where the enemy guns were deliberately targeting the glass of their windows, thus disabling the engines and leaving the identity of the enemy entirely concealed. The Windward Company has pointed out that this would be in direct contravention of the Laws of Engagement established by the Assembly.","36":"Fury in the Windward Company offices as a supposed company holiday ended in disaster. Discounted tickets to Polmear and Plenty's Circus transpired to coincide with a date when the Ring Leader's cards left them unable (or unwilling) to put on a performance. The offer to purchase new tickets at full price for the next day was not taken up, the Gazette understands.","33":"Tensions mount in the Gulf of Gloam, as the stalled Tackety Scout refuses any attempt at rescue by patrolling Windward Company engines. The captain has called in aid from a Tackety contingent on manoeuvres near Traitor's Wood, which the Windward Commander is unwilling to let approach. Bloodshed is expected imminently.","8":"Horror in Port Avon as a senior Tackety signaller has been found dead, seemingly of stomach failure. Leaked reports from the coroner indicate a sudden and lethal ingestion of a large quantity of Hybras fungus. The Windward Company have offered their condolences to the family, and a lifetime supply of mushroom soup."}}

","13":"本周，伍载镇天翻地覆。对一家著名统计所的突击检查暴露了其与犯罪分子勾结合作的证据。臭名昭著的煽动者，女杀手及破坏者蜜糖阿简被据说正在伍载镇活动。迎风公司认为她已隐匿，近期内其活动将严重受阻。
","14":"一个老面孔回到了外野政治的前线。蜜糖阿简在一次大集会的激烈会议上洗脱了罪名，会议一直持续到凌晨。尽管坚韧的老兵强烈反对，但大集会裁定认定她在封锁期间导致皇后桥号被毁的行为中无故意恶意，且该时期针对她的其他十五项指控中有十三项均被判无罪。流亡伦敦的新温彻斯特总督拒绝发表评论，尽管她妻子的家人对决议表示反对。","15":"迎风公司股票上涨，在吝啬鬼主席恢复为和平时期关系委员会主席之后，在一名发言人所说的“失误”后短暂缺席。据了解，任性的会计师有望迅速康复。公司的机车已在埃文村和空中花园附近恢复运行。
","16":"据报道，午夜时分，边境地区发生小规模冲突。一辆迎风公司的机车被毁于自叛徒之林返程途中。两名钉鞋党车长被带进常胜厅问话，不过大集会的一位发言人表示，事故原因是能见度骤然下降。\"毕竟，在黑暗中，谁能分辨出伦敦机车和迎风机车之间的区别呢？\"","17":"据报道， 狄坦妮娅上空发生了一场毁灭性的战斗。大集会的几名高层已经辞职，而迎风公司则要求热情洋溢的市长辞职。《新公报》认为，迎风公司计划对一处钉鞋党走私窝点进行突袭，但差点被一群突然出现的唱诗蜂打乱方向。人们看到大部分公司机车已返回兴荣港。钉鞋党已经销声匿迹，或者是完全消亡了。","18":"下层地区一家秘密军火厂被炮击！根据秘密情报，坚韧的老兵召开了一次紧急会议，授权使用致命武力来消除威胁。据报道，没有幸存者，大集会也没有人员伤亡。迎风公司尽力为正在进行的调查提供帮助。","19":"随着迎风公司在第二次新温彻斯特战役中取得了出乎意料的全面胜利，《新公报》想借此机会向车站的新主人表示最真诚的祝贺。我们还想请求公司在推进改革时，考虑到新温彻斯特的独特历史和特点，并记住我们不是兴荣港，也不希望成为兴荣港。我们还希望迎风公司立即撤销其和平时期联络委员会。","21":"尽管取得了胜利，但谣言弥漫整个新温彻斯特站，称公司正在兴荣港的工场里建造新机车。伊桑巴德航线上已发现无畏机车。看来伦敦不会轻易放弃其代理权。","23":"尽管最近遇到一些挫折，但大集会本周的表现非常好。事实证明，为伍载镇的勘探者引入独立许可证的新立法非常受欢迎，而新的《本地治理，外部协助法案》得到了来自埃文村、狄坦妮娅，甚至是兴荣港代理政府代表们的赞扬。同时，蜜糖阿简对推测为公司遗弃前哨的突击检查已取得成果。","24":"迎风公司继续发挥其优势，似是回应大集会认为的自满。兴荣港代理政府在周一晚间遭遇政变，内阁成员在政府临时总部“海军上将纳尔逊餐馆”中被逮捕。迎风公司已重获民间政府的控制权，并鼓励其他车站对\"钉鞋暴政\"进行反击。","25":"近期发生的一连串戏剧性事件将令所有未关注《新公报》版面的人感到无比震惊。大集会昨夜投票决定退出外野的多个车站政府，并允许迎风公司返回新温彻斯特。日益不受欢迎的议会将不得不应对日益增长的物资短缺和捉襟见肘的分配策略，以及自身能力的局限性。是否觉察谨慎的秘书在新协议中有所牵涉？","27":"尽管这似乎是一场胜利，但迎风公司的控制并不像它看起来那么稳固。《新公报》可以证实大集会的几个关键人物目前仍然存活，包括坚韧的老兵和蜜糖阿简，他们都在伍载镇被目击。远方的车站已经有了不满的杂音，他们不会对任何企图强加给他们的直接统治感到高兴。
","29":“我们从吝啬鬼主席那里得到消息，我们的末日预言和抱怨正变得令人头痛。与此同时，我们还收到了谨慎的秘书对我们最近工作的赞赏。新温彻斯特的贸易有所改善，其他车站也在与董事会接洽，提出开始谈判。到目前为止，除了最热心的钉鞋党支持者，似乎没有人愿意恢复敌对行动。
＂,"30":“公司方面为清除投敌者和同情者而做出的尖锐举措似乎造成了与预期相反的效果。有的车站区域（我们被告知）现在是“公司”官员的禁区，包括整个主教桥区域。被赦免的大集会成员聚集在圆桌旁。许多边境车站已经切断了联系，其中最不祥的是伍载镇。
","31":“我们在这里发表谨慎的秘书的一封信，仅做了少量修改。\"在最近一段时间的动荡后，我们注意到迎风公司在处理新温彻斯特形势时存在错误。我们并非对那些针对我们的指控无动于衷：即严酷、死板、阴谋和间谍。然而，我们并不接受“无差别恐怖”的指责。事实远非如此。然而，我们显然缺乏公众的支持来继续我们的计划，以免采取非必要而有害的手段将我们的计划强加给无辜者。因此，我们已邀请大集会在我们鼎力甚至过分的支持下重回新温彻斯特。我觉得有必要明确表示，迎风公司认为这并非一次失败，而是一个两派和平合作的新机遇。\"
","34":“常胜厅的所有工作都因迎风公司谨慎的秘书提出的一项措施而停滞不前，该措施试图规范公司接受交易的发动机的材料。人们普遍认为，该措施是该公司试图迫使大集会暴露他们在支持打捞失事机车、组装非法机车方面所起的作用。”,"35":"抹大拉之家的随和的主管汇报称，大批精神受创和天狂症发作的钉鞋列车员涌入抹大拉之家。他们都提到了在埃文村附近的一次无端攻击，敌人的枪故意瞄准他们的车窗玻璃，致使引擎失灵，并恰好隐匿了敌人的身份。迎风公司指出，这直接违反了大集会制定的交战法。”,"36":“迎风公司办公室的愤怒事件：原以为是公司假期，结果以灾难收场。 波尔梅尔&普伦蒂马戏团的折扣票恰逢团长的不详占卜结果，马戏团成员在当天无法（或不愿）进行表演。据本报了解，全价购买次日新票的提议未被采纳。”,"33":格洛姆湾的紧张局势升级，因为抛锚的“战术侦察机车”拒绝了所有迎风公司巡逻机车的救援尝试。该车长呼叫了一支在叛徒之林附近演习的战术分队进行支援，迎风公司的指挥官不愿让他们靠近。流血事件一触即发。”}}

currentOriginal: "Why should Punishment Weave the Veil with Iron Wheels of War" A short-range, rapid-firing gun capable of quick turn arounds. Beloved by the short-tempered and the short-sighted.
